article.articleHeadline: Deadly virus on the cruise ship: WHO issues advisory on global risk
article.articleSummary: HCPS hantavirus outbreak linked to a Dutch-flagged cruise ship carrying 147 passengers and crew. By 4 May, seven cases (two laboratory-confirmed, five suspected) including three deaths; one patient critically ill, others milder. The vessel departed Ushuaia, Argentina on 1 April, traversed the South Atlantic to Antarctica, and remains moored off Cabo Verde while investigators probe exposure on shore excursions or before boarding. Contact tracing, isolation, testing, and medical evacuations are under way. WHO assesses global risk as low. Early symptoms mimic viral illness (fever, headache, GI distress) but can rapidly progress to respiratory failure; hantaviruses are rodent-borne; human-to-human transmission is extremely uncommon, mainly with Andes virus. No specific antivirals or vaccines; management is early detection with intensive supportive care. WHO notes 2025 Americas data: 229 cases, 59 deaths (CFR 25.7%); East Asia reports HFRS activity.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船での致命的ウイルス：WHOが世界的リスクについて警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国にまたがる集団発生、死亡例あり、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: アルゼンチン・カナリア諸島・アンゴラなど複数地域が関連しているが、対象国に限定するとChinaのみ（記事で東アジアのHFRS活動が言及）。クルーズ船由来の国際的集団発生であり、複数国での死亡例、人-人感染リスク（限定的だが言及）、医療対応の負荷あり。WHOが世界リスク低と評価しているも、IHR通知相当の公衆衛生影響および国際的性質は明確。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak di Sumut Tinggi Data Terbaru 2026 dan Analisis Pengamat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in North Sumatra are high: latest data for 2026 and observers' analysis.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in North Sumatra, Indonesia: 387 suspected cases and 18 laboratory-confirmed positives as of March 4, 2026, raising concern over expansion of an outbreak amid low MR (measles and rubella) immunization coverage and vaccine-distribution challenges. In 2025, MR immunization reached 84.1%—below the 93% herd-immunity target. Stock instability since 2024–25—MR vaccine also used for the MR BIAS campaign—plus insufficient central buffers have limited MR vaccination at posyandu. A high zero-dose burden persists (about 91,000 children at risk); urban density in Medan and Deli Serdang, high mobility, and vaccine misinformation worsen transmission. The first MR dose alone does not confer herd immunity; a second dose is essential, yielding about 95% protection. Authorities are strengthening surveillance and pursuing catch-up immunization; public is advised to seek care for fever with red rash. Details on imported/exported cases not provided.

triage.headline_ja: 北スマトラ州の麻疹患者数が高い：2026年の最新データと観測者の分析
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とはしかの同時流行（387疑い例、18確定例）が報告され、予防接種カバレッジが目標値93%を下回る84.1%に留まっており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。IHR基準でも「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」が該当し、フルRRA検討が必要。
triage.notes: 北スマトラ州メダンでの麻疹・風疹同時流行。予防接種不足（目標93%に対し84.1%）、ワクチン供給課題、高い未接種児童数（約91,000人）、都市密集地による高い感染リスク、予防接種に関する誤情報が懸念される。国際的な報告義務基準を満たす可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two domestic meningitis cases! A one-month-old male infant has been diagnosed; this year's same-period cases have reached a 10-year high.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports two confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases caused by Neisseria meningitidis (serogroup B): a 1-month-old infant born in the south and a man in his 30s in central Taiwan. The infant developed poor feeding and irritability in mid-April, fever prompted hospital admission; CSF testing confirmed meningococcal meningitis, and he remains hospitalized in stable condition after more than two weeks. The adult in his 30s developed fever, cough, myalgia, and septic symptoms in late April; blood culture grew Neisseria meningitidis; he has been hospitalized about a week with stable status; infection source under investigation. This year Taiwan has 7 confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases, higher than the 2017–2025 same-period range of 0–6. Globally, outbreaks have risen in Africa's Meningitis Belt, Vietnam, and parts of the U.S. and U.K.; transmission occurs via close contact with respiratory secretions. Prevention emphasizes reducing crowding and maintaining hand and respiratory hygiene, and seeking care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国内で流行性髄膜炎2例発生！生後1ヶ月の男児が確診、今年同期の病例は10年ぶりの新高

article.articleHeadline: Waspada, Orang Dewasa Bisa Kena Campak Sampai Bikin Radang Otak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware: Adults Can Contract Measles That Can Cause Encephalitis
article.articleSummary: Measles poses danger to adults, contrary to the belief it is only a childhood disease. In Indonesia, Dr. Erpryta Nurdia Tetrasiwi of Eka Hospital MT Haryono notes adults without immunity remain at risk of severe illness, including encephalitis. Immunity from childhood vaccines can wane; older one-dose regimens left gaps, whereas two-dose MMR offers about 97% protection. The measles virus can survive in the air for up to two hours after an infected person leaves a room, sustaining transmission risks in offices and transit, especially for those without immunity. In adults, measles can cause not only rash and fever but also immune suppression and serious complications, with 1 in 1,000 cases progressing to encephalitis, risking seizures, hearing loss, and permanent damage; rare cases include myocarditis and keratitis leading to blindness. Protection remains possible through MMR vaccination, acting as a booster, along with avoiding contact with febrile and rash individuals during outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 注意：成人も麻疹に感染する可能性があり、脳炎を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹と脳炎のリスク啓発記事だが、具体的な発症例数、集団発生の規模、死亡事例などの実質的なイベント発生データが不明確。医学的警告の性質が強く、公式な疾病サーベイランス報告ではないため、現段階では情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアの医療専門家による麻疹の危険性についての啓発記事であり、実際の集団発生イベントの報告ではない。麻疹の重症度（脳炎リスク）と感染性（エアロゾル伝播）は確認されるが、現在のインドネシアでの具体的な患者数、入院数、死亡数などのサーベイランスデータが記事に含まれていない。続報でイベント規模や実際の患者発生状況が報告される場合は、PICKUP判定への変更が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin "khẩn" về vi rút Hanta sau thông tin thế giới ghi nhận 3 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health issues an urgent update on Hantavirus after global reports of 3 deaths
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak risk on a cruise ship traveling from Argentina through the South Atlantic. As of May 4, 2026, seven respiratory illness cases have been reported: two laboratory-confirmed Hantavirus infections and five suspected; three deaths (one in critical condition) and three mild cases. The vessel carries 147 people from 23 nationalities; no Vietnamese nationals are involved. Vietnam’s Center for Disease Control notes Hantavirus can cause severe disease—Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome or Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome—with no specific cure; care is supportive. Transmission is primarily rodent-to-human (urine, feces, saliva, or inhaled dust); human-to-human transmission is rare but documented. Incubation is 2–8 weeks (up to 8 weeks possible). Early symptoms include fever, chills, myalgia, and gastrointestinal symptoms, potentially progressing to dyspnea and shock. Vietnam stresses prevention, rodent control, and public awareness; no cases detected domestically.

triage.headline_ja: 厚生省、世界で報告された3人の死亡事例を受けてハンタウイルスに関する緊急情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: 複数国間での国際的な集団発生（アルゼンチンから南大西洋経由で発生した船上での集団発生）、2件の確認症例と3件の死亡（1件は重篤）という重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、および複数国への拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3項目とWPRO基準3項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはハンタウイルス集団発生のグローバル情報に関するベトナム厚生省の緊急警告が主題である。発生地はアルゼンチン・南米発の船舶上だが、配信媒体がベトナムのDOI SONG PHAP LUAT（ベトナムのメディア）であり、記事の主要な関心はベトナムでの対応と国民啓発である。アルゼンチン（3865483）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに記載されない。米国のニュージャージー州での事例も含まれているが、米国も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。この事例は国際的な船舶での複数国籍の集団発生であり、ベトナムを含む多くの国に対する潜在的脅威となる。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirüs can aldı! Atlantik Okyanusu'ndaki turistik gemide üç kişi öldü - Haberler
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus claims lives! Three people died on a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean - News
article.articleSummary: Three people died aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship in the Atlantic during a hantavirus outbreak. The World Health Organization confirmed one laboratory-confirmed hantavirus case and five additional suspected cases, with investigations ongoing; the voyage was from Argentina to the Cape Verde Islands. Hantavirus is carried by rodents and can be transmitted to humans via airborne particles from dried droppings or urine, with rodent bites as a less common route. The virus causes Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) and Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS). HPS presents with fatigue, fever and myalgia, then headache, dizziness, tremors, and abdominal symptoms; respiratory failure carries about a 38% mortality. HFRS primarily affects kidneys, potentially causing shock and acute kidney failure. Global HFRS ~150,000 cases annually, many in China; US cases since 1993 total 890. Treatment is supportive; prevention emphasizes rodent control and protective gear when cleaning droppings. A 2025 hantavirus-related death of Betsy Arakawa is noted.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスが人命奪う！大西洋のクルーズ船で3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡例あり、予想外：クルーズ船での集団発生、国際的拡大リスク：複数国にまたがる航路）。WPRO基準でも重症度と流行リスクが確認された。国際的な船舶での感染症クラスターはフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: クルーズ船（MV Hondius）の航路はアルゼンチン→カーボベルデ間だが、サマリーで具体的な発症者の国籍や乗船地域の詳細が不明確。ただしWHOが確認した検査陽性例が存在し、死亡3例、疑い例5例という重大な公衆衛生事象。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類媒介で、クルーズ船内でのげっ歯類繁殖による持続的曝露リスクが懸念される。サマリーで「中国でグローバルHFRS症例の多数発生」が記述されているため、China（1814991）を verified_locations に含める。USA、アルゼンチン、カーボベルデは対象国リスト外であり除外。

article.articleHeadline: รู้จัก 'ไวรัสฮันตา' โรคร้ายจากหนูสู่คน เปิดสาเหตุการระบาด อาการ วิธีป้องกันในไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Learn about Hantavirus, a deadly rodent-to-human disease: causes of outbreaks, symptoms, and prevention in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus is a rodent-to-human disease. Thailand currently reports no cases. Globally, hantavirus disease is widespread, with China reporting about 40,000–100,000 cases annually; Korea ~1,000/year; Europe (including Russia and the Balkans) experiences nephropathia epidemica from Puumala virus, peaking in spring–summer. In Thailand, historical data show exposure to Hanta-like viruses: antibodies detected in 1985 in Kanchanaburi and Bangkok; a 1991 Siriraj Hospital study confirmed Hanta-like infection by ELISA in Bangkok; subsequent studies found IgG antibodies in more patients. Rodent surveillance (with Mahidol University) found hantavirus in multiple rodent species in Thailand, including Rattus rattus, R. exulans, R. norvegicus, Bandicota indica, B. savilei, with 2–24% prevalence, indicating circulation. Transmission occurs by inhaling aerosols from rodent urine, saliva, or feces; bites are less common. Preventive measures: rodent-proofing, food storage, disinfection with diluted agents, careful cleaning, trapping, reducing wildlife contact, and testing laboratory rats. Surveillance and rodent control are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスについて学ぶ：齧歯動物から人への致命的な病気、タイでの流行の原因、症状、予防方法
triage.triage_reason: タイでハンタウイルスの現在の症例報告はないが、歴史的な血清学的証拠と齧歯動物サーベイランスに基づくウイルス循環が確認されている。情報が限定的であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はタイにおけるハンタウイルスの疾病認識・教育であり、現在の人的症例は報告されていない。しかし、齧歯動物での循環が確認され、過去に血清学的証拠があることから、潜在的なリスクが存在する。記事は情報提供的性質であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirüs nedir? Hantavirüs belirtileri neler? Hantavirüs nasıl bulaşır?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Hantavirus? What are Hantavirus symptoms? How is Hantavirus transmitted?
article.articleSummary: Three people died in a hantavirus outbreak on a passenger ship in the Atlantic Ocean, per WHO. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne; human infection mainly occurs when aerosols from rodent urine, droppings, or saliva are inhaled, with bites rarely causing transmission. Globally, about 150,000 HFRS cases are reported annually, with more than half in China; US cases numbered 890 between 1993–2023. The Seoul virus strain has spread worldwide via the brown rat (Rattus norvegicus). In February 2025, Betsy Arakawa, wife of actor Gene Hackman, died of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome after exposure to rodent nests at home. No disease-specific cure exists; management is supportive—oxygen therapy, ventilation, and dialysis as needed, with antivirals used in some cases and ICU care for severe disease. Prevention focuses on eliminating rodent contact, sealing home entry points, and wearing protective gear when cleaning droppings. Early infection presents with flu-like symptoms starting 1–2 weeks after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとは何か？ハンタウイルスの症状は何か？ハンタウイルスはどのように感染するか？
triage.triage_reason: 大西洋上の旅客船でのハンタウイルス集団発生により3人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常・予想外の事象」が該当。国際輸送環境での感染拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な事象は大西洋上の旅客船でのハンタウイルス集団発生（3人死亡）である。Bluedot APIが「United States」と「China」を発生地域として付与しているが、サマリーでは船舶上での発生が主題であり、具体的な属する国の記載がないため、対象国リストに基づき China のみを verified_locations に含める。米国での事例（Betsy Arakawa）は参考情報として記載されている。船舶での異常な集団発生が国際的な懸念となりうる。

article.articleHeadline: 3度就醫才通報！台南再增境外移入登革熱病例 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reported only after three medical visits! Tainan reports more imported dengue fever cases - Liberty Health Net
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's Tainan City reports one new imported dengue fever case, bringing the city’s total imported cases to three. The patient, a woman in her 30s from Xinpu Village, Guanmiao District, traveled to the Maldives from April 22 to May 1. After returning, she developed fever, muscle pain, and a rash, and sought medical care three times before PCR confirmed dengue on May 4. The Dengue Prevention Center mobilized an emergency response, including spraying the residence area, eliminating breeding sites, conducting vector-density surveys, and planning chemical control. Center director Li Cui-feng emphasized the delay between visits and reporting, urging physicians to routinely obtain travel history to facilitate early diagnosis and reduce community spread. The health bureau warned of penalties under the Infectious Disease Control Act for failure to report.

triage.headline_ja: 3度就醫才通報！台南再増境外移入登革熱病例（3度目の受診でようやく通報！台南で追加の境外移入デング熱症例）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国リストに含まれない）でのデング熱境外移入事例の報告。ただし、患者の感染地がモルディブ（非対象国）であり、台湾は対象国ではないため、verified_locationsは空となるが、同時に医療機関の通報遅延問題が感染管理上の重要な課題として浮上しており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。しかし対象国リストの制約により、本イベントは地域検証で除外される。
triage.notes: 記事の主な舞台は台湾の台南市であり、患者の感染地はモルディブである。台湾は対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。ただしIHR基準2つ以上該当（unusual/international_spread）かつWPRO基準2つ以上該当（abnormal/epidemic_prone）し、医療通報遅延という公衆衛生管理上の重要な懸念が存在している。対象国リスト外のイベントであるため、本トリアージは参考情報のみとして扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: 近10年年紀最小！1個月大男嬰確診流行性腦膜炎 食欲不振隔天入住ICU | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The youngest in nearly a decade! A one-month-old boy diagnosed with epidemic meningitis; loss of appetite led to ICU admission the next day.
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Taiwan has confirmed seven cases of meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis), including a one-month-old male—the youngest in nearly a decade—and a man in his 30s. The infant, born in the south and cared for in a postpartum home, developed poor appetite and crying on April 17; fever led to ICU admission on April 18, and CSF testing confirmed infection. Four household members received post-exposure prophylaxis. The adult presented with fever, cough, and limb pain on April 26–28, progressing to sepsis; laboratory confirmation followed, with one close contact monitored without symptoms. Nationally, cases this year (7) exceed the 2017–2025 range (0–6). Globally, Africa’s Meningitis Belt remains active during the dry season, with 22 countries reporting 6,929 suspected cases and 340 deaths; Congo, Niger, Burkina Faso are notable. Transmission is via close contact with respiratory secretions; vaccination is advised for at-risk individuals, and prevention emphasizes hygiene and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 近10年で最年少！生後1ヶ月の男児が流行性脳膜炎を確診 食欲不振で翌日ICU入院
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で流行性脳膜炎（髄膜菌性髄膜炎）の確定症例が急増（7例、過去9年間の0-6例を上回る）。乳幼児を含む重症例が複数発生し、アフリカのメニンジティスベルト地域での同時活動と並行して懸念あり。IHR基準2つ以上該当・WPRO基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはDRC、Burkina Faso、Niger、Taiwan、Africaが記載されているが、記事サマリーの主題は台湾（Taiwan）での髄膜菌性髄膜炎の確定症例増加。アフリカの情報は参考情報として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにおいて、台湾はChina(1814991)に含まれるため、verified_locationsはChinaのみとした。DRC(203312)は対象国に含まれるが、記事サマリーではアフリカ全体の背景情報として言及されており、具体的な台湾でのイベントが主題であるため除外。Classical Swine Feverも疾患リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーには言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: 12 người ở một phường bị chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12 people in a ward were bitten by dogs suspected of having rabies.
article.articleSummary: On May 3–5, 2026, in Phuoc Hoi ward, Lam Dong Province, Vietnam, a stray dog suspected of rabies attacked near the Phuoc Hoi fishing port, injuring 12 people. By May 4, residents with authorities had restrained the animal, and initial assessments classify the dog as rabies-suspected; samples were taken from bite victims for testing. Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear. Health workers advised bite victims to rinse wounds with clean running water and soap for about 15 minutes, disinfect, and promptly seek medical care for vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin as indicated. The incident underscores the need for dog vaccination, bite prevention, and timely post-exposure management in the area.

triage.headline_ja: ある町区で12人が狂犬病疑いの犬に咬まれた
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑い例で複数の人的被害（12人）が発生し、IHR基準「異常/予想外」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。ベトナムは対象国であり、地域検証完了。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が極めて高い（症状出現後ほぼ100%）。複数人被害と感染源（疑い犬）の確保が報告されている。動物由来感染症の人間への伝播事例として重要。記事サマリーに基づくと、イベント発生地はベトナムのLam Dong Province（ラムドン省）Phuoc Hoi ward。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Mewabah, Cirebon Gratiskan RS Pemerintah untuk Warga Tanpa BPJS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Outbreak: Cirebon Waives Government Hospital Fees for Residents Without BPJS
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Cirebon Regency, Indonesia, with four districts—Mundu, Sumber, Greged, and Ciwaringin—designated as a KLB after a surge of suspected cases in week 15 of 2026. A total of 119 suspected measles cases, with 23 laboratory-confirmed positives, and no deaths reported. Public hospitals waive fees for residents without BPJS to ensure access to care. Health authorities have intensified surveillance, early detection, and community education, amid irregular weather that may raise transmission risk. A catch-up vaccination campaign (CUC) for children 9 months–59 months has reached about 95% coverage at the regency level, and ORI will expand to seven additional subdistricts for ages 9 months–13 years. Measles-rubella (MR) immunization coverage over five years remains below 80%, underscoring ongoing vulnerability due to high mobility and gaps in vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しん流行、シレボン地域が無保険者向けの公立病院の費用を免除
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻しん・風疹の確認されたアウトブレイクが報告されており、IHR基準「異常・予想外」に該当し、WPRO基準複数項目（重症度、流行感染性、管理可能性など）が満たされている。社会的関心も確認されている。
triage.notes: シレボン地域（Cirebon Regency）での麻しんアウトブレイク。119件の疑い例、23件の実験室確認例、死亡例なし。予防接種率が80%未満であることが課題。当局が追跡予防接種キャンペーン等の対応を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Combinational effect of gamma irradiation and sustainable bioactive absorbent bacterial cellulose pads impregnated with tangerine essential oil against some bacterial fish fillet-borne pathogens - Bioresources and Bioprocessing
article.articleSummary: BC-impregnated with tangerine essential oil (TEO) as a bioactive absorbent pad, combined with gamma irradiation, was evaluated to curb bacteria contaminating fish fillets. From 10 fish fillet samples, 24 pathogenic isolates were recovered: Enterobacter cloacae complexes (8), Klebsiella oxytoca (7), Serratia ficaria (5), and Kocuria rosea (4). The study addresses rising diversity of aquatic pathogens linked to fish, noting that multidrug-resistant E. cloacae and K. oxytoca have been reported in fish in India’s southeast coast, Nile fish in Egypt, and in Zambia; no Salmonella, Listeria, Vibrio, or E. coli were detected in farmed shrimp in Bangladesh. The average microbial load in the FFS exceeded acceptable limits per CFS 2014 and EOSQC/8891/2005. The work supports essential oils as safe antimicrobials, with irradiation-enhanced BC pads offering a potential intervention to reduce contamination during processing and packaging.

triage.headline_ja: マンダリンエッセンシャルオイルを含浸させたバクテリアセルロースパッドとガンマ線照射の併用効果：魚フィレ由来の細菌病原体に対する研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は魚フィレ汚染防止の技術開発に関する実験的研究報告であり、実際の公衆衛生危機イベントではない。記事で列挙された複数国は技術の応用可能性を示すための例示であり、各国での実際の感染症アウトブレイク発生を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術論文で、食品安全技術の研究報告である。複数国（ザンビア、エジプト、インド、バングラデシュ）が言及されているが、これらは耐性菌が「報告されている」地域として背景情報として引用されており、当該イベント（アウトブレイク）が発生している地域ではない。実際の感染症危機管理シグナルの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Касса здоровья призывает защитить детей: в Европе распространяется несколько опасных заболеваний
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Fund Urges the Protection of Children: Several Dangerous Diseases Are Spreading Across Europe.
article.articleSummary: Estonia faces rising measles risk amid regional outbreaks. In 2024 Estonia had 4 measles cases; 2025 saw 11 (7 locally transmitted, 4 imported from Ireland, Thailand, and Russia); none were vaccinated, and more than half were hospitalized. In 2026 Estonia has registered three measles cases. Latvia reports a Riga-area school-linked measles outbreak with about 50 cases and over 1,000 close contacts. Beyond measles, Europe has seen outbreaks of pertussis, mumps, rubella, and tetanus. Estonia recorded two mumps cases in 2025 (Lääne-Viru and Jõgeva) and five in 2024 (Harju, Tallinn, Pärnu, Viljandi, Tartu); tetanus was last diagnosed in 2024 in Viljandi. Immunization coverage for most vaccines sits at 75-85%, below the WHO target of 95%, leaving about 25% of children unprotected. Parents are urged to check vaccination status with their GP; vaccines are free via the national schedule; call 1220 for information and prepare for autumn school entry and travel.

triage.headline_ja: ヘルスケア基金が子どもたちの保護を呼びかけ：ヨーロッパで複数の危険な疾病が拡大中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響・異常な状況・国際的拡大リスク）。複数の対象国での麻疹等感染症の集団発生であり、ワクチン接種率の低下が基盤要因。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはエストニア、ラトビア、アイルランド、ロシア等が含まれるが、対象国リストではタイのみ該当。記事では麻疹の輸入症例がタイを含む複数国から報告されているため Thailand (1605651) をverified_locationsに含める。エストニアでの麻疹集団発生（2026年3例、2025年11例）、ラトビアのリガ学校関連集団発生（約50例）、複数国でのワクチン予防可能疾患（麻疹、おたふくかぜ、百日咳、風疹、破傷風）の相次ぐ報告が懸念される。ワクチン接種率が75-85%であり、WHO目標の95%に達していない点が重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 38 Filipino crew on Atlantic cruise safe from hantavirus  --  DOH
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard an Atlantic cruise ship near Praia port, Cape Verde: 38 Filipino crew members are safe and uninfected, while three passengers have died and three others are infected. The vessel carries about 150 tourists from several countries; medics are planning evacuation to ensure safety of the remaining passengers. DOH spokesperson Albert Domingo said none of the Filipino crew tested positive for hantavirus, citing WHO reports. There have been no hantivirus cases recorded in the Philippines in 2026. Authorities are coordinating with international partners to monitor potential imported/exported case risks. Details on the infection source or exact timing beyond the ship's docking near Praia on May 3, 2026 were limited.

triage.headline_ja: 大西洋クルーズ船のハンタウイルス感染症：フィリピン人乗組員38人は安全 - DOH
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡者発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度：死亡者・感染者あり、流行しやすさ：クルーズ船という高リスク環境）。国際的な感染症管理協調の必要性あり。
triage.notes: 記事主題はカーボベルデ沖のクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生ですが、verified_locationsはフィリピン人乗組員の安全確認とフィリピンでの感染事例なしという報告に基づき、対象国リストに該当する地域がフィリピンのみであるため、フィリピンのみを列挙。カーボベルデはスクリーニング対象国に含まれていないため除外。多国籍乗客や国際的な感染リスク評価は重要だが、実際の感染発生地はカーボベルデ沖（対象国外）。

article.articleHeadline: Kampanye Global Soroti Ancaman Penyakit Pernapasan pada Orang Dewasa |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Campaign Highlights the Threat of Respiratory Diseases in Adults
article.articleSummary: Pfizer Indonesia, in collaboration with healthcare professionals, launched the 'For the Reasons that Matter' campaign to raise public awareness of adult respiratory health, rolling out simultaneously in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and the Philippines. The initiative educates about the impact of serious respiratory diseases—COVID-19, influenza, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), and pneumococcal disease—on quality of life, independence, and daily functioning. Indonesia, with over 280 million people and nearly 34 million adults aged 60+ (12%), faces widespread acute respiratory infections, which surpassed 13 million cases reported through November 2025, per the Ministry of Health. BPJS Kesehatan outpatient costs for respiratory conditions run about IDR 10–13 trillion annually. World Immunization Week, observed in late April, emphasizes health protection across ages. Campaign leader Deborah Seifert notes a gap between adults' health expectations and actions, aiming to make respiratory health conversations relevant and actionable, with clinicians guiding discussions.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルキャンペーン、成人の呼吸器疾患の脅威に焦点
triage.triage_reason: RSVおよびインフルエンザに関する公衆衛生啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な感染症の発生報告ではない。該当対象国（フィリピン、インドネシア）での広告・教育活動が主体で、新規の流行警報ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はファイザーインドネシアが実施した呼吸器疾患啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、感染症の新規発生や流行警報ではない。背景として2025年11月までにインドネシアで1,300万件以上の急性呼吸器感染症例が報告されている記述があるが、具体的な現在の流行状況の詳細は不明。シグナルピックアップの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: दही-बड़ा खाने वाले रुक जाएं! कैसे एक छोटी सी गलती ने पूरे गांव को बना दिया बीमार | Food Poisoning Dahi Bara Symptoms Prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dahi Bada Eaters, Stop Now! How a Small Mistake Made the Entire Village Sick | Food Poisoning, Dahi Bada, Symptoms, Prevention
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreak in Odisha's Jajpur district, India, after 58 people consumed dahi bada from a roadside stall between 08:30 and 09:30 local time. Rapid onset of vomiting and diarrhea followed; several patients, including children, were admitted to hospital. As of May 5, 2026, all patients are reported to be stable. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the suspected contaminant. This incident underscores the risks of street-food consumption and potential food-safety lapses at informal vendors, highlighting the need for vigilance in hygiene practices and public health messaging to prevent similar outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ダヒバラ食べる人は止めて！小さな間違いがいかにして村全体を病気にしたか | 食中毒、ダヒバラ、症状、予防
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な食中毒事例（58人、1つの路上店舗、全員安定）で、異常性、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスクはいずれも低い。情報確度も低く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響の証拠もない。
triage.notes: 単一の食中毒事例で、患者数が限定的（58人）、発生源が特定された（路上店舗のダヒバラ）、全患者が安定している。実験室確認なし。公衆衛生警報の基準を満たさない通常の食中毒報告。

article.articleHeadline: ไข้กาฬหลังแอ่น ยังต้องจับตาผู้ป่วยเพิ่มในหลายประเทศ ไทยพบตลอดทั้งปีและอัตราเสียชีวิตสูง | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease: cases to watch as numbers rise in several countries; Thailand sees cases year-round with a high mortality rate
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports 24 meningococcal disease cases and 4 deaths in 2026, with 46% under 15 years old, higher than last year. Thailand records 5 cases and 3 deaths in 2026, a 60% case-fatality rate, with most patients aged 0–4, then 40–49 and 20–29. Meningococcal disease, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, can rapidly progress to meningitis or septicemia. Transmission is via respiratory droplets and close contact; sharing items such as cups and even electronic cigarettes may spread infection. Early warning signs include sudden high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, and rash; urgent hospital care is crucial to prevent brain injury, hearing loss, limb loss, sepsis, or death. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention, alongside strict personal hygiene and rapid treatment. Vietnam is implementing proactive controls (cleaning/disinfection, hygiene, prompt treatment), while Thailand maintains year-round vigilance and vaccination emphasis for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌疾患：複数国で症例増加の監視が必要、タイでは年間を通じて発生し死亡率が高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、高い死亡率（タイ60%、ベトナム17%）、複数国での同時発生、ワクチン対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: タイでは2026年に5例3死（死亡率60%）、ベトナムでは24例4死（死亡率17%）が報告されており、特に小児層への影響が大きい。髄膜炎菌疾患は呼吸飛沫感染で急速に進行し、ワクチン接種による予防が強調されている。両国での活発な対応（清掃・消毒、衛生管理、迅速な治療）が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus: Após crise em navio de cruzeiro, relembre surto de infecção nos anos 90 que causou mortes no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: After cruise-ship crisis, recall the 1990s infection outbreak that caused deaths in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of hantavirus on the cruise ship MV Hondius near Cape Verde has prompted authorities to issue alerts after reporting deaths and one confirmed hantavirus case aboard the vessel. Hantavirus is a rare rodent-borne infection that can cause pulmonary edema and carries high mortality. The incident recalls a 1990s outbreak in the United States that exposed the seriousness of the infection and its potential for fatal respiratory complications. In Brazil, hantavirus was identified in 1993 and subsequently spread to several regions, underscoring the need for early diagnosis and the difficulties of treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：クルーズ船危機の後、1990年代ブラジルの致死的な感染アウトブレイクを想起
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響・異常・国際的拡大リスク）。クルーズ船での死亡例とハンタウイルス確定例、多国間への流行リスク、渡航制限の可能性が認められ、フルRRA進行に値する。
triage.notes: サマリーはクルーズ船MV Hondiusの危機（Cape Verde近海）とブラジルの1990年代アウトブレイク回顧が主題。現在のクルーズ船での死亡例と確定例により高い関心。ただし、現在の発生地が「Cape Verde近海のクルーズ船」であり、ブラジルでの発生は1990年代の過去の事例であることに注意。クルーズ船は対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。高い死亡率と呼吸器合併症のリスクが報告されており、初期診断と治療の困難さが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mirip tapi Tak Sama, Influenza Punya Dampak Lebih Serius dari Selesma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Similar but Not the Same: Influenza Has a More Serious Impact Than the Common Cold.
article.articleSummary: Influenza poses a greater threat than the common cold in Jakarta, Indonesia. Although often mistaken for mild illness, influenza is highly airborne and can rapidly worsen, causing high fever and systemic impact, especially in the elderly and those with comorbidities such as heart disease, diabetes, asthma, or kidney disease. The virus can trigger acute organ dysfunction and is a major driver of COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease) exacerbations, with influenza involvement reported around 31% in COPD patients. Across acute respiratory infections, influenza accounts for about 15%. Vaccination is presented as the most effective protection, reducing severity, hospitalizations, and mortality even if it does not fully prevent infection. Emphasis is placed on annual flu vaccination as a key preventive measure for vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: 似ているが異なる：インフルエンザは普通感冒よりも深刻な影響を持つ
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの健康リスクについての教育的記事であり、新規の感染症発生イベントやアウトブレイクの報告ではない。患者数、発生数、流行状況などの具体的な疫学データが記載されていない。
triage.notes: この記事はインフルエンザの臨床的特徴とワクチン接種の重要性についての一般向け啓発記事であり、具体的な患者数、死亡数、新規クラスター、または流行の拡大を示す疫学的データを含んでいない。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo khẩn loại virus lây truyền từ chuột
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health issues an urgent warning about a mouse-borne virus.
article.articleSummary: Urgent warning from the Vietnamese Ministry of Health about Hantavirus risk linked to mice. WHO reports a cluster of severe pneumonia on a cruise ship in the South Atlantic, after departing Argentina with 147 passengers. In early May, 7 pneumonia cases were reported on board, 2 confirmed for Hantavirus and 5 suspected; the outbreak caused 3 deaths and one patient in critical condition. No Vietnamese citizens were aboard. Hantavirus is a rodent-borne virus transmitted by bites or inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent excreta; cleaning dry areas or using vacuum can aerosolize the virus. Human-to-human transmission is rare; there is no specific antiviral treatment, only supportive care. Vietnam has not recorded Hantavirus cases, but rodent exposure remains a risk. Public health guidance urges avoiding barehanded rodent handling, securing food, daily waste disposal, sealing holes, and wearing protection when cleaning; seek medical care if symptoms appear after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がネズミ由来のウイルス伝播に関する緊急警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の警告が発出され、国際的な集団発生（南大西洋のクルーズ船）が報告されているが、ベトナムでの実際の患者発生は確認されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、主題はベトナム保健省による警告であり、ベトナムが対象国として該当する。ただし、実際のハンタウイルス集団発生はアルゼンチナ発のクルーズ船での南大西洋での事象であり、ベトナムでの確認患者はない。警告の対象は主にベトナムの住民への予防ガイダンスである。Bluedot APIが付与した他国（米国、アルゼンチン）についても地理的な言及があるが、記事の主題としてはベトナムの公衆衛生警告に焦点が当たっているため、verified_locationsはベトナムのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, Terduga Sumber Wabah di Kapal Pesiar, Dari Hutan ke Global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Suspected Source of Outbreak on a Cruise Ship, From Forest to Global.
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, hantavirus suspected aboard the cruise MV Hondius off Cabo Verde (West Africa) with three passenger deaths and at least three others in critical condition. Of 87 remaining passengers and 61 crew, two crew members exhibit severe respiratory symptoms. Blood tests confirmed hantavirus infection; one German national is among the deceased, with earlier deaths: a 70-year-old Dutch man on April 11 and his wife in South Africa. WHO has deployed a medical team; Cabo Verde authorities have refused port entry, exploring evacuation to the Canary Islands, Spain. WHO regards the incident as isolated, not a global outbreak. Transmission is via inhalation of aerosolized rodent excreta rather than direct contact, with rapid progression to pneumonia and acute respiratory distress syndrome in some cases. Rare human-to-human transmission noted for Andes virus. Background: US CDC reports 864 US cases (1993–2022; ~1/3 fatalities); Indonesia reported 10 cases by Aug 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：カボベルデ沖のクルーズ船での流行の疑われた原因、森から世界へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国での死亡者、国際的な支援体制の展開、メディア報道あり。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではハンタウイルス感染がカボベルデ沖のクルーズ船で疑われ、複数国籍者（ドイツ人、オランダ人）の死亡が報告されている。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはカボベルデ、スペイン、米国、南アフリカ、オランダ、ドイツが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドネシアのみ（背景情報として2025年8月までに10例報告と記載）。カボベルデ、スペイン、米国等での実際のイベントは対象国でないため除外した。クルーズ船での集団発症、複数死亡、国際的な展開、WHO対応という観点からはPICKUPの重大性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 命理師去年預言鼠患神準命中　泰國靈媒示警大規模致死傳染病 | 生活 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortune-teller's prediction of a rat plague last year proves uncannily accurate; Thai medium warns of a large-scale deadly infectious disease
article.articleSummary: Taipei faces a severe rat infestation around metro stations, raising public health concerns. The situation coincides with a late-2025 prediction by fortune teller Jian Shaonian, who warned that 2026 would bring rodent-related troubles and a possible infectious disease. Thai medium Mor Plai echoed alarms, describing 2026 as a Fire Horse year and forecasting a new virus by year’s end with features of tuberculosis and the Black Death, potentially causing large-scale fatalities. She gave the code HJT and urged avoidance of related locations in the first half of the year, citing airline-security risks and a possible aviation-related outbreak; speculation links spread to air travel and a lab-accident scenario involving an engineered ancient virus. Taiwan's CDC says current risk is low but travel vigilance remains; emphasize hand hygiene after animal contact, avoid ground-sourced or bat-bit fruits, and stay away from bat habitats, pig farms, and sick horses.

triage.headline_ja: 占い師の去年の鼠害の予言が驚くほど的中　タイの霊媒が大規模な致死性伝染病を警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主体が占い師やタイの霊媒による予言・警告であり、実際の感染症の流行報告ではない。台北のネズミ駆除は公衆衛生上の懸念だが、具体的な患者数や疾病確認がなく、疫学的根拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の大部分が占い師やタイの霊媒による予言的警告に基づいており、実際の感染症流行の証拠がない。台北のネズミ問題と香港・バット由来のウイルスリスク警告には公衆衛生的関心があるが、具体的な患者報告や疾病確認がなく、根拠が推測に頼っている。疾患名としてTuberculosisとPlagueが挙げられているが、これらは予言の内容であり、実際の診断例ではない。タイの霊媒による警告のみであり、タイでの実際の流行報告ではないため、タイは verified_locations に含めない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: La OMS confirma un segundo caso de hantavirus en el crucero y prepara la evacuación de dos tripulantes afectados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms a second hantavirus case on the cruise ship and is preparing the evacuation of two affected crew members.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization confirms a second hantavirus case linked to the expedition cruise MV Hondius, detained off Cape Verde, as Oceanwide Expeditions coordinates medical evacuation of two crew members with respiratory symptoms. Three deaths have occurred in this outbreak. No additional symptomatic cases have been identified to date; one person related to the passenger who died on May 2 is noted in ongoing investigations. The ship carries 149 people (88 passengers, 61 crew) from 23 nationalities, including 14 Spaniards, 38 Filipino crew, 23 British, and 17 American travelers. A port of disembarkation is under consideration, Las Palmas or Tenerife. WHO reports ongoing investigations, new lab analyses, and epidemiological work. Hantavirus infections are linked to environmental exposure to rodent urine or feces and can cause severe respiratory disease, though human-to-human transmission is rare. The Hondius’ voyage departed Argentina on March 20, with a route including Antarctica, the Falklands, South Georgia, Nightingale Island, and Tristan da Cunha.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが船上の2番目のハンタウイルス症例を確認し、患者の乗員2名の避難準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: 国際クルーズ船での複数死亡を伴うハンタウイルス集団発生であり、IHR基準3つ（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。23か国の乗客・乗員が関与し、WHOの公式確認と医療避難対応がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数国を「発生地域」として返していますが、記事サマリーの主題は「ケープベルデ沖に停泊中の国際遠洋探検クルーズ船MV Hondiusでの集団発生」です。乗客・乗員は23か国籍から構成されており、フィリピン国籍の乗員38名が関与しています。船の寄港地はスペイン領カナリア諸島（ラスパルマスまたはテネリフェ）が検討中ですが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはフィリピンのみとしました。陸上での実際の集団発生確認がないため、他の国は含めていません。3名の死亡、呼吸器症状の乗員2名が医療避難対象となっており、重大度・緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Sejarah Hantavirus, dari Perang Korea Kini Mewabah di Kapal Pesiar |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: History of Hantavirus, from the Korean War to the Current Outbreak on Cruise Ships | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: Three passengers aboard the luxury cruise MV Hondius have died and several others are critically ill amid a suspected hantavirus exposure on a voyage from Ushuaia, Argentina, south toward Cape Verde off West Africa. The outbreak before confirmation is attributed to hantavirus, a rodent-borne virus known to cause severe fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, and organ involvement; transmission is linked to dust from dried rodent droppings and urine encountered in open, outdoor settings. Historically, hantavirus has been documented in records from China dating to the first millennium CE and caused outbreaks among UN troops in the Korean War (1951–1954), with hundreds of deaths and about 3,200 infections. The virus was later identified in 1978 in a field mouse near the Hantan River in South Korea, which led to the name Hantavirus. The current cruise case emphasizes rodent-associated exposure as the likely source, pending laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの歴史：朝鮮戦争からクルーズ船での流行へ｜Republika Online
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な影響：複数死亡と重症者、異常・予想外：クルーズ船での集団発生、国際的拡大リスク：複数国を航行する船舶）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: クルーズ船（MV Hondius）はアルゼンチン（ウシュアイア）からカーボベルデへの航海中の発生。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアルゼンチン、アンゴラ、カーボベルデ、韓国、中国が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのは中国のみ。記事の主要な現在の事象はクルーズ船（国際水域）での発生であり、特定国での限定的な発生ではない。ただし、歴史的背景（中国、朝鮮戦争）が言及されている。現在の船舶での集団発生（3名死亡、複数重症）と国際的な移動が高リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒進入好發期　疾管署：4重症與去年同期相當｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses Enter Peak Season; Taiwan CDC: Four Critical Cases Similar to Last Year’s Same Period | Yipin News Network
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Taiwan reports enteroviruses at peak season with four critical cases in the year’s comparable period. In the last four weeks, laboratory surveillance shows community activity dominated by Coxsackievirus A6, followed by Coxsackievirus A4. Cumulatively, there are two EV-D68 cases and one each of Coxsackie A4 and A16—similar to last year, but higher than 2022–2024 (0–3). The Taiwan CDC urges heightened vigilance for infants and preschool children. Internationally, neighboring countries show rising activity: Vietnam has over 34,400 cases with eight deaths, mainly EV71 and concentrated in the south; China and Singapore also trending up; Japan, Thailand, and Korea at modest increases; Hong Kong down. Preventive measures include handwashing and regular disinfection, and keeping sick children home. Among under-fives, warning signs include drowsiness, confusion, limb weakness, persistent vomiting, and rapid breathing—seek urgent medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒進入好發期　疾管署：4重症與去年同期相當
triage.triage_reason: 複数の東南アジア・東アジア地域でエンテロウイルス71（EV71）を含む腸病毒が同時多発的に流行しており、ベトナムでは8名の死亡を含む34,400件以上の症例が報告されている。国際的な地域流行の兆候があり、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数に該当し、公衆衛生上の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されている主要な発生地はベトナム（8死亡、34,400+症例）、中国、シンガポール、タイ、香港、日本、韓国。対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナム、中国、タイのみ。香港はChinaに含める。台湾はサマリーで症例報告の主体だが対象国リストに非含。EV71はWHO注視病原体であり、特にベトナムでの死亡例を伴う急速な増加が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ویروسی که عامل ۲ بیماری شدید است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus that is the causative agent of two severe diseases.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirmed three deaths from a suspected hantavirus outbreak on the cruise ship MV Hondius in the Central Atlantic, en route to Cape Verde. One laboratory-confirmed hantavirus case has been reported aboard, with five additional suspected cases under investigation. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne and spread mainly by inhaling aerosolized rodent excreta; bites or scratches are rare. The virus can cause two severe illnesses: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), which begins with fatigue, fever and myalgia and may progress to respiratory failure (CDC notes about 38% mortality with respiratory involvement); and Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS), primarily affecting the kidneys and potentially causing shock or kidney failure. Globally, about 150,000 HFRS cases occur annually, mainly in Europe and Asia; China reports notable activity. In the US, 890 hantavirus cases have been recorded since 1993. Seoul virus, carried by Norway rats, is found worldwide including the US. CDC urges supportive care and rodent-exposure prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 2つの重篤な疾患の原因となるウイルス
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船での集団発生、死亡事例3件、確定症例1件、疑い例5件の報告。閉鎖環境での複数国への国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認される。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: イベントは大西洋上のクルーズ船MV Hondiusで発生。複数国への寄港予定（Cape Verde向け）のため国際的拡大リスクが高い。記事ではChinaの継続的なハンタウイルス活動に言及されている。Bluedotが付与したCabo Verdeは記事サマリーでは具体的な患者報告がないため除外。米国（対象国外）での過去の事例言及は対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 腦脊髓膜炎升溫創9年新高！30多歲男發燒胸悶確診  疾管署：「2類人」最危險 | 生活 | Newtalk新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis hits a nine-year high; man in his 30s diagnosed after fever and chest tightness, Taiwan CDC says "Two Types of People" are most at risk | Life | Newtalk News
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports 7 confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases in 2026, a nine-year high. Case 1: a 1‑month‑old male infant in southern Taiwan with fever and poor feeding; Neisseria meningitidis confirmed; four household members received chemoprophylaxis; postnatal care home contacts monitored through Apr 29 with no symptoms. Case 2: a man in his 30s in central Taiwan with fever, cough, chest tightness and dyspnea around Apr 26–28; lab-confirmed Neisseria meningitidis. One close contact asymptomatic; authorities provided education and monitoring. Seven cases this year exceed the 2017–2025同期 range (0–6). Over the past decade, ages 25–64 are most affected; serogroup B is most common. Global context notes Africa’s meningitis belt peak with 22 countries and 6,929 suspected cases and 340 deaths; Vietnam and Western countries report rises; Hajj season may pose risk. Transmission is via close contact or respiratory secretions; 5–10% of people may be asymptomatic carriers. Preventive measures: avoid crowded places and practice hand/respiratory hygiene; infants under 1 year are high risk.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎が9年ぶりの高水準に上昇！30代男性が発熱と胸痛で確診　疾管署：「2種類の人」が最も危険
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の9年ぶりの高い確認件数（7件）と、アフリカのメニンジティスベルト地域での大規模発生（22か国、疑い例6,929件、死亡340件）が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）を満たし、ベトナムでの増加も報告されているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはAfricaとTaiwanも記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはVietnamのみ。記事は台湾での9年ぶりの高い症例数と、アフリカメニンジティスベルトの大規模発生、ベトナムの上昇傾向を報告している。ハッジシーズンのリスクも言及されており、国際的な拡大懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: O que é o hantavírus, que causou mortes em cruzeiro | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is hantavirus, which caused deaths on a cruise ship | G1
article.articleSummary: Three deaths on the cruise ship MV Hondius, which left Argentina for Cabo Verde, are under investigation by the World Health Organization for a hantavirus outbreak; WHO says there is no need for panic or travel restrictions, and the general public risk remains low. Hantavirus is carried mainly by wild rodents; humans typically become infected by inhaling particles from rodent urine, feces, or saliva, especially in enclosed spaces. Person-to-person transmission is rare but has occurred in Argentina and Chile with Andes hantavirus. The virus can cause two major diseases: hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (Europe/Asia) and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (Americas). HPS is severe and often fatal; symptoms appear 1–8 weeks after infection and progress from flu-like illness to shortness of breath and respiratory failure. There is no specific treatment; care is supportive. In Brazil, hantavirus infections are mostly rural, with 1,386 confirmed cases and 540 deaths (2007–2024).

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船での死亡を引き起こしたハンタウイルスとは | G1
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症による死亡例が複数報告され、WHOが調査中。国際的な輸送手段（クルーズ船）での発生で、複数国への拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: イベントはアルゼンチン発カボベルデ行きのクルーズ船MV Hondius上で発生。アルゼンチン、チリ、カボベルデは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ブラジルは記事内でハンタウイルス感染の流行統計が記載されているため含める。WHOが既に調査を開始し、パニックや渡航制限は不要とコメントしているが、死亡症例の存在と国際輸送での発生という要素で PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam chưa ghi nhận trường hợp mắc bệnh do virus Hanta trên người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam has not yet recorded any human cases of Hantavirus infection.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam has not recorded any human Hantavirus infections to date. As of May 4, 2026, WHO notes a cluster of severe acute respiratory illness on an international cruise ship traveling from Argentina via the South Atlantic, with seven cases: two confirmed Hantavirus infections and five suspected; three deaths, one in critical condition, three mild. Hantavirus can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome; incubation is about 2–4 weeks (up to 8). Symptoms begin with fever, chills, headache, and myalgia, followed by cough, chest tightness, dyspnea, and fatigue; no specific antiviral treatment exists, only supportive care. Transmission is mainly rodent-borne via urine, feces, or saliva; dry rodent dust can be aerosolized; human-to-human transmission is rare but reported. Vietnam’s Department of Disease Prevention continues to monitor with WHO and issue guidance. Preventive measures: avoid direct contact with rodents; wet-clean areas; wear gloves and masks; ventilate; wash hands; seal entry points; store food; seek care if exposure symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、ハンタウイルス感染症の人間への症例を未だ報告していない
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はベトナムにおけるハンタウイルス感染症の未報告事例の公式声明であり、実際の流行イベントではなく予防的監視情報。ただし国際クルーズ船でのアウトブレイク（7例、2確認例、3死亡）が記述されており、続報によっては国際的拡大のリスク評価が必要。現段階では情報不足のため経過観察判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はベトナムにおけるハンタウイルス感染症の未報告状況だが、アルゼンチナ発の国際クルーズ船でのクラスター（2確認例、5疑似例、3死亡）に言及されている。発生地域にArgentineRepublic が含まれるが、記事の焦点はベトナムの予防的対応であり、実際の流行イベントはクルーズ船（発生国不特定だが南大西洋経由）での報告。IHR基準3項目該当し、WPRO基準3項目該当するが、ベトナムでの実際の患者報告なく、関連する詳細情報不足のため「WATCH」と判定。クルーズ船での感染確認が確定的でないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: कितना खतरनाक है लग्जरी क्रूज पर फैला हंता वायरस, जिसने ले ली तीन लोगों की जान?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How dangerous is the hantavirus that has spread on a luxury cruise and claimed the lives of three people?
article.articleSummary: On the luxury cruise MV Hondius in the Atlantic Ocean, hantavirus infection has raised alarms: three deaths, one confirmed case, and five suspected cases under investigation by the WHO. Hantaviruses, carried by rodents, infect humans when inhaled particles from dried urine, droppings, or saliva enter the air; there is no direct human-to-human transmission typically. Globally, thousands are affected annually; Hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) accounts for about 150,000 cases yearly, mainly in China, while the US reports about 890 cases from 1993–2023. Seoul virus is found in many regions. No specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive—oxygen, ventilation, and, in severe cases, dialysis and ICU care. A February 2025 case linked Betsy Arakawa’s hantavirus-related respiratory illness, with rodent nests near home. Preventive measures include reducing rodent access, sealing entry points, and using masks/gloves during cleaning; enclosed cruise environments hinder control.

triage.headline_ja: 高級クルーズ船で発生したハンタウイルス、3人の死亡者を含む危機的状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度高、流行しやすい環境、管理可能性の懸念）。国際的なクルーズ船での多数死亡者とWHO関与のため、フルRRA必要。
triage.notes: クルーズ船MV Hondiusは大西洋上で国際的な移動体であるが、記事サマリーでは米国内の事例（Betsy Arakawa 2025年2月）と中国の疾病統計が示唆されている。発生地域にUSAが含まれるが、サマリーの主要内容はクルーズ船でのアウトブレイク（発生国明示なし）と中国でのHFRS統計に集中。クルーズ船乗客の国籍等詳細不明のため、確認できる発生地は中国のみとした。WHO関与と3死亡者の報告により緊急性高い。

article.articleHeadline: ไข้กาฬหลังแอ่นยังต้องจับตา ผู้ป่วยเพิ่มในหลายประเทศ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis remains a concern as cases rise in several countries.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) remains a concern in Vietnam and Thailand as cases rise in early 2026. Vietnam reports 24 cases and 4 deaths, with 46% under age 15, up from the previous year; authorities pursue proactive control, including area cleaning/disinfection, public hygiene campaigns, and prompt testing and treatment, underscoring vaccination as the most effective prevention. In Thailand, 5 cases and 3 deaths (case fatality rate 60%) were recorded in 2026, predominantly among children aged 0–4, with other affected ages including 20–29 and 40–49. The disease can progress rapidly to meningitis or septicemia, causing long-term disabilities such as hearing loss or limb loss. Transmission occurs via droplets and close contact; protective measures include vaccination, strict personal hygiene, avoiding contact with ill individuals, and mask use in crowded settings. Vigilant surveillance continues to prevent wider outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が懸念事項のまま、複数国での患者数増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目が該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響）。WPROスクリーニング基準では全5項目が該当し、死亡を含む重症事例が報告されている。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は急速な進行と高い致死率が特徴。ベトナムで24例4死（致死率16.7%）、タイで5例3死（致死率60%）が報告されており、タイの致死率は特に高い。小児（15歳以下）と0-4歳児が主な被害層。ドロップレット感染・密接接触による伝播リスクが高く、複数国での同時発生が確認されている。当該地域における公衆衛生対応が実施されており、国際的な監視継続が必要。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: Ce este lepra? Iată cum se transmite și cât de periculoasă este!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is leprosy? Here's how it is transmitted and how dangerous it is!
article.articleSummary: Hansen’s disease (leprosy) is a chronic infection caused by Mycobacterium leprae and Mycobacterium lepromatosis that primarily affects the skin, peripheral nerves, nasal mucosa, and eyes. It is curable, but progresses slowly: incubation lasts 3–20 years, and infection can be asymptomatic for 3–5 years. Without treatment, it can cause permanent disabilities and facial or skin deformities; modern therapy is effective and free. Transmission is believed to occur via inhalation of droplets from an untreated person, and through prolonged close contact; casual contact, sexual activity, and in utero transmission do not spread it. Most people retain natural immunity—about 5% are susceptible, ~95% are resistant. Armadillos can harbor the disease and have transmitted it in the southern United States and Mexico. Ongoing transmission is reported in Africa (DRC, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Mozambique, Nigeria, Tanzania), Asia (Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Myanmar, Nepal, Philippines, Sri Lanka), and Brazil in the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病とは何か？その感染経路と危険性について
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は治療可能で感染性も限定的（密接な接触が必要）であり、深刻な公衆衛生危機を示唆する新規情報ではない。記事は疾患の一般的な啓発が主目的と見られる。
triage.notes: 記事はハンセン病の一般的な医学情報提供が主目的（ルーマニア語ソースの医学啓発記事）。現在の流行状況や新規患者の急増に関する具体的な報告はなく、既知の地域分布を述べているのみ。長期曝露の可能性は存在するが、疾患の性質上、管理可能性は高い。WPROスクリーニング基準1つのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Should India worry? Cruise ship stranded in Atlantic after 3 deaths, WHO confirms hantavirus cases- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus cases and five suspected infections have been identified aboard the Dutch-operated cruise ship MV Hondius stranded off Cape Verde in the mid-Atlantic, with three deaths reported. As of 4 May 2026, one patient is critically ill, three have mild symptoms, and three have been evacuated while four remain on board. The vessel, carrying about 150 passengers and crew, departed Ushuaia, Argentina on 1 April and was en route to Antarctica and South Atlantic destinations when docking was refused over public health concerns. WHO coordinates risk assessments; a medical team has visited the ship and evacuations to South Africa have occurred; one evacuated individual tested positive and remains in critical condition. Hantavirus is typically rodent-borne; human-to-human transmission is rare, and the outbreak source is under investigation. India has had only sporadic hantavirus cases historically, with no major outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インドは心配すべき？3人の死亡後、大西洋で立ち往生している豪華客船、WHOがハンタウイルス感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性と国際的な拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（死亡3件を含む）と流行しやすさ（船舶内での感染）が該当。WPRo基準2つ以上該当し、社会的関心も高い国際的な感染症クラスターであるため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には多くの不正確な場所が含まれている（Antarctica、Greater Antarctica、Cabo Verdeなど）。記事の主題は南米アルゼンチン（ウシュアイア発）から大西洋を経由してケープベルデ沖で発生したクルーズ船のハンタウイルスクラスターで、患者の南アフリカへの疏開と、インドが懸念される記事タイトルという構成。対象国リストではインドのみが該当するが、実際の感染症イベントはアルゼンチン発のクルーズ船であり、対象国外での発生である。ただし記事がインドの懸念を名指しで言及しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルであるため、PICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Πρόεδρος ΕΟΔΥ για χανταϊό: Πόσο εύκολα μεταδίδεται, οι δύο επικίνδυνες ασθένειες που προκαλεί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: President of EODY on hantavirus: How easily it spreads, the two dangerous diseases it causes.
article.articleSummary: Hantaviruses are rodent-borne viruses with two main human diseases: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) in the Americas, which can cause severe respiratory illness with a fatality around 38%, and Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS), mainly in Europe, affecting the kidneys and risking shock. Transmission is usually by inhaling dried rodent urine, droppings, or saliva; human-to-human spread is extremely rare and debated. A hantavirus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship was noted, but officials say the overall risk is very low. Globally, about 150,000 HFRS cases occur annually, mainly in Europe and Asia (China), while the US recorded 890 cases from 1993–2023. No specific antiviral treatment exists; care is supportive (oxygen, ventilation, dialysis in severe cases). Prevention focuses on avoiding rodent contact, sealing entry points, and PPE during cleanup. A February 2025 death of Betsy Arakawa was linked to hantavirus.

triage.headline_ja: EODY会長がハンタウイルスについて語る：感染の容易さ、それが引き起こす2つの危険な疾患
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症は高い致命率（HPS 38%）を示す重篤な疾患であり、複数の基準で該当するが、現在の情報では具体的な流行規模や国内での集団発生の詳細が不明であり、公式なリスク評価が「全体的に非常に低い」とされているため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にハンタウイルスの一般的な情報と公衆衛生当局（EODY - ギリシャ）の公式見解を提示している。大西洋クルーズ船でのアウトブレイク言及があるが、具体的な患者数や拡大状況の詳細は不明。対象国ではスペイン（カナリア諸島）とアメリカが地理的に含まれているが、記事の主題上、HFRS流行地域として明示されているのは中国とヨーロッパ地域であり、対象国リストから中国のみ該当。今後の患者報告と地域的拡大を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 台北爆鼠患「用吃來解決」？中國禁菜竟生吞鼠寶寶　殘忍過程曝光 | 兩岸(大陸) | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taipei Hit by Rat Infestation: "Solve It by Eating"? China's Banned Delicacy Allegedly Devours Baby Rats Alive — Cruel Process Exposed | Cross-Strait (Mainland China) | SETN.COM
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-05, Taipei faces a severe rat infestation with public health implications. Rumors link the nuisance to a controversial Mainland Chinese delicacy, 'Three Squeaks' (also known as 'Three-crying mice'), which serves newborn rats alive, sometimes glazed with honey; the practice has been banned as a Chinese top-ten forbidden dish. Historical records describe 'honey-glazed roasted mice' as a delicacy. The piece cautions that wild rats carry viruses, bacteria, and parasites, and cooking cannot fully eliminate infection risks. To address rodent problems, authorities advocate a 'Three No's' policy: no entry of rats, no rat habitation, and no rat consumption. Additional measures include eliminating food sources, and employing targeted baiting with strict record-keeping to prevent environmental contamination or accidental ingestion. The report underscores health risks amid Taipei’s rodent outbreak and stresses preventive actions.

triage.headline_ja: 台北のネズミ大量発生：「食べて解決」？中国の禁止料理がネズミの赤ちゃんを生きたまま食べる――残忍なプロセスが明かされた
triage.triage_reason: ネズミ駆除・食文化に関する報道であり、感染症イベント（公衆衛生の具体的なアウトブレイク）としての条件を満たしていない。「未確認疾患」の分類は不適切で、感染症の患者発生、流行の証拠、死亡、入院などの具体的な公衆衛生被害の記載がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾（対象国外）でのネズミ駆除および食文化に関する報道であり、対象監視地域に該当しない。Bluedot APIが中国を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは中国での現在の感染症アウトブレイクを示す具体的証拠がなく、歴史的記録と禁止食文化の言及のみ。感染症イベントとしての定義（患者集積、流行、死亡等）を満たさないため、シグナルとして識別しない。

article.articleHeadline: Македонија во топ пет земји со највисоки стапки на смртност од Ковид 19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Macedonia among the top five countries with the highest mortality rates from COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: North Macedonia ranks among the world's top five by COVID-19 mortality rate per million population, at about 5,429 deaths per million as of February 22, 2026, behind Peru (6,603) and Bulgaria (5,681) but ahead of Bosnia and Herzegovina (5,123) and Hungary (5,072). Globally, the pandemic has resulted in 7,111,356 confirmed deaths and 779.2 million cases as of 12 April 2026, with two major waves in 2022 and weekly deaths peaking in January 2021 (~103,000) and May 2021 (~96,000). By late 2023, 67% of the world population had completed the primary vaccination series; vaccination in Europe reduced mortality by at least 57% and saved over 1.4 million lives, with 14.4 million deaths prevented globally by Sep 2023. In total deaths, the United States leads (~1.24 million), followed by Brazil, India, Russia, and Mexico; North Macedonia is among the top five per million, illustrating the ongoing unequal burden.

triage.headline_ja: 北マケドニア、COVID-19死亡率で世界トップ5の国の一つ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行疾患であり、2026年5月時点での死亡率統計レポートは公衆衛生上の新規シグナルを示していない。新規の異常事象、重症度の急激な変化、または管理上の課題を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は北マケドニアにおけるCOVID-19の累積死亡率統計を報告しているもので、新規の感染症イベントや危機的な状況を示していない。記事に言及されている複数国（ペルー、ハンガリー、ボスニア・ヘルツェゴビナ、ロシア、メキシコ）は評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、対象国はインドとブラジルのみ。両国とも新規シグナルの対象ではない。

United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Two Hantavirus Cases Confirmed, Five Suspected On Cruise Ship, Says WHO
article.articleSummary: Two hantavirus cases have been laboratory-confirmed and five suspected among passengers and crew on the MV Hondius off Cape Verde, bringing the total to seven cases with three deaths as of 4 May 2026. Illness onset occurred 6–28 April 2026 during a cruise from Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde. The first deaths were a Dutch couple: the husband died on board April 11; his wife disembarked in St Helena with his body, flew to Johannesburg on 25 April, and died on 26 April. PCR confirmation was reported on 4 May, with contact tracing for the Saint Helena–Johannesburg flight initiated. The 147-person ship carries passengers from Britain, Spain and the United States, and crew from the Philippines, across 23 nationalities. A British passenger is in intensive care in Johannesburg; two crew (British and Dutch) require urgent care; four remain on board, including a German who died. WHO assesses global risk as low and will continue monitoring. Hantavirus is primarily rodent-borne, with possible human-to-human transmission reported previously.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船でハンタウイルス2例確認、5例疑い - WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な旅客輸送中の複数国籍者への感染、複数死亡、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限の可能性を満たすため、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: クルーズ船MV Hondiusの乗客乗員は23国籍で、アルゼンチャ発、ケープベルデ経由、複数国での医療対応と接触者追跡が進行中。フィリピンはクルー乗船国として記事に明記されている。WHOは全世界的リスクを低いと評価しているが、複数死亡と国際的な医療対応の複雑性から、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi bị dại tấn công 12 người ở Lâm Đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog suspected of rabies attacks 12 people in Lâm Đồng.
article.articleSummary: Rabies suspected after a feral dog attacked 12 people in Phuoc Hoi Ward, Lam Dong Province, Vietnam (La Gi area, formerly Binh Thuan Province). On May 3 the dog appeared at the local fishing port and assaulted residents, then fled and bit more. By May 4 the dog was restrained and killed by residents and authorities; initial assessment indicates it may be rabid. Public health guidance urges vaccination of pets, keeping dogs from roaming, and muzzle use in public, while minimizing contact with stray dogs and cats. For bite injuries, wounds should be washed with soap and clean water for 15 minutes, then disinfected and medical care sought promptly for rabies vaccination and immunoglobulin. A separate report notes a roaming dog in Son Tinh, Quang Ngai Province, confirmed rabies, prompting outbreak containment and prevention actions.

triage.headline_ja: ラム・ドン省で狂犬病が疑われる犬が12人を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの狂犬病関連イベント（犬の攻撃と疑い例）として認識されるが、IHR基準の2つ以上該当が確認できず、また国際的な拡大リスク・渡航制限のリスクは明確でない。追加情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムの複数地域（ラム・ドン省、クアン・ガイ省）で狂犬病関連イベントが報告されている。ラム・ドン省では5月3日に野犬が12人を襲撃し、その後射殺・検査中。クアン・ガイ州では別の野犬から狂犬病が確認されている。死亡数や重症者数が記事では不明であるため、重症度評価は限定的。公衆衛生対応は開始されているが、国際的拡大リスクは現時点では低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD Rohil Tinggi, 3 Pasien Meninggal, Camat Bangko: Gencarkan Gotong Royong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Dengue Fever Cases in Rohil, 3 Die, Bangko District Head: Step Up Mutual Cooperation.
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, dengue fever cases in Rokan Hilir Regency, Indonesia total 244, with Bangko District recording the highest at 35 cases and three deaths. The Rohil Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Rohil) convened a meeting with Bangko Camat Aspri Mulya and two Puskesmas to plan containment. The Camat urged broad community participation, asking Datuk Penghulu and Lurah to intensify gotong royong and environmental clean-up, noting not all residents join such efforts. He also urged residents to report suspected dengue cases to local leaders so they can coordinate with Puskesmas and the health office to conduct fogging in affected locations. Given limited district resources, Datuk Penghulu and Lurah will liaise with Puskesmas and Dinas Kesehatan to implement fogging as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ロカン・ヒリル県（Rohil）のデング熱患者数が高い、3名が死亡、バンコ郡長：相互扶助を強化する
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのロカン・ヒリル県で244例のデング熱患者が報告され、うち3名の死亡が確認されている。IHR基準（異常性・重症度）とWPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、地域的な対応強化が進行中であるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ロカン・ヒリル県（Rohil）のバンコ郡における局地的なデング熱集団発生を報告。2026年4月時点で244例の患者と3名の死亡が確認され、郡レベルでの公衆衛生対応（fogging、住民参加の推進）が進行中。ベクター対策と環境対策が実施されているが、限定的な資源の制約が示唆されている。インドネシアはデング熱の風土病地域であり、シーズン的な季節変動が予想される中での報告である。

article.articleHeadline: BGN Ungkap Penyebab Keracunan MBG di Anambas, Ditemukan Boraks dan E. coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BGN Reveals the Cause of MBG Poisoning in the Anambas Islands, Borax and E. coli Found.
article.articleSummary: Borax and Escherichia coli contamination were confirmed in meals from Indonesia’s Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG) served in Air Asuk, Kepulauan Anambas, Riau Islands. The incident occurred on 15 April 2026, affecting 115 students from PAUD to SMP, with 41 parents/relatives who consumed leftover food. Rapid testing initially indicated issues; subsequent laboratory analyses showed borax contamination in samples from the Natuna Health Office (ranging 100–5,000 mg) and E. coli presence detected by BPOM. Rapid test results were available 15 April, with formal lab confirmations received 28 April 2026. The exact source of water and food contamination remains under investigation. BGN will tighten oversight of the Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) in Air Asuk, which is closed until it updates the Sertifikasi Laik Higiene Sanitasi (SLHS). Meals reportedly originated from a single supplier and were distributed to several schools.

triage.headline_ja: BGN（インドネシア保健省）がアナンバス島でのMBG中毒の原因を明らかに、ホウ砂と大腸菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 食品汚染による集団食中毒イベント。115人の学生と41人の大人が影響を受け、ホウ砂と大腸菌の二重汚染が確認された。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: インドネシアの学校給食プログラム(MBG)における化学物質(ホウ砂)と微生物(大腸菌)の複合汚染。記事では157人（学生115人+保護者等41人）が影響を受けたことが明記されている。汚染源の追跡調査が進行中で、当該施設は衛生認証取得まで閉鎖予定。公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: " Sept cas, dont trois décès " : l'OMS alerte sur le navire bloqué au Cap-Vert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Seven cases, including three deaths": WHO warns about the ship stranded off Cape Verde.
article.articleSummary: Seven hantavirus cases tied to the MV Hondius, a cruise ship stranded off Cape Verde, with three deaths as of May 4, 2026. Of seven cases (two laboratory-confirmed, five suspected), onset occurred April 6–28 during an Ushuaia–to–Cape Verde crossing. Symptoms began with fever and gastrointestinal illness and progressed to pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome, and shock. WHO investigations are ongoing and the global risk is considered low. Three cases are no longer on the ship; four remain aboard, including a German patient who died on Saturday. A British passenger was in intensive care in Johannesburg; two crew members (British and Dutch) require urgent care. Passengers hailed from the UK, Spain, and the USA; crew from the Philippines. The infection is hantavirus, typically transmitted via rodent urine, feces, or saliva, with occasional human-to-human transmission; a flight from Saint Helena to Johannesburg on April 25 prompted PCR confirmation on May 4 and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 「7例、その中に3例の死亡」：WHO、カーボベルデ沖に停滞している船舶について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡を含む重症例、異常性：国際航海中のアウトブレイク、国際拡大リスク：複数国籍の患者・乗員、渡航制限リスク：船舶隔離）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）。国際的な注目も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカーボベルデ沖の船舶でのハンタウイルスアウトブレイクだが、カーボベルデは対象国リストに含まれていない。実際の患者発症地はウシュアイア（アルゼンチン）からカーボベルデ航路の船上、検査確認地はケープタウン（南アフリカ）およびヨハネスブルグ。乗員にはフィリピン国籍が含まれるため、フィリピンを verified_locations に含める。発生地域リストに含まれるその他の国（南アフリカ、アルゼンチン、米国、英国、スペイン等）は対象国リストに該当しないため除外。この事案は国際的な船舶検疫・公衆衛生対応を伴う重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Spurensuche in der Bronzezeit: Wie Tierkrankheiten zum Menschen kamen | MDR.DE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tracking down clues in the Bronze Age: How animal diseases reached humans.
article.articleSummary: Most infectious diseases today originate from animals. An international research team led by the Berlin Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology identified the Eurasian Bronze Age as a pivotal era for this cross-species transmission. By analyzing more than 300 animal samples, scientists succeeded in isolating ancient pathogen DNA and tracing the origins of prehistoric zoonoses back as far as 5,000 years. The study highlights how interactions between humans and animals during the Eurasian Bronze Age facilitated the emergence of infectious diseases that continue to impact populations. The work demonstrates the value of ancient DNA analysis in reconstructing long-term pathogen evolution across Eurasia and underscores the deep-rooted connection between animal reservoirs and human health.

triage.headline_ja: 青銅器時代の痕跡探索：動物の病気がどのように人間に伝わったか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は5,000年前の青銅器時代の古代病原体に関する歴史的・考古学的研究報告であり、現在進行中の感染症発生イベントではない。現代的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事象ではなく、学術的な回顧分析である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域としてThailandおよびGermanyを付与しているが、記事は古代考古学的研究に関する学術論文紹介であり、現在の感染症イベントの発生地ではない。現代における進行中の感染症事象は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo khẩn sau vụ 3 người tử vong do virus Hanta trên tàu du lịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health issues urgent warning after three people die from Hantavirus on a cruise ship.
article.articleSummary: May 5, 2026: Vietnam's Ministry of Health issued an urgent warning after hantavirus deaths on a cruise ship traveling from Argentina. WHO reported a cluster of seven illnesses on board, two confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases; three deaths, one patient in critical condition, three with mild symptoms. The ship carried 147 people (88 passengers, 59 crew) from 23 nationalities; no Vietnamese cases were reported. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne, primarily transmitted via urine, feces, or saliva; inhalation of contaminated dust is a key risk. Human-to-human transmission is rare. Incubation is typically 2–4 weeks, up to 8 weeks. Early symptoms include fever, chills, headache, dizziness, myalgia, nausea, vomiting; progression can cause chest tightness, dyspnea, hypotension, and death. No specific antiviral therapy exists; treatment is supportive. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with rodents, wet-cleaning dusty areas, wearing gloves and masks, hand washing, rodent-proofing homes, and reporting exposure if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症で3人が死亡したクルーズ船でベトナムの保健省が緊急警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な輸送手段での集団発生、複数国籍者への曝露、死亡を含む重症例の存在、および複数の確認・疑い例がIHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの保健省による緊急警告が主題であり、クルーズ船はアルゼンチン発だが、対象国リストではベトナムのみが該当。23ヶ国籍の乗客が含まれており国際的な拡大リスクが高い。ハンタウイルスの人間への感染は稀だが、クルーズ船という密閉空間での集団発生であり、密接接触環境での感染リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS a confirmat două cazuri de hantavirus pe nava de croazieră pe care au murit trei oameni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has confirmed two cases of hantavirus on the cruise ship where three people died.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms two hantavirus cases aboard the MV Hondius cruise (Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde). As of May 4, 2026, seven cases identified (two lab-confirmed, five suspected), with three deaths, one critical patient, and three with mild symptoms. Symptoms include fever, gastrointestinal illness, rapid progression to pneumonia, ARDS and shock; investigations are ongoing. The ship carries 147 people from multiple nationalities, including passengers from Britain, Spain and United States, with crew from the Philippines. Three cases were no longer on board; four remained aboard, including a German national who died on Saturday. First deaths involved a Dutch couple: husband died aboard April 11; wife fell ill after deboarding at Saint Helena to accompany him, worsened during a flight to Johannesburg on April 25, and died April 26. May 4, PCR confirmed hantavirus in this case; contact tracing was launched for Saint Helena–Johannesburg flight. WHO assesses risk as low; monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がハンタウイルス感染を確認した客船内で 3 人が死亡 - 2 例が確定、5 例が疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国籍の乗客・乗組員が関与する国際クルーズ船での集団感染で、3 人の死亡と急速な進行（肺炎、ARDS、ショック）が報告されている。ハンタウイルス感染症は重症度が高く、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 国際クルーズ船（MV Hondius）でのハンタウイルス集団感染。アルゼンチャ（ウシュアイア出発地）とフィリピン（乗組員）が対象国に該当。記事に列挙されている複数国籍の乗客（英国、スペイン、米国）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加していない。死亡率が高く（3 死亡、4 人が船上に残存）、急速な進行が特徴。WHOのリスク評価は「低」とされているが、国際輸送手段での感染拡大リスクと複数国への接触者追跡（セントヘレナ-ヨハネスブルク間フライト）が必要なため、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies claims fourth child in Maun " TheVoiceBW
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Maun, Botswana, has claimed four children since February, the latest a four-year-old girl from Riverside Ward bitten by a dog. The crisis has prompted emergency government sessions as authorities strive to contain spread. New anti-rabies vaccines arrived, but officials say 93 doses are far from sufficient for Maun’s estimated 15,000 dogs, including about 7,000 strays. To curb transmission, a culling operation is underway; about 191 animals have been culled and 8,000 vaccinated so far, with pace hampered by transport shortages. A cross-species transmission signal emerged after a cow in the Mawana area outside Maun was culled following rabies signs; officials suspect scavenging from infected dog carcasses. The Minister of Health, Dr. Stephen Modise, held a late-afternoon technical meeting and was set to meet district leadership on April 30 to address the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病、マウンで4人目の子どもの命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: ボツワナのマウンにおける狂犬病アウトブレイク。2月以来4人の子どもが死亡し、異種間感染シグナル（牛への感染疑い）も出現。政府の緊急対応と国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与したIndiaはサマリー内に明示的な言及がなく、Uttar Pradesh/Mawanaはボツワナのマウン近郊エリア（Mawana）の誤地名参照と考えられる。実際のアウトブレイク発生地はボツワナ（対象国リストに非含）のマウンであり、verified_locationsは空配列となる。ただしIHR基準2項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）かつWPRO基準5項目該当、政府・公衆の関心が高いため、シグナルとしてピックアップする。

article.articleHeadline: Hiszpania walczy z groźną chorobą. Nowe ograniczenia i wielomilionowe wsparcie - Trzoda chlewna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spain fights a dangerous disease. New restrictions and multi-million euro support - Swine.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak in Catalonia, Spain triggers tighter controls. In Castellbisbal, Barcelona province, the risk area expands from 18 to 19 municipalities around Barcelona, with a full ban on forest entry enforced across the region, including the regional capital. Nine people were fined for entering restricted zones; Agriculture Minister Òscar Ordeig warned that sanctions will apply to all violators. Forest access monitoring is increased, especially around Collserola at night during efforts to reduce wild boar populations. An emergency contract worth 7 million euros funds ASF control: 170 additional staff, over 50 vehicles, and 50 new wild boar traps to limit spread. Each new ASF case can delay pork exports by up to 12 months. Despite this, the sector reports moderate economic stabilization and partial reopening of exports to China, a major importer.

triage.headline_ja: スペインが危険な病気と戦う。新たな制限と数百万ユーロの支援 - 豚
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は動物疾患であり、ヒト感染の報告なし。IHR(2005)の公衆衛生基準に該当せず、EBS活動の対象外と判定。
triage.notes: 本イベントはアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）であり、動物疾患。IHR(2005)Annex2は公衆衛生に関する人間の健康への影響を対象としており、純粋な動物疾患は対象外。記事サマリーにはヒト感染、死亡、疾病に関する情報なし。対象国（China、Zambia等）に関しても、スペインは対象国リストに含まれず、発生地がスペインのみであるため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: 越南胡志明市19岁小伙"约炮"后确诊艾滋！医生痛心：这不仅是病毒，更是孤独！_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 19-year-old man in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, diagnosed with HIV after a casual hookup! Doctors lament: This is not just a virus, it's loneliness!
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, a 19-year-old man presented with low-grade fever and inguinal lymphadenopathy and was diagnosed with HIV after sexual health screening prompted by casual hookups, with concurrent hepatitis B infection. Clinicians highlight loneliness and limited psychosocial support as part of the case. The same clinic reports other unexpected HIV diagnoses, such as two office workers who sought care after a karaoke night and massage; comprehensive testing confirmed HIV in one, likely acquired months earlier. 2025 data show 42% of new infections in ages 15–29; 81% via unsafe sex. High-risk groups account for about 90% of new cases, with men who have sex with men at 54%. Early detection and antiretroviral therapy turn HIV into a manageable chronic disease; prevention includes condoms, regular testing, PrEP, and timely PEP within 72 hours. Co-infections tested include syphilis, gonorrhea, chlamydia, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのホーチミン市で19歳男性がカジュアルな関係後にHIV診断。医師は嘆く：これはウイルスだけでなく孤独の問題だ
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染症を含む複数の性感染症が対象国（ベトナム）で確認されており、IHR基準でも異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・流行しやすさが該当。若年層への拡大と公衆衛生上の懸念から、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市での具体的なHIV症例報告であり、若年層（15-29歳）における感染拡大が82%が異性間での安全でない性行為によるとされている。複数の性感染症の同時検査が実施されており、公衆衛生的な関心が高い。ただし国家レベルの流行警報や国際的な拡大リスクについては記事から直接的な情報は得られない。
