article.articleHeadline: Dos de los fallecidos por hantavirus estuvieron antes del crucero en una zona con la variante Andes: "Identificar la cepa es esencial"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two of the hantavirus fatalities were in an area with the Andes variant before the cruise: "Identifying the strain is essential"
article.articleSummary: Seven people aboard the Dutch cruise MV Hondius near Praia, Cabo Verde, have been affected by hantavirus, with three deaths and two laboratory-confirmed infections; five cases remain suspected. Illness onset occurred 6–28 April. The ship departed Ushuaia, Argentina, on 1 April after visiting South Atlantic islands. Case details include two Dutch travelers who had been in South America: a 70-year-old man who developed symptoms 6 April and died on board, and his 69-year-old wife who disembarked in Santa Helena on 24 April and later died. A third patient, a man with fever and pneumonia-like symptoms, was transferred from Ascension Island to South Africa and was PCR-confirmed as hantavirus on 2 May (second confirmed). A fourth case, a woman with fever beginning 28 April, died on 2 May. On board, 14 Spaniards (five Catalans, one Valencian, one Galician) remain asymptomatic. The WHO suspects Andes virus (New World hantavirus from Argentina); transmission is primarily via inhaled rodent excreta, with limited human-to-human spread. Canary Islands are among possible repatriation routes.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス死亡者2人が乗船前に南米のアンデス株変異体が存在する地域にいた：「ウイルス株の同定は不可欠」
triage.triage_reason: 国際クルーズ船での集団発症（死亡3名、確認例2名、疑似例5名）、複数国への拡大リスク、Andes hantavirus（限定的なヒト-ヒト感染の可能性あり）の報告でありIHR基準3項目該当、異常性・重症度・流行可能性が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の地域（スペイン、アルゼンチン、カーボベルデ、南アフリカなど）を抽出しているが、記事サマリーから実際のイベント発生地はアルゼンチン（出発地Ushuaia）と対象国リスト内ではブラジルのみ該当。船舶関連での国際的集団発症であり、WHOが懸念を示している。Andes hantavirusはヒト-ヒト感染が限定的とされているが、閉鎖空間（船舶）での複数事例と死亡例の発生は公衆衛生学的に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease cases rise among children
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases rise among kindergarten and pre-school children in Srinagar over the past week, with at least one school closing for a week due to clustering. Doctors describe the outbreak as mild and seasonal; Prof. Parvaiz Ahmed notes a spring surge that has recurred for five–six years, though occasional spikes occur. The infection spreads via the faeco-oral route, making hand hygiene and keeping symptomatic children at home for a few days prudent. While not considered a major threat, the spread can be rapid in group settings, and school closures are not routinely advised. Symptoms include lethargy, fever, sore throat, and painful blister-like sores in the mouth and on hands (sometimes buttocks), lasting 5–7 days. HFMD is a viral illness caused by coxsackievirus, primarily affecting children under 5 but can affect older kids; no specific treatment exists; fever can be managed with paracetamol or ibuprofen. Parents call for proactive containment.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病（HFMD）の症例数が子どもの間で増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な軽症の流行で医学的には「主要な脅威ではない」と医師から評価されている。ただしスクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」と「長期曝露」に該当し、学校閉鎖など社会的関心が存在するため、情報続報を注視する段階の判定。
triage.notes: 記事は医師が「軽症で季節的」と評価しており、深刻度は低いが、スリナガルの幼稚園・保育施設での集積、学校閉鎖、親による積極的な防除要請など社会的関心が存在。エンテロウイルス71による手足口病は潜在的に重症化リスクがあるため、今後のサーベイランス継続が推奨される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu outbreak in Navapur: More samples likely to test positive, containment measures intensify, focus on backyard poultry
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Navapur, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, confirmed as H5N1 avian influenza. In five days, nearly 200,000 chickens have been culled (total 193,667 birds), with 807,922 eggs destroyed and 21.22 metric tonnes of poultry feed discarded as containment measures. ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal confirmed positive samples from four farms, prompting culling within a 1-km radius and a 3-km containment zone; additional sampling is underway within 3 km of the infected farm. The batch of culling is expected to finish by Wednesday. Authorities are also inspecting backyard poultry, with Navapur containing about 11 lakh poultry birds. Twenty-five rapid response teams—each with a veterinary officer, livestock supervisor, and attendants—are enforcing strict biosecurity and providing Tamiflu prophylaxis and PPE. This is Navapur’s third avian influenza outbreak, following 2006 and 2021.

triage.headline_ja: ナヴァプルの鳥インフルエンザ発生：より多くのサンプルが陽性となる可能性、封じ込め措置が強化、バックヤード養鶏に焦点
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの確認、大規模な殺処分（19万羽超）と経済的影響、同地域での反復発生（第3回）により、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行易易性が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認、短期間での大規模殺処分（19万3667羽）、複数の農場での感染確認、バックヤード養鶏への拡大リスク、同地域での過去2回の発生歴（2006年、2021年）により、継続監視が必要。国際的な家禽貿易への影響の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisadoras da Uesb alertam para avanço de "superbactérias" e riscos em hospitais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female researchers from UESB warn about the rise of 'superbugs' and risks in hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian nursing/public health researchers warn of rising healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) in Brazil and globally, driven by antimicrobial resistance. The study, led by Karla Rodrigues and Gisele Lemos at UESB, Jequié campus, analyzes 1,601 hospital patients and over 2,300 culture samples, with the dominant infection being ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) and Pseudomonas aeruginosa as the principal resistant organism. The review spans 2019–2024 literature and a Northeast Brazilian public hospital, indicating infections where resistant pathogens double/triple mortality compared with susceptible strains. Projected, by 2050 HAIs could cause ~3.5 million deaths annually, about 4.4 times HIV/AIDS and sexually transmitted infections' 2021 mortality. COVID-19-era antibiotic overuse is linked to accelerated resistance. The authors call for strengthened hand hygiene, infection-control protocols, and rational antimicrobial use, plus investment in specialized antibiotic-management teams to reduce hospital stays and costs.

triage.headline_ja: UESB女性研究者が「耐性菌」の増加と病院でのリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 抗菌薬耐性による院内感染の増加は重要な公衆衛生課題だが、本記事はシステマティックレビューと研究報告であり、新規の流行イベント報告ではない。スクリーニング基準の複数該当は認められるが、リアルタイムの危機発生というより啓発・警告性質のため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、UESB研究チームによる2019-2024年文献レビューと院内感染データの分析報告である。抗菌薬耐性（AMR）による院内感染増加は既知の継続的課題であり、予測シナリオ（2050年HAI関連死亡350万人）も含まれている。COVID-19とHIVは文脈的言及であり、本イベントの主体ではない。IHR基準を2つ満たすが、リアルタイムの流行警報ではなく学術的警告の性質。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es el hantavirus? ¿Hay riesgo en Guanajuato?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is hantavirus? Is there a risk in Guanajuato?
article.articleSummary: May 5, 2026: Hantavirus is a severe acute viral disease transmitted mainly by field rodents via urine, droppings, or saliva; bites can also transmit. Two main syndromes exist: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), with fatigue, fever, muscle pains, headache, dizziness, and abdominal symptoms appearing 1–8 weeks after exposure; Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS), presenting headaches, back/abdominal pain, fever, nausea, blurred vision, hypotension, and acute renal failure within 1–2 weeks. Death rates are about 38% for HPS and 5–15% for HFRS. A recent Atlantic-cruise outbreak involving the MV Hondius (departing Ushuaia, Tierra del Fuego, Argentina) includes 1 laboratory-confirmed case and 5 suspected, with 3 deaths; transmission is primarily rodent-to-human, with very low person-to-person spread. Guanajuato, Mexico, has no recent locally acquired cases, so the risk is considered very low. Notable outbreaks have occurred in Asia (China) and the United States (33 cases, 13 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとは何か？グアナフアトに危険があるのか？
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船集団発生（確定1例、疑い5例、死亡3例）は重症度と異常性で注目に値するが、グアナフアト（メキシコ）は対象国外であり、記事サマリーでは検出対象国での活動性感染症イベントが明確でない。船舶関連のため地理的限定とスクリーニング基準の判断が困難。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン・ティエラ・デル・フエゴ出航のクルーズ船集団発生（MV Hondius）とグアナフアト（メキシコ）のリスク評価。両者とも対象国リスト外。アジア・米国での過去発生言及あるが、現在の活動性イベントとしては対象国での確認なし。船舶関連イベントのため地理的限定が複雑。

article.articleHeadline: Adapi alerta criadores e populaÃ§Ã£o apÃ³s confirmaÃ§Ã£o de caso de raiva humana em Oeiras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adapi alerts breeders and the public after confirmation of a human rabies case in Oeiras
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Oeiras, Brazil, after confirmation of a human rabies case. Adapi, the State Program for Control of Rabies in Herbivores, urges breeders and the public to intensify vigilance on properties with cattle, goats, sheep, and horses. Watch for neurological signs: excessive drooling, difficulty moving, motor incoordination, and altered behavior. Do not handle suspected animals; report cases immediately to Adapi or health authorities. Be cautious about wildlife on farms; do not touch or feed sagui (squirrel monkeys), bats, or other animals exhibiting abnormal behavior. Vaccination of production herds is emphasized as the main prevention against this zoonosis. Recommendations: vaccinate bovines, caprines, ovines, and equines; avoid contact with symptomatic animals; report suspected cases promptly; increase vigilance in rural areas. Authorities continue monitoring; public cooperation is essential to prevent further cases and protect public health; no panic.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・オエイラスで人間狂犬病ケースが確認された後、Adapiが畜産者と住民に警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの人間狂犬病ケースは深刻だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、フルRRA対象外。ただし狂犬病の人間感染は重篤疾患であり、国内警報が発出されており、情報追跡の価値がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リスト（CEPR監視対象）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。ただし狂犬病による人間死亡ケースの発生と公式警報の発出は公衆衛生的に重要。発生地域はBrazilを含むが、対象国リストの制約により除外。情報源がポルトガル語で詳細な警告内容があり、信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria da Saúde alerta para prevenção da dengue mesmo com queda de casos no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department warns about dengue prevention even with a drop in cases in Paraná
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Paraná, Brazil shows a substantial drop in cases and deaths in early 2026, but health authorities warn against complacency due to circulation of all four dengue serotypes (DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4). Infection with a serotype grants permanent immunity to that type only; secondary infections with a different serotype increase risk of severe disease and fatal outcomes. DENV-2 remains the predominant serotype in Paraná through 2025–2026, with DENV-3 circulation reintroduced since 2024; historical surveillance since 1995 shows shifting serotype dominance. From Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2026, state labs processed over 6,000 samples from Paraná residents, with more than 200 positive dengue cases. March marked a climate-related risk period across much of Paraná, indicating climate alone is not decisive. Preventive measures include sealing water tanks, screening drains, avoiding water pooling in plant pots and tires, cleaning gutters and roof eaves, draining refrigerator trays, proper waste disposal, and community engagement to maintain control of multiple viral variations.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州の保健部門、パラナでのデング熱患者数減少にもかかわらず予防接種を警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の患者数と死亡数は減少しているが、4つの全セロタイプが循環しており、二次感染による重症化リスクが存在する。情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国（3469034）として認識されたが、今回の記事主題はブラジル国内のパラナ州レベルの情報であり、CEPR対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。患者数減少傾向にあるが、多重セロタイプ循環と二次感染リスク、長期的な曝露リスクが存在する点で、ローカルスクリーニング基準では要注視水準。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus é um vírus novo e desconhecido? A SIC Verifica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Hantavirus a new and unknown virus? SIC Verifica.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus on the MV Hondius cruise ship (Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde) has drawn global attention but is not a new or global threat. As of May 4, 2026, the World Health Organization confirmed seven cases: two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases, including three deaths. Historic context spans China-written accounts from about 900 years ago and notable outbreaks during the Korean War (1950–53) caused by hantavirus, later identified in rodents in the 1980s. A major US outbreak occurred in Four Corners in 1993; from 1993–2023, the United States reported at least 129 cases in New Mexico and more than 890 nationwide. Transmission is primarily via rodent excreta or secretions; human-to-human spread is rare. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control rates overall public health risk in Europe as 'very low'. The hantavirus is not a novel virus, nor is it an imminent global threat like COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスは新しく未知のウイルスか？SIC検証
triage.triage_reason: 記事はハンタウイルスが新規・未知のウイルスではなく、グローバルな脅威ではないことを確認する fact-check 記事である。公衆衛生への深刻な影響や異常性は認められず、対象国での発生報告もない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは cruise ship での限定的な症例（7例、死亡3例）を報告しているが、これは確認済みの既知ウイルスであり、新規脅威ではない。歴史的文脈（中国900年前、朝鮮戦争、1993年US Four Corners outbreak）を説明する fact-check 記事。ECDCは欧州での公衆衛生リスク評価を「very low」としている。Ushuaia（アルゼンチン）からCape Verde へのクルーズ船経路が記載されているが、これは出発地・経由地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地は特定されていない。対象国リストでは China のみが歴史的背景として言及されているため、検証位置として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand: Over half of children killed by Covid under age of 5 - phnompenhpost.com
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 in Thailand remains a major pediatric concern, with January data showing more than half of Covid-19 deaths among children occurred in those under five, too young to be vaccinated. Omicron-driven infections have surged, prompting Bangkok hospitals to ready beds, transfer systems and special treatment for severely ill children as the new school year starts. The government is accelerating vaccination for five-to-11-year-olds at schools, and the Immunity Promotion Subcommittee proposed a half- or full-dose Pfizer booster for five-to-17-year-olds after four to six months. From May 9, school vaccination points will offer half-doses, with the second half-dose at local hospitals later. Thailand has the eighth-highest Covid-19 death toll globally since the start of the pandemic. On Saturday, 20,052 new infections and 129 deaths were reported; deaths rose 22% week over week, while infections fell 19%. Omicron is expected to continue spreading and mutate; long Covid risk studies are pending.

triage.headline_ja: タイ：COVID-19で殺害された5歳未満の子どもが半数以上
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は周知の疾患であり、タイにおける小児死亡増加は重篤な懸念だが、IHR基準は最大2つ（予想外性および重症度）の部分的該当のため、情報不足の状況でWATCHに分類。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患だが、タイにおける小児死亡（特に5歳未満）の急増は公衆衛生上の重要な懸念。Omicronバリアントによる感染増加、死亡率の週間増加率22%、パンデミック開始以来世界で8番目に高い累積死亡数などから予想外性・重症度・流行しやすさで複数基準に該当。ただしCOVID-19の既知性とタイの管理能力を考慮するとPICKUPの確定には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Após morte por raiva humana no Piauí, Adapi alerta e pede que população redobre atenção à doença - Portal O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a death due to human rabies in Piauí, Adapi warns and asks the public to be more vigilant about the disease - Portal O Dia
article.articleSummary: In Piauí, Brazil, a 17-year-old rural resident in Oeiras died last month from human rabies after being bitten by a sagui (tufted capuchin monkey). The death prompted an alert from Adapi and Sada, urging heightened vigilance among farmers, livestock producers, and residents. Authorities emphasize vaccination of production herds (cattle, goats, sheep, horses) as the principal preventive measure to curb this zoonosis. People should monitor animals for neurological signs—excessive salivation, difficulty moving, ataxia, and behavioral changes—and avoid handling suspected animals, contacting health authorities instead. Wildlife such as saguis and bats can be reservoirs; do not touch or feed found or abnormal animals and report them. Statewide monitoring continues, and population cooperation is essential to prevent further cases; no panic is advised.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州でヒト狂犬病による死亡後、Adapiが警告し、住民に疾病への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による人間の死亡は重大であり予想外だが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が確認できず、国際的拡大リスクも低い。情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: Bluedotが抽出した発生地域にはBrazil (3469034)が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列となる。ただしIHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当しており、地域的には懸念される事象である。ブラジル国内での狂犬病対策ニュースとしての性質が強く、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Suman siete los casos de hantavirus en el crucero aislado frente a África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven hantavirus cases on the isolated cruise ship off the coast of Africa.
article.articleSummary: Seven hantavirus cases (confirmed and suspected) and three deaths are reported aboard the MV Hondius, a cruise ship off Cabo Verde with 149 people on board from 23 nationalities; crew largely Filipino and European. The vessel is at SHIELD level 3, with strict isolation, continuous medical surveillance, and full operational restrictions as epidemiological investigations proceed. Two cases are laboratory-confirmed hantavirus; the remaining five are under investigation. One of the confirmed deaths is a Dutch passenger with a detected virus variant who had accompanied the transfer of her husband’s body, who died during the voyage. A British national evacuated earlier remains in intensive care in South Africa. The ship has not been allowed to dock or offload; transfers depend on Cabo Verde’s authorization and international coordination. Potential destinations include Las Palmas and Tenerife (Canary Islands); Spain requests full epidemiological data, and Canary Islands authorities have expressed reservations about a stop. Oceanwide Expeditions operates the vessel. Date reference: 2026-05-05.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ沖の隔離クルーズ船でハンタウイルス7例、3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。閉鎖空間での集団発生、複数国籍者の搭乗、国際的な港湾管理・医学的疫学調査が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の感染イベント発生地はCabo Verde沖のクルーズ船（Cabo Verde領海内）。乗客・乗員の国籍・起源地は多様（フィリピン人乗員、オランダ人・イギリス人乗客など）であるが、対象国リストではフィリピンのみ確認。船舶の隔離・医学的管理はSHIELD level 3で継続中。ハンタウイルス感染の閉鎖空間での集団発生は国際的に異例であり、シグナルピックアップの優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Χανταϊός: Πλάνα από το εσωτερικό του κρουαζιερόπλοιου που έχει βρεθεί στο επίκεντρο της έξαρσης του ιού | LiFO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Footage from inside the cruise ship that has been at the center of the virus outbreak | LiFO
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on MV Hondius, a 107-meter polar research cruise ship, currently off West Africa near Green Cape with plans to sail to the Canary Islands. Three deaths—two Dutch, one German—are reported, with initial infections suspected to have occurred during remote excursions; hantavirus is typically rodent-borne and can cause severe respiratory illness. A British passenger is critically ill and being treated in a Johannesburg ICU; two crew members have respiratory symptoms and may be evacuated. The ship carries 85 passengers and 61 crew (38 Filipino crew, 23 Brits, 17 Americans, 14 Spaniards). WHO epidemiologist Maria Van Kerkhove notes that human-to-human transmission is rare, with possible limited spread among very close contacts; initial cases are believed to be outside the vessel. Authorities paused onshore contact, and Spain plans epidemiological work and full disinfection in the Canary Islands. Oceanwide Expeditions has activated emergency level 3 with isolation, hygiene protocols, and continuous medical monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：ウイルス流行の中心にあるクルーズ船の船内映像
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な多地域での死亡例（3名）を含む異常事象であり、複数国で感染者が報告されている。IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行性」「管理可能性」に該当する。国際支援（スペイン、WHO関与）および社会的関心の高さから、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき検証地域の確認を実施。フィリピンはMV Hondiusの乗組員38名が同国籍であることで言及されているため、対象国リストに該当として含める。本件は南アフリカ（ヨハネスブルグの集中治療室での治療）、スペイン（カナリア諸島での予定と疫学調査）、オランダ・ドイツ・イギリス・アメリカ（死亡・患者国籍）での国際的な多地域事象であるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはフィリピンのみ。ハンタウイルスは通常げっ歯類由来であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀とのWHO専門家見解があるも、船上での密接接触による限定的伝播の可能性がある。緊急レベル3対応により管理体制は確立されている。

article.articleHeadline: Feira Mega Gestante promove campanha de vacinação contra a gripe - Diário do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mega Gestante Fair Promotes Influenza Vaccination Campaign - Rio de Janeiro Daily
article.articleSummary: Free influenza vaccination will be offered to pregnant women, babies up to two years, and their families at the Mega Gestante Fair in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The event, the 2nd edition of 2026 and touted as the largest maternity‑infant fair in the country, runs May 13–17, 2026 at Riocentro (Pavilion 2), Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro. The fair spans about 10,000 square meters with 140 exhibitors and is expected to draw roughly 15,000 visitors over five days. Vaccination hours are: Wednesday to Friday 14:00–21:00; Saturday 10:00–21:00; Sunday 10:00–20:00, with free entry after preregistration at the event site. The vaccination campaign is conducted in partnership with the Rio de Janeiro Health Secretariat, reinforcing preventive care for mothers, infants, and families.

triage.headline_ja: メガプレナンテフェアがインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施 - リオデジャネイロ日報
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは既存の公衆衛生ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、新規感染症アウトブレイクではない。異常性なく、流行性もなく、公式保健機関による計画的な予防活動である。
triage.notes: 本記事はインフルエンザの患者数増加や流行アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、リオデジャネイロ保健局による正常な予防接種キャンペーンの告知記事である。妊婦・幼児・家族を対象とした公式イベントでの無料ワクチン接種であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルではなく通常の公衆衛生活動である。

article.articleHeadline: Dog bite cases soar in J&K, cross 2 lakh mark in 2 years
article.articleSummary: Dog bite cases in Jammu and Kashmir surged to 2.06 lakh across 2024–2025, rising from 93,765 in 2024 to 112,695 in 2025. Over the two years the territory averaged about 282 cases per day. Jammu division accounted for 126,844 (61%) of cases, up from 54,863 in 2024 to 71,981 in 2025; Kashmir division reported 79,616 (including 38,902 in 2024 and 40,714 in 2025). Among districts, Jammu district recorded 76,824 cases (33,065 in 2024; 43,759 in 2025). In the Kashmir Valley, Srinagar led with 35,174 cases, followed by Baramulla 12,882 and Anantnag 10,818. A 2023 survey estimated 152,775 stray dogs citywide, with 64,416 in Srinagar; current numbers may be higher. Officials are running Animal Birth Control and Anti-Rabies Vaccination programmes, plus more ABC/ARV centres in Jammu and Srinagar, to curb rabies risk, especially around schools and hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: Dog bite cases soar in J&K, cross 2 lakh mark in 2 years
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：年間平均282件/日の犬咬傷、狂犬病リスク；異常：2年で206,000件超の急増），WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度：狂犬病病原体曝露，長期曝露：野良犬152,775頭と継続的リスク）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ジャンムー・カシミール地域での狂犬病関連の犬咬傷件数の急増を報告。2年間で206,000件を超える事例は重大な公衆衛生課題を示唆。政府がABC（動物生殖制御）・ARV（抗狂犬病ワクチン）プログラムを実施中との報道あり。野良犬数の増加傾向も懸念要因。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS rastreja més de vuitanta passatgers d'un vol en què viatjava una víctima de l'hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO tracks more than eighty passengers on a flight in which a hantavirus victim was traveling.
article.articleSummary: WHO is tracing over 80 passengers on an Airlink flight from Santa Helena to Johannesburg connected to a hantavirus outbreak on the Dutch-flagged cruise ship MV Hondius, docked off Cape Verde after authorities blocked disembarkation. The April 25 flight carried 82 passengers and six crew; a Dutch woman who left the vessel with gastrointestinal symptoms died after hospital admission in Johannesburg and was the partner of another passenger who had died earlier aboard. The Hondius outbreak has three deaths (two Dutch, one German) and at least seven confirmed or suspected cases. A British national has been evacuated in critical condition to a South African hospital; two crew members require urgent care. Hantavirus is typically rodent-borne, but very limited human-to-human transmission in close contact is under study. Genomic analyses in South Africa aim to identify the variant, while authorities maintain low population risk and conduct passenger tracing.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがハンタウイルス患者が搭乗していたフライトの80人以上の乗客を追跡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響：死亡3例、患者7例以上；異常性：クルーズ船での複数国籍者の集団発症；国際的拡大リスク：オランダ・ドイツ・英国人を含む；渡航制限リスク：船舶隔離・乗客追跡中）。WPRO基準でも複数基準該当。国際社会の関心が高い。フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的詳細を精査。発生地は「オランダ船籍MV Hondius」（カーボベルデ沖）のクルーズ船。サンタ・ヘレナ→ヨハネスブルグ便は被害者追跡用。クルーズ船自体の停泊地はカーボベルデだが対象国外。患者の死亡・治療地は南アフリカ（対象国外）。記事サマリーにおいて「マラニャン州」と「サンタ・ヘレナ」はブラジル国内地名として記述されているが、本イベントの主要な発生地はあくまでクルーズ船（国籍はオランダ）とその関連の南アフリカの病院である。ただし、Bluedotが付与した発生地域リストにBrazilが含まれており、サマリーにもマラニャン州・サンタ・ヘレナが言及されているため、地理的な曖昧性がある。厳密には、記事の主題となっているハンタウイルス発症事例はクルーズ船およびジョハネスブルグの病院での診断・死亡であり、ブラジル国内での感染発生とは直接関連がない可能性が高い。しかし保守的に、フライト経路・地名言及の観点からBrazilを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Itajaí cria atendimento móvel para doença do gato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itajaí launches mobile clinic for feline disease.
article.articleSummary: Itajaí launches a mobile clinic to address suspected cases of the so-called 'cat disease'. The city deploys a mobile care unit to expedite diagnosis, orient the population, and offer follow-up for affected individuals, aiming to prevent complications and limit transmission. Specialized teams can reach symptomatic residents faster, expanding access to care and reducing burden on health facilities. The initiative reinforces public health actions and prevention messaging, emphasizing information sharing and preventive care, particularly for cases involving contact with animals and potential infections. No case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources are provided in the report for immediate public health planning.

triage.headline_ja: イタジャイが猫の病気に対応する移動クリニックを開設
triage.triage_reason: 未特定疾患（Unknown Illness）で実態が不明瞭だが、動物接触を含む感染症の可能性が示唆されている。症例数・検査確認・感染源の詳細が記事に記載されていないため、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 疾患名が『Unknown Illness』で具体的な診断名が記載されていない点が大きな制限要因。動物接触との関連が示唆される一方、症例数・実験室確認・感染源の詳細が全く報告されておらず、公衆衛生インパクトの評価が困難。移動クリニック設置という行政対応は地域での関心の高さを示唆するが、国際的懸念は低い。続報で疾患の特定と症例数が明らかになるまで経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Após ações coordenadas, epidemia de chikungunya recua em aldeias de Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After coordinated actions, the Chikungunya epidemic recedes in the villages of Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreaks receded in the Bororó and Jaguapiru villages in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, according to the COE in Public Health. Despite the decline, 35 patients remain hospitalized with complications across facilities: 1 at Porta da Esperança Indigenous Hospital (Missão Caiuá), 18 at HU-UFGD, 1 at Hospital Cassems, 7 at Hospital Regional, 2 at Unimed, 3 at Hospital da Vida, and 3 at Evangélico Mackenzie. Up to May 5, 3,141 notifications were filed for suspected chikungunya in the Indigenous Reserve, with 2,418 probable, 2,071 confirmed, 723 discarded and 347 under investigation. A mutirão has collected 250 tons of solid waste to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding. Interventions follow the Incident Action Plan, emergency decrees, and vaccination in basic care. Teams reported cases across acute, subacute and chronic stages. No imported or exported chikungunya cases were reported.

triage.headline_ja: 調整されたアクション後、ドゥラードス村のチクングニア流行が減少
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国外）でのチクングニア流行は継続中だが、記事は「流行が減少」と報じており、死亡や国際的拡大の具体的なリスクの情報が不足している。継続観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。35名が入院中、2,071名の確定症例、3,141の疑い通知があり、地域的には重症度・流行性が確認されるが、記事は流行減少を報じている。国際的な拡大リスクの言及はなく、ブラジル国内での対応状況を述べている。継続的な監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: World News in Brief: Sudan refugee update, child trafficking crisis in South Sudan, 'mystery' illness in Burundi, human rights in Serbia - news
article.articleSummary: Burundi, Mpanda district near the DRC border, reports an illness with 5 deaths among 28 cases since 30 March. Patients present fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, blood in urine, and sometimes jaundice and anaemia. Ebola and Marburg tests were negative; laboratory analyses are ongoing. WHO supports the Health Ministry, deploying a joint team to strengthen surveillance, care and laboratory diagnosis. Separately, Chad hosts about 1.3 million Sudan refugees, most since the April 2023 war; around 15,000 new arrivals this year. UNHCR and WFP warn essential aid could be scaled back unless a $428 million shortfall is met. In South Sudan, displacement totals about 3.4 million (1.4 million refugees from Sudan plus nearly 2 million internally displaced), driving a trafficking crisis with child trafficking, sexual violence and forced recruitment; calls for AU Hybrid Court action. In Serbia, UN rights chief warns of erosion of civic space and media restrictions after elections, urging accountability.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース速報：スーダン難民更新、南スーダンの児童人身売買危機、ブルンジの「謎の」疾病、セルビアの人権問題
triage.triage_reason: ブルンジで原因不明の疾病が報告され、28例中5死亡（致死率17.9%）という重症度の高いイベントが記録されている。Ebola/Marburg検査は陰性だが原因不明であり、WHOが現地支援チームを派遣する異常かつ重大な公衆衛生事象として該当。IHR基準で複数該当あり、かつ国際的な支援が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は『ブルンジのMpanda地区での原因不明疾患』だが、Mpanda地区はDRC（Kasai地域）に属する。発生地域リストに含まれるBurundiは地理的に言及されているが、実際の感染症イベントはDRC側のMpandaで発生している。DRCのみを対象国として verified_locations に含める。Chad、Sudan、South Sudan、Serbiaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Ebola/Marburg検査が陰性とされているが、確定診断待機中の原因不明疾患であり、重症度と国際的対応の規模からピックアップ判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sesa alerta para circulação de múltiplos sorotipos da dengue e reforça prevenção no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesa warns of circulation of multiple dengue serotypes and reinforces prevention in Paraná.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a vigilance concern in Paraná, Brazil, despite a decline in cases and deaths in the first months of 2026. The Paraná State Health Secretariat notes circulation of multiple dengue serotypes, with DENV-2 currently predominant and DENV-3 reintroduced, raising the risk of severe disease in secondary infections. Health officials warn that a low transmission period does not end the threat, and emphasize ongoing measures such as clearing gutters, sealing water tanks, and proper waste disposal as the most effective tools. Laboratory surveillance confirms the serotype switch, signaling heightened alert for a population with limited immunity to DENV-3. Climate data indicate mosquito reproduction is no longer confined to traditional seasons, driven by temperature variations, leading to possible year-round transmission. Citizens are urged to regularly inspect backyards, remove standing water in plant dishes, and protect containers like tires and bottles from rain. Continuous vigilance is essential to dengue control.

triage.headline_ja: セサが複数のデング熱血清型の流行に警告し、パラナ州での予防を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国外）でのデング熱事例であり、verified_locationsは空配列となる。IHR基準2つ以上該当の可能性があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため、フルRRA進行の判断保留。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのパラナ州でのデング熱複数血清型（DENV-2, DENV-3）の流行を扱っている。ブラジルは評価対象国リスト（GeoNames ID 3469034）に含まれるが、記事の主題地域がパラナ州であり、発生地域としてBrazilが列挙されている。ただし、対象国リストにBrazilは含まれていない（3469034は対象リストに記載されていない）ため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。スクリーニング基準4項目が該当し、複数血清型の同時流行、二次感染時の重症化リスク、年間を通じた蚊の繁殖が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。ただし地理的対象外のため、シグナルピックアップとしない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Divinópolis alerta para risco de sarampo e faz apelo urgente à vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis City Hall Warns of Measles Risk and Makes an Urgent Appeal for Vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil - The City Hall Health Secretariat issued a measles warning on 5 May 2026, highlighting the risk of reintroduction as measles remains circulating in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, potentially bringing cases into Brazil during international travel, including visitors for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Vaccination remains the primary defense and is offered free at public health clinics. Travelers should review their vaccination records, update necessary doses, and be immunized at least 15 days before departure. A one-time dose zero is advised for children 6-11 months traveling to areas with transmission, but it does not replace the standard schedule after age one. The recommended schedule: ages 12 months–29 years, two doses; ages 30–59 years, at least one dose. Symptoms to watch: high fever, red rash, runny nose, conjunctivitis; seek care and report travel history if measles is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: ジノーポリス市保健局が麻疹リスクについて警告し、ワクチン接種を緊急呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの麻疹リスク警告であり、国際的な流行（米国、メキシコ、カナダ）の文脈で国境を越えた懸念が生じている。2026年FIFAワールドカップという国際イベントに関連し、国際的拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのジノーポリスにおける麻疹リスク警告が主題。米国、メキシコ、カナダでの流行との関連が述べられているが、これらは背景情報であり、実際の発生地域はブラジルのみ。2026年FIFAワールドカップという国際イベントが関連する点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman un nuevo caso de Mpox en CABA: qué es, cómo se contagia y cuáles son los síntomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Mpox case confirmed in the City of Buenos Aires: what it is, how it spreads, and what the symptoms are.
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Argentina reports 8 confirmed Mpox cases in 2026, including a new case in the City of Buenos Aires (CABA) that raises the national total. Seven cases are residents of CABA; one is in Río Negro with a travel history to Chile. All patients are men aged 29–43, with most reporting sexual contact with new or multiple partners. Mpox (monkeypox) is caused by an Orthopoxvirus; transmission occurs mainly via close physical contact, including sexual contact, skin-to-skin contact, exposure to lesions, or contact with contaminated objects; condoms offer limited protection. Incubation is typically 6–13 days (up to 21), and illness lasts 2–3 weeks. Symptoms include painful skin or mucosal lesions (often genital/anal), fever, myalgia, headache, lymphadenopathy, and fatigue; coinfections with other STIs can occur. Most current cases are clade Ib; two are clade I. Regional circulation shows 784 cases in the Americas, notably the United States and Brazil. Public health guidance emphasizes early detection, case isolation, avoiding contact with suspected cases, and disinfection of shared items.

triage.headline_ja: ブエノスアイレス市で新たなMpox症例を確認：それは何か、どのように感染し、症状は何か
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（Clade I/II）の複数国での継続的流行を示す事象。アルゼンチンで8例（2026年）、米国・ブラジルでも広がり、ヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触含む）が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアルゼンチン、チリ、米国も列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は「アルゼンチンとその地域内の症例」。評価対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。ただし、米国でも784例の区域流行が報告されており、北米でのClade I/II流行は確認される。アルゼンチンの症例は医療体制が比較的整備された地域での発生だが、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続的リスク（特に性的接触経由）が強い。Mpoxは国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Exército reforça combate à dengue, zika e chikungunya em Alagoinhas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Army steps up the fight against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Alagoinhas.
article.articleSummary: Alagoinhas, Brazil expands fight against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya by enlisting the Brazilian Army's 6th Battalion to assist endemic agents, with the Municipal Civil Guard as support. The move follows a public health emergency declaration issued by Mayor Gustavo Carmo on May 4, 2026 (Decree No. 6.626/2026) enabling faster procurement, hiring, and legal backing for compulsory entry into unoccupied or abandoned properties when health risks are imminent. The Army’s field presence aims to overcome barriers to accessing closed or resident-resistant homes and to intensify elimination of mosquito breeding sites in neighborhoods with higher infestation, as identified by Municipal Health Surveillance. Health Secretary Luciano Sérgio says the joint operation strengthens safety and effectiveness. Subtenente Aparecido of the 6th Battalion emphasizes unity among Army, public agencies, and community, underscoring a commitment to protect public health and social peace. The plan seeks to curb the spread of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Alagoinhas.

triage.headline_ja: 軍がアラゴイニャスのデング熱、ジカウイルス感染症、チクングニヤ熱との戦いを強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアラゴイニャスでデング熱、ジカ、チクングニヤの対策強化が報告されているが、記事は行政対応の発表であり、具体的な感染数や重症度、拡大の直接的証拠が明示されていない。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性や流行性を示唆する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月5日のもので、アラゴイニャス市におけるデング熱、ジカ、チクングニヤの継続的曝露と流行性の高さは確認されるが、発症者数、重症度、具体的な流行規模が記載されていない。公開健康緊急事態宣言（令5月4日）は政府対応の関心を示すが、IHR基準を満たす深刻性の客観的証拠に乏しい。続報による具体的データの収集が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Government issues travel warning over 'concerning' virus that can leave symptoms lasting years
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus prompts UK travel warning ahead of summer. Transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes through daytime bites in towns and cities; not spread person-to-person. Outbreaks include Foshan, China, last August; the virus is found across the Americas, Africa, and South/Southeast Asia. UKHSA reports no onward UK transmission at present. In 2024 there were 112 confirmed cases, predominantly from India, with smaller numbers from Pakistan and Brazil—destinations popular for British travellers. Symptoms include fatigue, debilitating joint and muscle pain, headaches and nausea; most patients recover within one to two weeks, but high-risk groups may suffer more serious complications affecting the nervous system, eyes, heart, or digestive system. There is no targeted antiviral treatment. Prevention relies on insect repellents containing DEET. Two vaccines, Ixchiq and Vimkunya, are available in the UK via private pharmacies (£185–£195). Vaccination should be considered by travellers to regions with significant outbreaks; there is no ongoing UK transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が『懸念される』ウイルスに対する渡航警告を発令、症状が数年続く可能性
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアウイルスは対象国（インド、パキスタン、ブラジル、中国）で流行しており、複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、英国内での感染は現在ないと報告されており、国内の公衆衛生への直接的な重大影響は限定的。情報が不足しているため継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: チクングニアウイルスは複数対象国で流行中。蚊媒介性感染症で人人感染はなし。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するが、英国内での感染伝播は現在ないと報告されている点が重要。渡航者への警告が政府レベルで発出されており、社会的・政治的関心は存在。継続的な情報収集で動向を監視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus é um vírus novo e desconhecido? A SIC Verifica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is hantavirus a new and unknown virus? SIC Verifies.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on the cruise MV Hondius, operating between Ushuaia, Argentina, and Cape Verde, attracted global attention but the virus is not new. Historical records describe hantavirus infections in Chinese writings dating back about 900 years, with a major 1950s outbreak during the Korean War causing hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS). The hantavirus was identified in the early 1980s from wild rodents. A notable US outbreak occurred in Four Corners in 1993; from 1993–2023, 129 cases were recorded in New Mexico and more than 890 cases across the United States. As of May 4, 2026, the World Health Organization confirms seven cases linked to the Hondius incident (two laboratory-confirmed, five suspected), including three deaths. Infections usually arise from exposure to rodent excreta or secretions; human-to-human transmission is rare. The European risk is very low per ECDC, and the outbreak does not represent a global threat comparable to COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスは新しく未知のウイルスか？SICが検証
triage.triage_reason: 限定的なアウトブレイク（7例、死亡3例）だが、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀で、欧州リスクは非常に低く、グローバル脅威でない。シグナル基準の複数項目で不明情報が多く、続報注視が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国を記載しているが、記事サマリーの主題は特定のクルーズ船（MV Hondius）でのハンタウイルスアウトブレイクであり、アルゼンチン（ウシュアイア）とケープベルデ間で発生。しかしアルゼンチンはWPRO対象国外。WPROスクリーニング基準には該当するが、死亡3例を含む7例の限定的なアウトブレイク、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀、欧州リスク非常に低い、グローバル脅威でないとの評価により、フルRRA開始の水準には達していない。ただしクルーズ船というユニークな設定と死亡例が複数あり、続報注視は適切。

article.articleHeadline: Erratic April rain triggers spike in dengue cases | Delhi News
article.articleSummary: Delhi records 107 dengue cases this year, with 52 in April, amid erratic April rainfall that sustains standing water and boosts Aedes aegypti breeding. The year-to-date total surpasses April counts of prior years: 130 dengue cases by end-April 2025 (32 in April); 35 in April 2024; 18 in April 2023. Mosquito density index findings are pending. Dengue remains the main concern, with 29 malaria and 5 chikungunya cases reported this year. About 119 dengue cases involve infections acquired in other states or where patient addresses are incomplete or untraceable. In response, Delhi civic authorities have intensified vector control: ~1.2 crore house visits, 15,649 households positive for breeding, 16,261 legal notices, 1,712 prosecutions, and administrative challans of Rs 50,000+ in 358 cases, recovering over Rs 1 lakh. Emphasis on preventing water accumulation on terraces and indoor preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 4月の不規則な降雨がデング熱患者数の急増を引き起こす | デリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な上昇傾向が報告されているが、重症度や入院率、死亡情報が不明であり、またインド国内での確認であっても国際的拡大リスクの記述がない。情報不足のため追加情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性疾患であり、4月の降雨増加に伴う患者数増加は予想される現象。前年比での増加傾向は記述されているが、重症度、入院率、死亡数などの詳細情報が不明。マラリアとチキングニアも報告されているが主要な関心はデング熱。インド国内での対応体制は整備されているが、国際的な支援要求はない。

article.articleHeadline: ES confirma quinto caso de Mpox do ano; veja onde - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espírito Santo confirms fifth Mpox case of the year; see where - Folha Vitória.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox), a viral zoonotic disease, has a confirmed fifth case in Espírito Santo, Brazil, as of May 5, 2026. Transmission to humans occurs via contact with infected people, contaminated materials, or infected wild animals. Common symptoms include skin eruptions or lesions, swollen lymph nodes, fever, headache, body aches, chills, and fatigue. Individuals with similar symptoms are advised to seek healthcare promptly. The report does not detail laboratory confirmation or the specific case location within Espírito Santo, but notes ongoing transmission with multiple cases this year. This briefing emphasizes mpox awareness and the public health importance of early identification and medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: エスピリト・サント州、年内5件目のMpox症例を確認 - フォーリャ・ビトーリア
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxは国際的に懸念される病原体であるが、ブラジルは対象国外のため verified_locations は空配列となる。IHR基準での該当状況は不確定だが、スクリーニング基準では重症度・流行性の可能性が認識される一方、情報不足のため確定的な判定ができない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジルのエスピリト・サント州で発生しているが、ブラジルは対象国リスト外であるため verified_locations は空配列。ただしMpoxは国際的に懸念される病原体であり、継続的な監視は推奨される。複数症例の継続発生が報告されており、情報の追加確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmaron un nuevo caso de viruela del mono: ¿Qué es y cómo se contagia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They confirmed a new case of monkeypox: What is it and how is it spread?
article.articleSummary: Argentina's Health Ministry reports a new mpox (monkeypox) case in Buenos Aires City, raising 2026 total to eight through week 15; seven cases are in CABA and one in Río Negro with recent travel to Chile. All eight patients are male, aged 29–43. Most belong to Clade Ib; two cases identified as Clade I. Regionally, the Americas reported 784 cases in weeks 1–13 of 2026, led by the United States (364) and Brazil (215). Mpox, a zoonotic virus in the Poxviridae family, transmits via close contact, including sexual contact; incubation 5–21 days (usually 6–13). Illness is typically self-limited over 14–21 days, with skin or mucosal lesions (often genital/anal), fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy. Coinfections with other STIs are common; immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk of severe disease. The Río Negro case had recent travel to Chile.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい猿痘感染者を確認：それは何で、どのように感染するのか？
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（Clade I/II混在）がアルゼンチンで確認され、地域的な流行が継続している。ただし対象国リストに含まれるブラジルでの詳細情報が限定的であり、現時点では社会的・政治的関心の度合いが明確でないため、追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にアルゼンチンでのMpox事例報告だが、対象国リストではアルゼンチンは含まれていない。対象国のうち、ブラジルについては週1～13で215例が報告されており、継続的な流行状況が示唆される。アメリカ、チリも記事に登場するが対象国外。Clade I/IIの両方が検出されている点、ヒト-ヒト感染（特に性的接触）による拡大の可能性、そして複数国での同時流行という点で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Antilopok terjeszthetik a majomhimlőt - Magyar Mezőgazdaság
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antelopes may spread Monkeypox - Hungarian Agriculture
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox may be spread by tufted antelopes in Central and West Africa. Bushmeat markets sell meat from hunted wildlife, including small antelopes, and researchers found evidence that tufted antelopes can carry mpox virus: two animals infected with mpox and a third with another orthopoxvirus, suggesting this species may play a larger role in transmission than previously thought. Monkeypox causes severe disease and deaths in parts of Central and West Africa; the first human case was in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In 2022 the virus spread beyond Africa, and by 2024 a second variant began circulating globally. The natural reservoir is thought to be rodents, though human transmission remains not fully understood. The findings derive from a ResearchSquare preprint cited by Science, with Anne Rimoin commenting on the potential importance of these antelopes.

triage.headline_ja: カモシカがサル痘を拡大させる可能性 - ハンガリー農業
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（サル痘）の中央・西アフリカでの流行継続、新たな動物媒介経路の発見（カモシカ）により異常性と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が示唆される。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は中央・西アフリカでのMpox流行とカモシカによる新たな動物媒介経路の可能性を報告。DRCは初の人類感染事例発生地として記載されている。2022年以降のグローバル拡大、2024年の第2亜系統の出現など、国際的拡大リスクが継続。アンゴラはサマリーで「中央西アフリカ」の地名として言及されているが、具体的な発生地として特定されていないため除外。動物-人間境界の感染症として高い継続リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept issues SOP to housing societies to curb mosquito breeding - The Navhind Times
article.articleSummary: Goa’s Directorate of Health Services issued an SOP urging housing cooperatives to curb vector-borne disease by appointing a nodal person to conduct weekly premises surveys and inform residents about preventive measures. The SOP calls for removal of breeding sources such as broken buckets, tyres and other items that collect rainwater on rooftops, balconies, and outside flats; all water storage containers—including overhead and ground tanks, drums, sumps, and bottle caps—must be covered, with weekly clearing or treatment of water stagnation in pumps, drains, basements, or parking areas. Weekly cleaning of water coolers, containers and buckets is advised, and when occupants are away, water-holding items should be kept dry; dustbins should be covered during the monsoon. In Goa, one dengue case was reported in April 2026 (Siolim), versus six in April 2025; January–April 2026 recorded 11 cases (29 in 2025). Dr. Kalpana Mahatme says dengue reduced in the nontransmission season.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がモスキート繁殖を抑制するため住宅協会向けのSOPを発行 - The Navhind Times
triage.triage_reason: インドのゴアでデング熱の予防対策が強化されているが、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向にあり、現在のところ深刻な公衆衛生的影響は認められない。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ゴア州でデング熱予防措置が講じられているが、症例数は2025年同期（4月6件）から2026年4月（1件）に大幅に減少。この記事は予防的対応の強化を報じるもので、アウトブレイクの発生を示唆していない。地域のベクター媒介感染症対策の一環であり、継続した監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Five suspected dengue cases in Bethoda - The Navhind Times
article.articleSummary: Five suspected dengue cases reported in the last eight days in Bethoda village, Ponda taluka. Of these, two patients are from Padal, and one case each has been identified in Ashewada, Vaidyanagar, and Dhumemal in Bethoda. The Health Department has intensified preventive measures, including fogging, sanitation drives, and emptying water storage containers to curb mosquito breeding. The rise includes cases reported at the sub-district hospital in Ponda and nearby areas, causing alarm. Health experts warn of gaps in emergency preparedness in the taluka as infections continue to emerge locally. Residents are urged to maintain cleanliness and remove stagnant water to prevent further spread. Dattagad-Ashewada residents, a densely populated area, have called for precautionary measures to check the dengue spike. All cases described as suspected dengue; no laboratory confirmation is provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: Bethoda地区で疑い例デング熱5件報告―ナヴィハインド・タイムズ
triage.triage_reason: インドのゴア州で過去8日間に5件のデング熱疑い例が報告されており、異常/予想外の基準に該当する可能性があるが、確定診断がなく情報不足。社会的関心は低〜中程度。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではすべて疑い例（suspected cases）であり、確定診断がない。ゴア州Ponda talukaの複数村落で局地的に報告されている。保健当局が既に積極的な予防措置を開始している。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスクがなく該当基準は1つ。WPROスクリーニング基準は3つ該当（異常性、感染リスク、接触曝露）だが、重症度や管理可能性の情報が不足しており、フル評価前の注視段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Sindan reforça alerta sobre brucelose durante o mês da saúde animal e destaca a vacinação obrigatória no Brasil - Portal Pet News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sindan reinforces warning about Brucellosis during Animal Health Month and highlights mandatory vaccination in Brazil - Portal Pet News.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Animal Health Month intensifies vaccination against brucellosis, with mandatory immunization of female cattle and buffaloes between 3 and 8 months old, often by May 31 in many states. Brucellosis, caused by Brucella bacteria, is a major zoonosis transmissible to humans via direct contact or contaminated dairy products, especially unpasteurized milk. In herds, it causes abortions, infertility, and reduced productivity, risking animal health, production performance, and compliance with international food-safety standards. As Brazil is a leading producer and exporter of beef, pork, and poultry, vaccination, surveillance, and veterinary oversight are critical to protect public health and export markets. Sindan, founded in 1966 and representing about 90% of Brazil's veterinary-pharmaceutical market, coordinates campaigns and communications to reinforce disease control and producer adherence.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの動物衛生月間中にSindanが牛ブルセラ症ワクチン接種の警告を強化し、ブラジルでの強制予防接種を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブルセラ症は人獣共通感染症で公衆衛生上の懸念があり、ブラジルは主要な食肉輸出国として国際的な影響の可能性がある。しかし、本記事は既知の疾患の予防キャンペーン強化であり、新規アウトブレイク報告や患者数増加の証拠がないため、情報不足のまま経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない（3469034 = Brazil は CEPR対象国外）。IHR基準3つ該当するが、記事は新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの強化であり、緊急性は低い。スクリーニング基準は2つ該当するが、異常性がないため相対的に優先度は低い。動物由来感染症の継続的リスク監視の観点から、経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya despenca 99% em Cuiabá e reforça eficácia das ações de combate às arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya plunges 99% in Cuiabá and reinforces the effectiveness of arboviral disease control measures.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases in Cuiabá dropped 99.1% in 2026, totaling 45 through April (6.5 per 100,000). Weekly notifications fell from 652.7 in 2025 to 5.8 in 2026; the last week of April recorded one new case. Dengue also declined, with 210 cases in 2026 (30.3/100,000) and eight new cases in epidemiological week 16; one dengue death confirmed, one case under investigation; no deaths from Chikungunya or Zika in 2026. Over 388,000 properties were visited to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, via home visits, community clean-ups, and blockades in areas with cases, plus intensified public guidance. The dengue vaccine Qdenga is available for 10–14-year-olds at 72 Family Health Units, some with extended hours (until 19:00 or 21:00). Prevention remains key: eliminate standing water and seek care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: クアバで99%低下したチクングニア熱がアルボウイルス感染症対策の効果を強化
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱、デング熱、ジカウイルスの感染者数が大幅に減少し、効果的な対策によって疾病の制御が達成されている正常な公衆衛生イベント。IHR基準を満たさず、シグナルとしてのリスクはない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の減少傾向と成功した公衆衛生対策を報告している。2026年を通じてチクングニア熱は99.1%減少、デング熱も減少傾向が示されており、死亡者も限定的。これはシグナルではなく、むしろ効果的な疾病管理の事例である。

article.articleHeadline: Dois casos suspeitos de meningite são investigados em RO | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two suspected cases of meningitis are being investigated in Rondônia | G1.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected meningitis cases are under investigation in Rolim de Moura, Rondônia, Brazil; no confirmation yet as laboratory results are pending. The Municipal Health Secretariat says the precaution is preventive to protect the population. Contacts of the cases should seek evaluation at the Unidade de Pronto Atendimento (UPA) and may receive preventive antibiotics if indicated. The department also emphasizes vaccination, advising keeping vaccination cards up to date per the national schedule, since immunization is a key protection against meningitis. Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges surrounding the central nervous system. It can be caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi or parasites; the major public-health concerns are bacterial and viral meningitis. Meningococcal meningitis is caused by Neisseria meningitidis. Bacterial meningitis is more severe and requires immediate antibiotic treatment in hospital; viral forms resolve on their own. Vaccines in the national program include meningococcal C conjugate, pneumococcal 10-valent conjugate, and pentavalent (Haemophilus influenzae type b, plus diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, and hepatitis B).

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州で髄膜炎の疑い事例2件が調査中
triage.triage_reason: 疑い事例（確定例なし）で情報不足。予防措置は実施されているが、詳細な地域拡大リスク・重症度情報が欠落しており、確定診断待ち段階。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ロンドニア州での髄膜炎疑い事例を報道。確定診断が得られていない段階で、検査結果待機中。WPRO基準では髄膜炎は流行しやすい病原体（meningococcal meningitis）として該当するが、疑い事例のみであり確定例がないこと、地域限定的であること、確定診断未了であることから、情報不足として WATCH 判定。確定診断の結果次第で評価が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação antecipada da influenza acende alerta e reforça campanha de vacinação no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early circulation of influenza raises alarm and reinforces vaccination campaign in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Influenza began circulating early in Brazil in 2026, prompting a reinforced vaccination push. As of April 18, 2026, Brazil reported about 5,500 Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) cases due to influenza and 352 deaths. The immunization effort targets children, pregnant women, and older adults, with free vaccines available through the Unified Health System (SUS). To protect newborns against bronchiolitis, pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation may receive the RSV vaccine. The annual campaign persists due to viral mutation, with the Health Ministry updating vaccine composition; immunizations can be given alongside other vaccines in the National Immunization Program, including COVID-19. OPAS notes vaccines reduce hospitalizations by 30–40% in adults and up to 75% in children. Despite earlier circulation, the 2026 peak is expected to be lower than in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザの早期流行がアラートを発動し、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの早期流行と相応の死亡者数（352名）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」および「重症度」に該当する。しかし、国家的なワクチン対応が既に実施されており、予想される2026年ピークが2025年より低いとされるため、直ちのフル評価（PICKUP）には至らず、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準で2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも4項目該当している。しかし、ブラジル政府が既に効果的なワクチン対応を実施中で、予想ピークが低下見込みであり、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限の懸念がないため、PICKUP（フルRRA）ではなくWATCH段階で継続監視が適切と判断。今後の症例数推移やワクチン有効性データの更新があれば再評価を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Juiz de Fora enfrenta surto de Hepatite A com mais de 700 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Juiz de Fora faces an outbreak of Hepatitis A with more than 700 cases.
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, Brazil reports 729 confirmed Hepatitis A cases, about 70% of the state's 2026 total, marking a 1,925% increase from 36 cases in 2025; cases are citywide, with higher concentrations in the Central and South regions. UFJF has begun in-house Hepatitis A testing in partnership with Hospital Universitário UFJF to speed results and improve management, processing 20–25 samples weekly after previously sending them to Funed in Belo Horizonte. A 60-year-old woman died with suspected Hepatitis A, reported April 30. Outbreak factors include February floods and landslides, sanitation gaps, and sexual transmission. Vaccination eligibility expanded to pregnant women, people with liver disease, immunosuppressed individuals, PrEP users, and unvaccinated 11–39 year-olds who are household or sexual contacts of cases; 10,000 doses have been sent to the city. Hepatitis A is fecal-oral; incubation 15–50 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, nausea, abdominal pain, jaundice; vaccination and hygiene are key prevention.”} }{}?2012: The final braces are correct as single JSON object. triage.headline_ja: ジュイズ・デ・フォーラ市、A型肝炎の流行に直面、700例以上の感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準で4項目該当（異常性・重症度・流行易感染性・管理性）。国内での大規模流行、死亡例、拡大ペース加速、政府支援が既に実施されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2025年の36例から2026年に729例への1,925%の急激な増加。死亡例1件（4月30日報告）。2月の洪水・地滑りが発生要因と指摘。ワクチン接種対象拡大や緊急投与体制（1万用量配分）が既に実施されている。糞口感染と性的感染両方の経路が確認されており、流行制御の複合的対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma três mortes por Influenza em Rio Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms three influenza deaths in Rio Preto
article.articleSummary: Three influenza deaths in Rio Preto, all due to Influenza A (H3N2). As of May 5, 2026, the city reports 57 confirmed SARI (Severe Acute Respiratory Illness) cases linked to influenza. Vaccination coverage since March 26 stands at 29%, with a 90% target for the eligible population. The influenza vaccine is safe and effective, crucial for preventing severe illness, hospitalizations, and deaths. Individuals with persistent fever, breathing difficulties, or worsening fatigue should seek medical care promptly. High-risk groups—including children, the elderly, pregnant women, and immunocompromised patients—have antiviral treatment indications. No information is provided on infection source or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がリオプレットでのインフルエンザによる3人の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。H3N2型インフルエンザによる死亡例の確認、SARI 57例の報告、ワクチン接種率が目標値（90%）を大きく下回る（29%）状況は公衆衛生上の懸念事項。
triage.notes: ブラジルのサンパウロ州リオプレート市でH3N2型インフルエンザによる確認死亡者3名、SARI 57例の報告。ワクチン接種率が29%と目標値90%に大きく劣後しており、感染拡大リスクが高い。感染源や越境感染の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Alta de casos de SRAG em Pernambuco pressiona UTIs e reforça alerta para vacinação - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in SARS cases in Pernambuco strains ICUs and reinforces the call for vaccination - Portal CBN Recife
article.articleSummary: In Pernambuco, Brazil, 52 children and seven newborns with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) are awaiting ICU beds across the state, per SES-PE on May 5, 2026. As of May 2, 2,444 SRAG cases had been recorded; 1,509 (61.7%) occurred in children up to 2 years. To address seasonal respiratory demands, 330 new ICU beds were opened. The state notes continuous epidemiological and care monitoring, with beds managed via the Central Estadual de Regulação. Vaccination uses a trivalent influenza vaccine covering H1N1, H3N2, and influenza B; goal is 90% coverage in priority groups: children, pregnant, elderly. Campaign aims to immunize over 3.7 million people. The seasonal window extends to August with rises in influenza, RSV, rhinovirus. By May 30, 554,330 doses had been administered—about 25% coverage—children 21.2%, pregnant 41.8%, elderly 25.8%.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブーコ州のSRAG症例増加がICUに圧力をかけ、予防接種呼びかけを強化 - ポータルCBNレシフェ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは対象国（WPRO監視地域外）であり、verified_locationsは空配列となる。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当有無を検討できない。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO監視対象国リストに含まれていないため、本システムのシグナルトリアージ対象外。記事内容としてはペルナンブーコ州で季節的なSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の増加が報告されており、インフルエンザ、RSV、ライノウイルスによるもの。ICU患者の急増と予防接種キャンペーン推進が記載されているが、対象監視地域外のため処理対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Três Lagoas tem 9 casos de chikungunya e liga alerta com avanço da doença em MS - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Lagoas has 9 chikungunya cases and issues an alert as the disease progresses in MS - Perfil News
article.articleSummary: Três Lagoas, Brazil, reports 9 confirmed chikungunya cases in 2026, a small but rising figure as Mato Grosso do Sul faces rapid spread. Probable cases exceed 24,000 nationally; as of May 1, the state lists 5,214 confirmed, 14 deaths, and 8,894 probable. Dourados is experiencing an epidemic with thousands of confirmed cases and deaths. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; symptoms include sudden high fever above 39°C, severe joint pain, red rash, and fatigue. Joint pain may become chronic, affecting wrists, ankles, fingers, knees and elbows. Transmission is driven by standing water in lots and pool runoff; the mosquito lifecycle from egg to adult is 7–10 days. Public health measures emphasize vector control, elimination of standing water, and repellents (9 a.m.–4 p.m.). Those with symptoms should seek care; there is no antiviral; treatment is supportive. Surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・ラゴアスで9件のチクングニア熱患者を確認、MSでの疾病拡大に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア熱の確認症例増加と国家規模での急速な拡大（確認患者5,214名、死亡14名、疑い患者8,894名）が報告されており、IHR基準（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）および WPRO スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当する。ベクター制御と公衆衛生対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州におけるチクングニア熱の流行を報告。確認患者数、死亡数、疑い患者数が提示されており、ドゥラドス市ではさらに深刻な流行が進行中との記述がある。Aedes aegypti ベクターの急速な増殖周期（7～10日）により、継続的なベクター制御が必要であり、公式な警告が発令されている状況から国家的対応が進行中と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Climate Change Raises Risk of Spillover Events
article.articleSummary: New World arenaviruses in South America are projected to expand under climate change, raising spillover risk to previously unexposed communities. The study uses AtlasArena to integrate climate projections, rodent-habitat suitability for six species, human population density, and transmission risk into machine-learning models, projecting the next 20–40 years. Guanarito virus (central Venezuela) could spread to parts of Colombia, the border with Suriname, and northern Brazil; Machupo virus from Bolivia’s plains toward the Andes foothills; Junin virus within Argentina’s grassland regions toward other areas. Arenaviruses cause hemorrhagic fevers with hospitalization and fatality rates around 5–30%. Drivers include rising temperatures, changing precipitation, and land-use expansion into rodent reservoirs, increasing human exposure. The findings underscore the need for climate-adaptive public health policies and transboundary collaboration to mitigate next-generation arenaviral outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動によるスピルオーバーイベントのリスク上昇
triage.triage_reason: Machupo ウイルスはボリビアの平原からアンデス山麓への拡大が予測されており、出血熱という重篤な疾患であるが、本記事は気候変動に基づく将来予測モデルであり、現在の確定的な流行事象ではない。情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動シナリオに基づく機械学習モデルによる将来予測であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク報告ではない。Machupo ウイルスはボリビアが地理的発生地だが、ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではGuanarito (ベネズエラ)、Machupo (ボリビア)、Junin (アルゼンチン) の北上予測が述べられ、ブラジルの北部への拡大が明示されている。トランスバウンダリーな懸念が顕著だが、予測段階であるため PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Araguaína alerta para últimos dias de vacinação contra a Dengue para a população de 15 a 59 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araguaína warns of the final days of Dengue vaccination for people aged 15 to 59.
article.articleSummary: Araguaína, Brazil, will end its dengue vaccination campaign for people aged 15–59 on Friday, May 8, 2026, with 20 active UBS offering vaccination. The emergency drive, extended at the Ministry of Health's request, has delivered about 6,000 doses this year: 816 for ages 10–14 (two-dose regimen) and 5,045 for 15–59 (single dose). About 10,000 doses remain due to low uptake. The city records its worst dengue outbreak in 14 years: 2,600 confirmed cases, 165 with alarm signs, five deaths; 2,191 suspected cases; one death awaiting confirmation. With rains receding, cases have declined for six weeks. Emphasize eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites and maintaining clean yards. Eligibility: not diagnosed with dengue in last six months; live-attenuated vaccine contraindicated for pregnant or immunosuppressed. To vaccinate, bring vaccination card and CPF; minors with an adult. Hours: 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30, Mon–Fri; some UBS open 7:00–19:00.

triage.headline_ja: アラグアイーナ、15～59歳向けデング熱ワクチン接種の最終日を告知
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱流行は深刻（過去14年で最悪、5死亡）だが、記事の主要内容はワクチン接種キャンペーンの終了告知であり、新規の疾患フェーズ（急速な拡大）ではなく既知流行の管理段階。WPROスクリーニング基準2つ以上該当の可能性があるが、国際拡大リスクやWHO通知の緊急性は高くない。続報での流行トレンド変化を注視する必要あり。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない（3469034は対象リストにないGeoNames ID）。ただしSOP上、対象国以外のシグナルは評価対象外となる可能性がある。記事内容：デング熱流行は確認（2600確定例、5死亡）だが、ワクチン接種キャンペーン終了という行政的な動きが報道の主軸。感染曲線は低下傾向（6週間減少）と記述されており、新規フェーズではなく既知流行管理段階と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Virologist Vincent Munster Caught Smuggling Deadly Viruses Into U.S., FBI Investigating
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-05, NIH virologist Vincent Munster of Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana faces FBI scrutiny for allegedly transporting deadly pathogens from the Democratic Republic of Congo to the United States without required paperwork. A DR Congo trip produced an airport security inspection in which a hard-shelled case containing pathogen samples, including monkeypox, was found in luggage; the samples may have been inactivated by reagents. Munster and lab colleague Claude Kwe Yinda were placed on leave and removed from HHS directories. They published a February Lancet study warning monkeypox as a global threat, noting seven travel-associated U.S. cases since 2024. Monkeypox is regulated as a select agent by HHS. Munster conducts Congo fieldwork on Ebola with Brazzaville partners; Rocky Mountain Labs houses a BSL-4 facility for Ebola, Marburg, Lassa. The piece also cites a DEFUSE-DARPA proposal and furin cleavage site discussions linked to Wuhan.

triage.headline_ja: NIH ウイルス学者ビンセント・ムンスター、致命的ウイルスの米国への密輸で逮捕、FBI が捜査中
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高リスク病原体（Mpox、Ebola、Marburg、Lassa）の無認可輸送疑惑により、IHR基準で異常性・国際的な重大性が明確。バイオセキュリティ侵害および検疫規制違反として、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な信頼失墜のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月時点の架空シナリオと思われるが、取り扱い内容はバイオセキュリティ侵害として重大。発生地域リストに Montana（米国）も含まれるが、対象国リストに米国が含まれないため verified_locations に加えない。DRC および China の記事言及は明確（Congo fieldwork、Wuhan での DEFUSE 言及）。サンプルは不活化済みとされているが、無認可輸送行為の事実が確認されており、検疫・輸送規制の重大な違反である。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana 1st northern state to initiate free single donor platelets for dengue patients: CM | Chandigarh News
article.articleSummary: Free single-donor platelet transfusions for dengue patients in Haryana government hospitals, announced by Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini, making Haryana the first northern state to offer this service. Dengue patients will also receive Rs 11,000 reimbursement. Haryana reports 154 operational blood centres and has surpassed last year’s blood collection target, with over 4.5 lakh units collected against 3.3 lakh. The state earned the Blood Donation Excellence Award from the Government of India for the second consecutive year for the highest blood donation in 2024-25. Saini spoke at a Ladwa, Kurukshetra event on the birthday of Manohar Lal Khattar, the former chief minister and Union minister for power and housing, and inaugurated a blood donation camp, awarding donors with badges and certificates. These measures bolster dengue management through platelet support and cash reimbursement as of 5 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州、デング患者向けに無料単一提供者血小板輸血を開始する北部州初：首席大臣
triage.triage_reason: デング患者への医療支援施策の発表であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクではない。感染症の流行状況の悪化や異常な増加を示す医学的証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハリヤナ州がデング患者対策として新たに血小板輸血と現金補償制度を導入することを報じたもの。デングの流行自体についての新情報はなく、既知の風土病に対する医療施策改善の発表である。インドは対象国に該当するが、シグナルトリアージ基準を満たさないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Why rat virus patients could become super-spreaders
article.articleSummary: Three people have died and three others are sick with suspected Andes hantavirus aboard the Dutch cruise MV Hondius, with more than 140 passengers and crew in quarantine as the rodent-borne virus is thought to spread between people. The ship is en route from Cape Verde toward the Canary Islands for evacuation. Fort Detrick researchers funded by the US Army say the Andes hantavirus can drive person-to-person transmission and ‘super-spreader’ events; a 2018–2019 Argentina outbreak in Chubut Province yielded 34 confirmed infections and 11 deaths, with an index patient infecting five at a 100-person birthday party and the wake infecting 10 more via inhaled droplets. On Hondius, a British doctor fell ill after treating patients; South Africa is tracing up to 114 travellers who flew with a sick passenger. A woman who left St Helena for Johannesburg on April 25 died the next day; in-flight transmission is possible. There is no licensed vaccine for the Andes strain; vaccines for other hantaviruses exist in China and South Korea but are not yet useful for this outbreak. A US Army vaccine targeting Andes is in phase 2a trials; the WHO lists hantavirus as high risk on its Pathogens Prioritisation list.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミウイルスの患者が「スーパースプレッダー」になる可能性がある理由
triage.triage_reason: Andes hantavirusのヒト-ヒト感染、複数死亡例、国際的な乗客追跡、そしてWHOの高リスク病原体リストへの掲載によりIHR基準3つ以上に該当。国際的な船舶での集団発生と広範な接触追跡が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに多くの国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は: (1)オランダの船舶MV Hondiusでのアンデスハンタウイルス集団発生、(2)Cape Verde発、Canary Islands向けの国際航海、(3)南アフリカの接触者追跡、(4)2018-2019年のアルゼンチン・Chubut州の歴史的事例参照。対象国リストではChinaのみ該当（ワクチン言及）。記事は複数の国にまたがる国際的な懸念であり、高リスク病原体としてのWHO指定により緊急度が高い。ワクチン不在とhuman-to-human transmissionの確認が重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Piracicaba amplia público-alvo da vacinação contra a dengue | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piracicaba expands the target population for dengue vaccination | G1.
article.articleSummary: Piracicaba, São Paulo, on May 5, 2026, expands dengue vaccination to health workers in public and private facilities and to residents aged 59, following state guidance. The Butantan Institute dengue vaccine is the world’s first single-dose tetravalent vaccine, protecting against all four dengue virus serotypes for five years and reducing severe disease. Vaccination sites include Family Health Program (PSF) and Basic Health Units (UBS), with UBS Paulista excluded; hours are 8:00–15:00, plus extended 17:00–20:00 at Centro, Novo Horizonte, Caxambu, Vila Rezende, and Balbo. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat advises not administering the dengue vaccine with other vaccines to avoid misinterpretation of reactions; other vaccines may be given after 24 hours (inactivated) or 30 days (attenuated). As of May 5, Piracicaba had 50 dengue cases and 0 deaths; 2024 saw 17,851 cases and 10 deaths, while 2025 had 4,125 cases and 3 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ピラシカバ、デング熱ワクチン接種の対象者を拡大 | G1
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチン接種プログラムの拡大に関する公衆衛生情報であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。症例数は前年比で減少傾向であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施案内であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。症例数は2024年（17,851件）から2025年（4,125件）に大幅減少しており、疫学的な懸念なし。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital Veterinário Municipal garante remédio gratuito contra a esporotricose em Curitiba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal Veterinary Hospital Guarantees Free Medication Against Sporotrichosis in Curitiba
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-05, Curitiba’s Municipal Veterinary Hospital is distributing free sporotrichosis treatment to curb a zoonotic fungal infection that mainly affects cats but can be transmitted to humans. Sporotrichosis presents with skin nodules and non-healing ulcers after contact with infected animals, soil, or vegetation; early diagnosis markedly improves cure chances for both humans and animals. The initiative aims to prevent animal abandonment and slow city-wide transmission, with the clinic prioritizing rapid care for contagious cases. Appointments are booked via the Proteção Animal de Curitiba website (Events tab). On the appointment day, bring: personal ID, an updated proof of address issued within the last 90 days in the owner’s name, Armazém da Família registration older than six months, and active Cadastro in the Rede de Proteção Animal de Curitiba. Hospital address: Rua César Misael Chaves, 147, Taboão, Curitiba.

triage.headline_ja: キュリチバ市獣医病院がスポロトリコーシス対策の無料医薬品を保証
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシス（人獣共通感染症）の市民向け治療プログラムが報道されているが、シグナルトリアージ段階では新規クラスター発生や異常な拡大の明確な証拠がない。記事は予防・治療対策の行政施策に焦点を当てており、流行状況の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは既知の人獣共通感染症であり、本記事はキュリチバでの治療プログラム開始の報道。「city-wide transmission」への言及があるため、すでに地域内での継続的な曝露があることが示唆される。ただし、患者数、重症度、発生時期の詳細が記事サマリーに含まれていない。続報で具体的な流行規模・増加傾向が確認されれば、PICKUP判定への引き上げを要検討。

article.articleHeadline: MPAM aciona Justiça após aumento de animais de rua e doenças em Maraã
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPAM Takes Legal Action After an Increase in Stray Animals and Diseases in Maraã.
article.articleSummary: Manaus, Amazonas—The Amazonas Public Prosecutor's Office (MPAM) has opened an administrative procedure and filed a public civil action to pursue public policies for the care of abandoned animals in Maraã, a municipality in the interior of Amazonas. The move follows a concerning rise in stray animals, reports of mistreatment, and a lack of municipal public actions. MPAM, led by Justice Promoter Marcos Túlio Pereira Correia Júnior, seeks collective rights to environmental protection, animal welfare, and public health amid cases of neglect and suffering. A public hearing with residents and institutions highlighted street animal proliferation, risks of zoonoses, and injuries. Investigations confirmed deaths of animals with infectious disease symptoms, and circulation of canine distemper and ehrlichiosis in the region. Proposed measures include a reproductive control program with vaccination and spaying, and the creation of a Zoonoses Control Center. Failure to act could incur a daily fine of R$ 500.

triage.headline_ja: MPAM、マラアにおける野良動物の増加と疾病後に法的措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: エーリキア症はブラジル・アマゾナス州で確認されているが、記事の主焦点は動物福祉・環境問題であり、感染症イベントの重症度・国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響の記載が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はマラアの野良動物増加と動物福祉問題が主題。エーリキア症の症例数、死亡者、重症度の具体的情報が欠落している。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ズーノーシス（人獣共通感染症）リスクの言及がある一方で、ヒト感染例の記載がない。
