article.articleHeadline: Variante da influenza em Sergipe: Lacen confirma subclado k | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza variant in Sergipe: LACEN confirms subclade K | G1
article.articleSummary: May 5, 2026: Sergipe's Laboratório Central de Saúde Pública (Lacen/SE) confirms circulation of influenza A (H3N2) variant subclade K. Detection occurred during surveillance of flu activity via sample analysis in partnership with Fiocruz. Subclade K is a genetic subdivision linked to an uptick in influenza-like illness in the current season and has now been reported in nearly all Brazilian states. No exact case counts are provided. Authorities emphasize vaccination as primary prevention, urging the public to stay up to date with immunization, monitor for symptoms, and seek care at a Basic Health Unit (UBS) if symptoms appear. In Sergipe, influenza vaccination is available for priority groups at UBS across 75 municipalities to prevent severe disease and hospitalizations.

triage.headline_ja: セルジッペ州のインフルエンザ変異株：LACEN（セルジッペ州中央公衆衛生研究所）が亜系統Kを確認
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA（H3N2）亜系統Kのブラジル全体での流行と流行性を示す兆候が認められるが、具体的な症例数、重症度、致命率などの重要な情報が不足しており、フルリスク評価前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はセルジッペ州での亜系統Kの確認を報道しており、ブラジル全域での流行が示唆されている。ただし、症例数、入院数、死亡数などの具体的な重症度指標が記載されていない。インフルエンザA（H3N2）の一般的な流行性と、ワクチン接種の推奨という公式対応が示されているため、WATCHレベルでの継続監視が適当。国際的拡大のリスクや渡航制限への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza fabricação nacional de vacina contra Chikungunya pelo Butantan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes domestic production of a Chikungunya vaccine by Butantan.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa authorized domestic production of IXCHIQ, a Chikungunya vaccine developed by Instituto Butantan with Valneva, enabling in-country manufacture in Brazil. The national version is approved for use and can be integrated into SUS. Indicated for adults 18–59 in high-exposure areas, the live attenuated vaccine has contraindications for pregnancy, immunodeficiency, or immunosuppression. Initial approval in April 2025 relied on Valneva facilities; the new resolution designates Butantan as the production site, with formulation and filling conducted under strict quality controls. IXCHIQ is the first globally registered Chikungunya vaccine. Brazil’s production aims to expand public supply. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and has been present in Brazil since 2014, now circulating in all states. PAHO reports about 620,000 global cases in 2025; Brazil logged over 127,000 cases and 125 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisaがブタンタン研究所によるチクングニア熱ワクチンの国内製造を承認
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はチクングニア熱ワクチン製造承認というプラスの公衆衛生政策決定であり、新たな感染症の発生や流行ではない。既知の風土病に対する予防医学的な対応であり、即時的な危機管理シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedotが検出した発生地域（Brazil）は行政データベースヒットであるが、記事サマリーの実質的内容はワクチン製造政策であり、ブラジルでの新規感染症イベント発生ではない。ブラジルはWPRO地域対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。既知の地風病に対する予防的措置であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde lança calculadora digital para auxiliar viajantes na prevenção contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health launches digital calculator to help travelers prevent measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles Immunological Window Calculator launched in Paraná, Brazil on May 5, 2026, via Saúde do Viajante to determine if travelers have enough time (≈15 days) for the measles vaccine to confer immunity before departure; if not, vaccination should occur ASAP, including on travel day, with masks and alcohol-based hand sanitizer during transit. Paraná has had no confirmed measles cases since 2020, but risk persists due to circulation in neighboring regions and abroad. This year Brazil reported two imported cases: a 6‑month‑old child in São Paulo (travel history to Bolivia) and a 22‑year‑old woman in Rio de Janeiro; Paraná: 42 cases notified, 40 discarded, 2 under investigation. Symptoms include fever, rash, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis. The MMR vaccine is free via SUS; vaccination coverage targets 95%. Dosing: Dose Zero (6–<12 months) for travel to Canada/Mexico/US; 12 months; 15 months; two doses up to 29 years; at least one dose (30–59 years).

triage.headline_ja: 保健局が麻疹予防のための旅行者向けデジタル計算機を発表
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例が報告されており、地域内での流行リスクが存在するが、現在のイベントは主にワクチン啓発キャンペーンであり、確実な流行や重症例の集団発生は報告されていない。情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジル（パラナ州）における麻疹予防キャンペーンであり、ボリビアへの渡航歴を持つ輸入症例が報告されている。パラナ州では2020年以降確定症例がないが、隣接地域および海外での流行リスクが指摘されている。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」（近隣地域での循環）と「流行可能性」（高い接種率目標達成が必要）に該当するため要経過観察。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Rio Preto confirma três mortes por gripe H3N2; vítimas sem vacina | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Preto confirms three deaths from H3N2 flu; unvaccinated victims | G1
article.articleSummary: Three deaths attributed to influenza A (H3N2) occurred in São José do Rio Preto, São Paulo, Brazil, with all fatalities recorded in April and all victims unvaccinated. The deceased include a child aged 1–4, a woman aged 60–69, and an adolescent aged 10–18. The Rio Preto health department reported the deaths and noted ongoing vaccination campaigns, which began March 26 and have reached 29% coverage (16.6% of children, 32.6% of seniors, 37.7% of pregnant people); the goal is at least 90%. Common symptoms include fever, breathing difficulty, and severe fatigue; seek prompt medical care. In 2025, Rio Preto recorded 11 April deaths, with a more than 72% reduction compared to 2026. Previous year total deaths were 35, with most having comorbidities such as cardiovascular disease and diabetes.

triage.headline_ja: リオプレト、H3N2インフルエンザによる3人の死亡を確認、被害者はワクチン未接種
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA（H3N2）による死亡例の報告は異常・予想外であり（通常流行期外の5月報告）、重症度が高い（死亡例複数、多様な年齢層を含む）。予防接種カバレッジが目標値（90%）に対し29%と低いため管理可能性に懸念あり。IHR基準で2つ以上該当、WPRO基準で複数該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国外だが、IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当のため PICKUP判定。記事は2026年5月配信だが、死亡はすべて4月に発生。予防接種カバレッジの低さ（29%）と複数死亡例の報告は感染症管理上の懸念を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: San Guillermo: entrega de insumos para la Prevención del DENGUE a localidades del dpto. San Cristóbal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: San Guillermo: Delivery of supplies for dengue prevention to localities in the San Cristóbal Department.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention supplies were distributed in the San Cristóbal Department, Argentina, under the provincial Objetivo Dengue program to bolster prevention and control across the department. The event was led by Cristian Cunha (Secretary of Cooperation) and Senator Felipe Michlig, with Mayor Romina López, and included representatives from 27 of 32 localities (e.g., San Guillermo, Suardi, Ceres, Hersilia, Villa Trinidad, Arrufó, La Lucila, Ñanducita, La Clara, Curupaity, Monte Oscuridad, Colonia Bossi, La Legua, Moisés Ville). Officials highlighted that only one dengue case has occurred recently in Suardi, contracted abroad (Islas Maldivas), with rapid local intervention preventing further spread. The vector is present year-round; emphasis on prevention and coordinated actions across municipalities. San Cristóbal was the first department to initiate dengue vaccination and to receive supplies. Distributed items include DEPE for fumigation; repellents produced and stocked at LIF; backpacks for application and thermal fogging equipment, to strengthen responses to risk situations and suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ギエルモ：サン・クリストバル県の自治体へのデング熱予防物資の配給
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンの予防・防蕩活動についての記事であり、現在の活発な流行の存在を示す指標がない。確認されたのは外地由来の単発事例で、地域の制御可能性が実証されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで抽出された位置情報には、アルゼンチン（対象国外）、ペルー（対象国外）、メキシコ（対象国外）、トリニダード・トバゴ（対象国外）が含まれている。記事の主体はアルゼンチンのサン・クリストバル県における予防供給配給であり、該当対象国は記事サマリーに言及されるフィリピン（Cagayan Valley地域など）のみである。ただし、記事の実質的な主題はアルゼンチンの予防活動であり、フィリピンは単に地理的座標として抽出されたものと考えられ、実質的なシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirüs ölümcül mü, Türkiye'de Hantavirüs var mı? Hantavirüs insandan insana bulaşır mı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is Hantavirus deadly? Is Hantavirus present in Turkey? Can Hantavirus be transmitted from person to person?
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus is a rodent-borne virus that can cause fever, muscle pains, and respiratory issues; severe cases may progress to kidney failure and respiratory failure. In Turkey, hantavirus cases have been rare, with the first clinically and serologically confirmed outbreak occurring in February 2009 in the Zonguldak-Bartın region. Transmission occurs via inhalation of aerosolized rodent excreta (dried urine, droppings, saliva). The article notes that hantaviruses are not transmitted person-to-person; specifically, an expert cites that Old World hantaviruses associated with fatalities in China do not spread between people, suggesting no expectation of an international pandemic. Overall, there is no indication of widespread circulation in Turkey beyond historically limited zoonotic cases.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスは致命的か、トルコにハンタウイルスは存在するか？ハンタウイルスは人から人へ感染するか？
triage.triage_reason: 記事はハンタウイルスに関する一般的な情報提供（致命性、伝播経路、トルコでの歴史的発生状況）であり、現在の流行やアウトブレイクを示す具体的なシグナルを含んでいない。IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが中国(China)を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーは中国での歴史的なハンタウイルス死亡事例を言及する程度であり、中国での現在のイベント発生を示していない。記事の主題はトルコでのハンタウイルス情報提供であり、トルコは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。一般的な公衆衛生情報記事として分類。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Jundiaí revê caso de gripe aviária após novo laudo técnico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Jundiaí re-evaluates a case of avian influenza after a new technical report.
article.articleSummary: Jundiaí, São Paulo, Brazil: On May 5, 2026, the city corrected an earlier avian influenza confirmation, stating there is no record of avian influenza in the municipality. Previously, on April 30, authorities had announced a case after samples from a wild bird received on April 25 by Associação Mata Ciliar (the bird originated from another municipality) tested positive for avian influenza. A newer laboratory report from state agencies, however, indicates only the presence of Influenza A and rules out both Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza and Low Pathogenicity avian influenza. Consequently, the epidemiological investigation has been closed by the competent bodies. The latest official statement confirms no ongoing avian influenza case in Jundiaí.

triage.headline_ja: ジュンジャイ：新しい技術レポート後に鳥インフルエンザケースを再評価
triage.triage_reason: 初期報告は撤回され、鳥インフルエンザ感染は否定された。高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）および低病原性鳥インフルエンザは除外され、単にインフルエンザAのみが検出された。公衆衛生上の懸念はなく、流行リスクは存在しない。
triage.notes: 初期報告（2026年4月30日）での鳥インフルエンザ確認は、後続の州機関の検査報告（2026年5月5日）により完全に覆された。高病原性・低病原性ともに除外され、インフルエンザA単独の検出のみ。疫学的調査は終了し、継続的な懸念なし。野生鳥からのサンプルであり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza produção de vacina contra Chikungunya  | Rdnews - Principais notícias de Cuiabá, Várzea Grande e Mato grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes production of a vaccine against Chikungunya | Rdnews - Top news from Cuiabá, Várzea Grande and Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya IXCHIQ vaccine, produced by Instituto Butantan in partnership with Valneva, has Anvisa authorization to manufacture in Brazil. The vaccine, registered in April 2025 and previously produced abroad by Valneva, will be domestically manufactured and may be incorporated into the SUS. It is indicated for adults aged 18–59 at high exposure risk. Butantan becomes an official production site, enabling part of the process to be carried out locally, with the same formulation and packaging adapted for Brazil. The vaccine is contraindicated for pregnant women and for immunodeficient or immunosuppressed individuals. Chikungunya is an arbovirus transmitted by Aedes aegypti; introduced to the Americas in 2013, sparking major epidemics in Central America and the Caribbean. In Brazil, transmission was detected in Amapá and Bahia in 2014, and all states now report transmission. In 2025, PAHO reported about 620,000 global cases; Brazil registered over 127,000 cases and 125 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisaがチクングニア症ワクチン製造を承認 | Rdnews - クイアバ、ヴァルゼア・グランデ、マット・グロッソの主要ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア症ワクチン製造承認という公衆衛生の進展事象であり、社会的関心がある。しかし本記事は感染症の新規発生や急増ではなく、ワクチン製造認可の報道であるため、直ちにフルRRAを要するシグナルではなく経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントはチクングニア症の新規発生や急増ではなく、ブラジルでのワクチン製造承認という公衆衛生政策の進展を報道している。記事では2025年にPAHOが約62万件の世界的症例を報告、ブラジルが12万7千件以上の症例と125人の死亡を登録したことが記載されているが、これは背景情報であり、本記事の主題ではない。スペイン（カナリア諸島）の発生地域情報は含まれるが、記事サマリーに明記されていないため、また対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Suzano inicia vacinação contra dengue para moradores de 59 anos  | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suzano begins dengue vaccination for 59-year-old residents | G1.
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Suzano offers dengue vaccination to residents aged 59 at 24 Basic Health Units (UBS) or Family Health Units (USF). The Butantan-DV dengue vaccine, produced by Instituto Butantan, is used to broaden coverage and optimize doses in stock. Previously, vaccination was limited to children and adolescents aged 10–14 and health professionals. Eligible residents must present an identification document, SUS card, and vaccination booklet. Contraindications include allergy to vaccine components, immunodeficiency, ongoing corticosteroid treatment, fever, or recent receipt (within 30 days) of another attenuated vaccine. The initiative aims to expand dengue prevention by improving accessibility for older adults.

triage.headline_ja: スザーノ市が59歳の住民向けデング熱予防接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防接種プログラム拡大に関するルーチンな公衆衛生イベント。新規の流行や異常な発生ではなく、既知の疾患に対する管理策の実施段階であり、IHR基準および緊急性の高いスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国（GeoNames ID 3469034）リストに含まれていません。したがってverified_locationsは空配列となります。記事はデング熱の既知疾患に対する予防接種拡大キャンペーンに関するもので、新規の流行イベント（signal）ではなく、ルーチンな公衆衛生対応です。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi: Erratic rain, rising temperatures drive spike in dengue cases, mosquito density
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 107 confirmed dengue cases so far in 2026, with 52 in April; 87 untraced and 32 acquired from other states, as of 6 May 2026. This April was the wettest in 18 years, at 30 mm rainfall. 2,443 larval sites were found in the past week; 15,649 breeding instances were recorded Jan 1–May 3, with 15% in the past week. Aedes aegypti is the primary vector, and erratic rain plus rising temperatures have boosted mosquito density; heat above 35°C accelerates breeding, while clogged drains and stagnant water sustain it. In total this year, Delhi reports 29 malaria cases (five in the past week) and five chikungunya cases (two last week). Dengue’s spread includes 32 imported cases from other states. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi issued 16,261 legal notices, pursued prosecutions in 1,712 cases, and issued ₹50,000+ challans in 358 cases, with recoveries over ₹1 lakh.

triage.headline_ja: デリー：不規則な降雨と気温上昇がデング熱患者数と蚊密度の急増を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの複数蚊媒介感染症が同時発生し、環境要因（異常気象）による媒介蚊密度の急増が確認されている。ただし死亡報告がなく重症度情報が不明であること、および国内での局所的発生であることから、現段階ではフルRRA前の継続監視が適切と判断される。
triage.notes: 異常気象（18年ぶりの多雨）による媒介蚊密度の急増と複数蚊媒介感染症の同時増加が特徴。ただし死亡例の記載がなく、また患者数は相対的に限定的（デング熱107例、マラリア29例、チクングニア5例）。デリー市当局による積極的な防虫対策（法的警告16,261件、罰金徴収）が実施されている。続報で重症度・死亡例の有無、流行の持続性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒進入好發季 D68型恐流行 - 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses Enter Peak Season; D68 Strain Feared to Spark an Outbreak - Lifestyle
article.articleSummary: Taiwan is in the enterovirus peak season, with the Taiwan CDC forecasting a June surge and a summer outbreak easing after holidays. Last week reported 3,814 enterovirus-related ED visits; four severe infections this year include two D68 cases. D68 differs from other enteroviruses: symptoms resemble a cold, often without rash or mouth ulcers, and can invade the central nervous system; there is no vaccine to prevent D68 (EV71 vaccine exists). Two severe D68 cases: a 5-year-old boy with leg weakness and myelitis, and a man in his 30s with encephalitis. The last D68 outbreak in Taiwan was three years ago. Locally, Coxsackie A6 is currently the most common strain, with A4 and A16 also present. Nearby, Vietnam, China, and Singapore report rising activity; Vietnam has over 34,400 cases and 8 deaths as of April, driven largely by EV71. Public guidance emphasizes monitoring infants and schoolchildren for severe signs, keeping sick children home, and strict hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒進入好發季 D68型恐流行
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・ベトナム・中国・シンガポールで腸病毒（EV71、EV-D68を含む）の活動が増加しており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」が該当し、政府・公衆衛生当局の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 台湾はWPRO加盟国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。シンガポールも同様。ベトナムは34,400例以上かつ8死亡を報告。EV71とEV-D68の両者が関与。中央神経系への侵襲と重症例の報告あり。ワクチンがないEV-D68についての言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por hantavirus en crucero: cómo se transmite, síntomas y qué tan peligroso es
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus alert on a cruise ship: how it is transmitted, symptoms, and how dangerous it is.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on an Atlantic-crossing cruise aboard Oceanwide Expeditions has killed three people (a Dutch couple and a German citizen) with several passengers ill. As of May 5, 2026, the World Health Organization indicated possible person-to-person transmission on the ship, though this is considered rare. The voyage departed Ushuaia, Argentina, last month and traveled toward Cape Verde, with stops on remote Atlantic islands. Transmission typically occurs when people inhale dried rodent feces particles or touch contaminated surfaces; less commonly via rodent bites. Early symptoms resemble flu—fatigue, fever, chills, muscle pains—progressing to severe respiratory failure, organ failure, and death. There is no specific antiviral; care is supportive. Prevention focuses on rodent exclusion and safe cleanup (gloves, mask, bleach solution, 5-minute wait). Global estimates: 60,000–100,000 HFRS cases annually, ~half in China; 890 US cases (1993–2023). WHO is sequencing the virus and investigating routes of exposure, including possible shipboard transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス警報：感染経路、症状、危険性について
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響：死亡3名、予想外：船上での人人感染の可能性、国際拡大リスク：大西洋横断航海）。WPRO基準も複数該当。国際的に重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: クルーズ船（Oceanwide Expeditions）はアルゼンチン・ウシュアイア出発、ケープベルデ向けの大西洋横断航海。死亡3名（オランダ系カップル1組、ドイツ人1名）、複数乗客罹患。WHO が船上での人人感染可能性を指摘しており、ハンタウイルスにおいて極めて異常。アルゼンチンで接触または感染し、中国への言及は背景統計情報（全球年間60,000-100,000例、約半数は中国）と考えられるため、実際の発生地は主にアルゼンチン（出発地）。ケープベルデは記事で立ち寄り先として言及されるが、症例発生の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: SES amplia estratégia de vacinação contra chikungunya em Mato Grosso do Sul - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Secretariat Expands Chikungunya Vaccination Strategy in Mato Grosso do Sul - Perfil News.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination expansion in Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil, includes Amambai, Batayporã, Douradina and Sete Quedas, with 14,400 doses reallocated from Dourados to be distributed proportionally to population. The expansion follows a Ministry of Health–driven plan (CGARB) and builds on an initial rollout that began April 16 with 20,000 IXCHIQ doses for Dourados and Itaporã. The vaccine is a single-dose, live attenuated immunization indicated for people aged 18–59; it is contraindicated for pregnant or puerperal individuals, immunocompromised persons, those with uncontrolled chronic diseases, and individuals with severe allergic reactions to vaccine components. Doses will be stored at the Núcleo Regional de Saúde de Dourados and administered gradually by municipal health secretariats. The strategy seeks to maximize vaccine use, expand coverage, and reinforce arboviroses defense, while stressing mosquito control and public engagement to eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱ワクチン接種戦略を拡大 - Perfil News
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱のワクチン接種展開に関する記事で、予防的な保健対応を扱っている。既知の感染症の定常的な公衆衛生介入であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、急速な感染拡大の兆候は認められない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準での該当がない。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱の予防接種キャンペーンの拡大に関するもので、新たな感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ブラジル保健省主導の計画的なワクチン配布戦略である。トリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Manaus registra mais de 350 bebês com sífilis congênita em um ano - Portal Em Tempo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Manaus records more than 350 babies with congenital syphilis in one year - Portal Em Tempo.
article.articleSummary: Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil reports 351 congenital syphilis cases in children under one year in 2025, with 66 new confirmed cases in the first months of 2026, per the Epidemiological Bulletin. The Municipal Committee for Prevention of Vertical Transmission (Semsa) notes that 90.5% of mothers of infants with congenital syphilis in 2025 had inadequate or no treatment. Diagnosis occurs late in many cases, with 55.5% identified at delivery or curettage; ideal screening is in the first trimester to enable treatment before birth. Treponema pallidum causes syphilis and untreated maternal infection can be fatal or cause irreversible child damage. From 2020 to 2025, Manaus logged more than 11,000 syphilis cases in pregnant women, and 2025 saw a 30% increase versus 2024. In the general population (age 13+), 63.7% of syphilis cases in 2025 were male. Semsa urges four testing points during pregnancy (first, second, third trimesters, and at delivery); primary health units offer rapid tests and free treatment.

triage.headline_ja: マナウスが1年間で350人以上の先天性梅毒児を報告 - ポータルエムテンポ
triage.triage_reason: 先天性梅毒の大規模集団発生（1年間に351例、2026年初頭に66例追加）であり、予防可能な母子感染疾患でありながら高い罹患率を示しており、異常/予想外であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: マナウス（アマゾナス州）での先天性梅毒の増加傾向が顕著。2025年には妊娠中の梅毒患者が2024年比30%増加。母親の90.5%が不十分または治療なしの状態であり、システム的な医療アクセス・診断の課題が存在する。予防可能な母子感染疾患の大規模発生として、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 38 Filipinos among crew of hantavirus-hit ship
article.articleSummary: MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak off Cape Verde in the Atlantic. As of 4 May 2026, seven cases (two lab-confirmed, five suspected) have been identified, including three deaths, one critically ill, and three with mild symptoms. The 147-person ship—88 passengers, 61 crew, including 38 Filipino crew—saw illness onset 6–28 April 2026, with fever, gastrointestinal symptoms and rapid progression to pneumonia, ARDS and shock. Three passengers were medically evacuated; the vessel remains anchored off Cape Verde with disembarkation undecided, while options include sending the ship to Las Palmas or Tenerife for screening. The WHO says there may be human-to-human transmission among close contacts, and that an index case might have been infected before boarding. The Philippine DOH reports no illnesses among its 38 Filipino crew and deems national risk low; repatriation is the operator’s responsibility. hantavirus is linked to rat urine/feces exposure; 1992 cases are being reviewed.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染の船舶で38人のフィリピン人乗組員を含む
triage.triage_reason: 国際輸送中の船舶におけるハンタウイルス集団感染で、死亡3例を含む重症者が発生し、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が指摘されている。複数国の乗員・乗客が関与し、国際的な拡散リスク、寄港地選定に関わる国際的課題がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてIowa、Florida、スペイン領カナリア諸島、カーボベルデが指定されているが、イベント本体はアフリカ沖大西洋の船舶上での集団感染である。フィリピン人乗組員38名が関与し、フィリピン保健省が対応を監視している点から、Philippines を verified_locations に含める。スペイン領カナリア諸島への寄港オプションが言及されているが、スペインは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。事例レビュー対象（1992年事例）との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Controle de Arboviroses inicia nova Avaliação de Densidade Larvária em Sumaré - Novo Momento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviral Disease Control Begins a New Larval-Density Assessment in Sumaré - Novo Momento
article.articleSummary: Sumaré's Health Department begins the second 2026 Larval-Density Assessment (ADL) to map Aedes aegypti larvae, vectors of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Teams survey Nova Veneza, Dall’Orto, Volobueff, Picerno, João Paulo and Área Cura, with citywide coverage to identify high-risk areas and guide intensified control. Agents visit homes, collect larvae, and record findings to shape epidemiological planning. The January 2026 Breteau index was 4.7, signaling imminent epidemic risk, with Maria Antônia reporting the highest infestation. Through 2026, Sumaré records 709 dengue notifications and 82 confirmed cases, no deaths. In addition to routine visits, actions include larviciding, removal of materials, and distribution of fine-mesh screens, plus Dia D mobilization in March. Residents receive guidance on symptoms and prevention. Preventive measures at home include sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters, eliminating standing water, washing of water storage containers, placing sand in plant saucers, storing bottles inverted, and proper waste disposal; community participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス病対策がスマレで幼虫密度評価を開始 - ノーボモメント
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱・チクングニア・ジカ熱の幼虫密度監視活動の報道。公衆衛生への関心があるが、現在のところ急速な流行拡大の兆候が明確ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はスマレ市（ブラジル、サンパウロ州）における予防的な幼虫密度調査（ADL）の実施報道。2026年1月のブレトー指数4.7は流行リスクを示唆しているが、現在の感染数は限定的（709件の通知、82件確認、死亡0件）。この活動は対応的・予防的性質であり、現時点ではIHR基準を満たさないが、WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当する。継続的な監視が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: "No somos solo titulares, somos personas con gente que nos espera en casa": pasajeros del crucero con brote de hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We're not just headlines, we're people with loved ones waiting for us at home": cruise ship passengers with a hantavirus outbreak
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius off Cape Verde involves 7 cases among 147–149 people onboard (passengers and crew) since departing Argentina on April 1. Two cases are laboratory-confirmed; five remain suspected. Three deaths, one patient in critical condition, and three with mild symptoms are reported. The ship carries 23 nationalities, including the largest groups of Filipinos (38), Brits (23), Americans (17), and Spaniards (14); one Argentine passenger and one Guatemalan crew member are also on board. Spain will host the vessel in the Canary Islands under WHO guidance, with the gravely ill patient to be evacuated there; the EU’s ECDC is assessing urgent evacuations while others are examined and cared for in Canary Islands in 3–4 days. OMS notes the general population risk as low but maintains epidemiological surveillance; hantavirus is linked to rodent excreta, and treatment is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちは単なる見出しではなく、家で待つ愛する者がいる人間です」：ハンタウイルス発生クルーズ船の乗客たち
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。多国籍乗客147-149名が乗船し、3名の死亡を含む7確認症例があり、複数国での上陸・健康管理が必要となる国際的イベント。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストには複数国が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は、アルゼンチアから出港したクルーズ船MV Hondius（ケープベルデ沖）でのハンタウイルス発生イベント。対象国リストから該当するのはフィリピンのみ（乗客38名が最大グループ）。スペイン、アルゼンチア、グアテマラ、米国、英国はいずれも対象国外。3名の死亡、1名の重篤患者がおり、カナリア諸島での上陸・医療対応と複数国への乗客分散に伴う疫学調査が必要。WHO及びECDCが対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya recua nas aldeias de Dourados, mas cenário ainda preocupa autoridades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya recedes in Dourados' villages, but the situation still concerns health authorities.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya shows a retreat in Dourados’ Indigenous Reserve villages Bororó and Jaguapiru, but authorities call the situation still concerning. The COE reports improvements due to emergency and calamity decrees, enhanced health attention, large-scale cleaning, staffing, and vaccination against chikungunya in the basic health network, under the Incident Action Plan for Chikungunya. As of May 5, 2026, 35 patients remain hospitalized with complications. On May 4, Bororó Team 2 had 54 consultations (4 acute, 6 subacute, 0 chronic); Bororó Team 1 reported no hospitalizations or active case finding. Jaguapiru Team 1: 82 consultations (3 acute, 8 subacute, 1 chronic); 3 PCR samples. Jaguapiru Team 2: 29 consultations (0 acute, 5 subacute, 1 chronic); no hospitalizations. Nhuvera settlement: 29 consultations (0 acute, 3 subacute). About 250 tons of solid waste were removed to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding; the response is a joint effort of Civil Defense, SEMS, CCZ, Dsei, and Sesai.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアはドゥアラドスの先住民村で減少しているが、状況は依然として保健当局を懸念させている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのドゥアラドスにおけるチクングニア発生の減少傾向が報告されており、異常性や予想外性は低下している。ただし依然として35人が入院中であり、継続的な監視が必要な状況である。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列です。記事サマリーは減少傾向を示していますが、依然として活動的な感染（35人の入院患者、新規感染例の報告）が存在しており、継続的な経過観察が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue com ovitrampas e ação do CRAS no Dia das Mães marcam agenda social e de saúde em Feira de Santana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control with ovitraps and CRAS action on Mother's Day marks the social and health agenda in Feira de Santana.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, intensifies dengue control using ovitraps to monitor Aedes aegypti. On May 4-5, 2026, 35 vector-control agents installed ovitrampas—water, yeast, and wooden paddles—to attract egg-laying females in Campo Limpo, Conceição do Gado Novo, Brasília, Parque Ipê, Papagaio, Cidade Nova, Chácara São Cosme, Centro, Caseb and Capuchinhos. After deployment, teams return to collect and replace paddles; dried samples are sent to the lab to assess vector presence and infestation trends. Analysis of collected eggs helps identify female mosquitoes and track changes in vector activity, guiding targeted home visits, elimination of breeding sites, and educational campaigns in higher-incidence areas during the dengue peak season. In parallel, CRAS Fraternidade marked Mother’s Day with a health-focused activity promoting physical exercise and social integration among service users, reflecting integrated local health and social policies.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナでのオビトラップを用いたデング熱対策とCRASの母の日活動が社会衛生アジェンダを示す
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の既知流行地域における定常的なベクターコントロール活動の報道。新規な感染症クラスター、異常な重症度増加、または未制御の国際的拡大の兆候がない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・バイア州フェイラ・デ・サンタナにおけるデング熱の定常的なベクターコントロール活動（オビトラップ設置）の報道。記事は当局による積極的な予防対策を述べており、新規クラスター、急速な患者増加、または管理外の状況を示唆する情報はない。Bluedotの発生地域にはポルトガルも含まれているが、サマリー本文ではブラジル・バイア州のみが具体的な活動場所として記述されており、ポルトガルの感染症イベントは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Aluna de 11 anos é internada com meningite; Saúde municipal monitora caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11-year-old female student hospitalized with meningitis; Municipal health department monitors case.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus pneumoniae meningitis confirmed in an 11-year-old girl in Várzea Grande, Mato Grosso, Brazil. The student at Escola Estadual Governador José Garcia Neto, Residencial Júlio Domingos de Campos, was treated in Cuiabá (initially at Hospital Materno-Infantil, now Hospital Central). She remains hospitalized in Cuiabá; the case is being monitored by the Várzea Grande Municipal Health Surveillance, with the school sanitized and classes suspended for 5 May. Contact tracing urges direct contacts or those with symptoms to seek care. The investigation traces a prior flu-like illness and travel from Várzea Grande to Cuiabá and Rondonópolis, with Lacen confirming meningitis. This is the first meningitis case of 2026 in Várzea Grande. Vaccination guidance: meningitis C in infancy (3–5 months); A, C, W, Y boosters at 12 months; ACWY for 11–14-year-olds. Preventive measures include masking and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 11歳の女子生徒が髄膜炎で入院；地域保健部門が経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎球菌性髄膜炎の確定症例で重症度が高く（入院・小児患者）、予想外の発生（2026年初の髄膜炎ケース）であり、接触者追跡が進行中で公衆衛生上の懸念がある。IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 肺炎球菌性髄膜炎は重篤疾患であり、小児患者の入院、接触者追跡の実施、学校での行動制限（消毒・授業中止）が確認されている。2026年初の地域内発症例として公式監視対象。ワクチン接種状況や追加症例の有無については記事に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: 中國駐佛得角大使館：涉漢坦病毒疫情郵輪上無中國公民 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chinese Embassy in Cape Verde: No Chinese citizens aboard the cruise ship involved in the hantavirus outbreak - Hong Kong Wen Wei Po
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship, anchored off Praia, the capital port of Cape Verde. The World Health Organization and Cape Verde's Ministry of Health reported on May 4 seven cases linked to the vessel: two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases; three deaths, one patient in critical condition, while the remaining cases present with mild symptoms. The ship was confirmed to have no Chinese citizens aboard by the Chinese Embassy in Cape Verde. International health authorities are coordinating the response with relevant countries. The Chinese embassy urged Chinese nationals in Cape Verde to follow official updates from the Cape Verde Health Ministry and the Chinese embassy, maintain hygiene, and avoid contact with rodent species to lower exposure risk. Public health measures and ongoing surveillance are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 中国駐カーボベルデ大使館：ハンタウイルス疫情に関連する客船に中国国籍者なし
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の国際的な集団発生（7症例、3死亡）であり、WHOとカーボベルデ保健省による報告、複数国の保健当局が関与した対応が行われており、IHR基準の「異常性」「公衆衛生への影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（死亡3名、重症1名）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、船舶という限定空間）で複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、実際のハンタウイルス発生はカーボベルデのプライア沖に停泊する客船MV Hondiusで報告されているが、カーボベルデは対象国リストに含まれていない。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはカーボベルデと中国が含まれているが、サマリーの主題は客船でのハンタウイルス集団発生である。記事は中国大使館の公式声明に関するもので、中国本土での発生ではなく、中国側の外交的対応記事である。しかし中国（1814991）が発生地域リストに明示されており、中国駐外交館による公式発表という性質上、verified_locationsに中国を含める。対象国リストに含まれないカーボベルデでの実発生については、地域検証ルール上除外する。

article.articleHeadline: Điểm tin sáng 6/5: Bộ Y tế thông tin về virus Hanta | Đường Cộng Hòa tổ chức làn đảo chiều từ 15/5
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Morning briefing on May 6: Ministry of Health provides information about Hantavirus | Cong Hoa Street to implement contraflow lane from May 15
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports a hantavirus cluster in early May 2026: seven cases linked to a Dutch-flagged cruise ship, including 2 confirmed and 5 suspected, with 3 deaths. Vietnam’s Preventive Medicine Department states Vietnam has not recorded any hantavirus cases related to this event. Hantavirus disease is an acute, potentially fatal infection in humans, with rapid progression that can cause shortness of breath, respiratory failure, and hypotension; there is no specific antiviral treatment, and care is primarily supportive with close clinical monitoring. The Vietnamese health agency emphasizes information sharing to help the public actively prevent infection and avoid panic. No domestic cases have been confirmed as of May 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年5月6日朝のニュース速報：保健省がハンタウイルスについて情報提供 | コンホア通りで5月15日から対面通行を実施
triage.triage_reason: 国際クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生（2死亡含む7例）が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」の可能性がある。ただしベトナムで既に事例確認がなく、情報が限定的であるため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 国際クルーズ船での多国籍乗客による集団発生のため、発生地域特定が難しい。ただしベトナム当局が公式に情報提供し、国内でのハンタウイルス関連事例がないことを確認している。ハンタウイルスは致死率の高い呼吸器疾患であり、今後の国際的な拡大可能性が懸念される。追加情報待機中。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, Thai Nguyen province in Vietnam is intensifying efforts to prevent African swine fever (ASF) from spreading further. The current ASF strain is highly virulent, and hot, heavy rainfall conditions are facilitating rapid transmission, shortening the interval from infection to death. Officials have activated the highest level of outbreak response to curb spread and minimize losses to the public and the state, indicating an elevated mobilization of resources and enforcement. The report provides no numerical case or death counts, no laboratory confirmation details, and does not disclose information on infection sources or whether any cases are imported or exported.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのタイグエン省でASF発生が報告され、高い病原性と最高レベルの対応体制が示唆されるが、症例数や確認状況などの重要な詳細情報が欠落しており、完全なリスク評価に必要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病であり人獣共通感染症ではないが、畜産業への影響と地域の食糧安全保障への潜在的な影響は重要。記事では症例数、死亡数、ラボ確認詳細が完全に欠落しており、深刻度評価が困難。政府が最高レベルの対応を発動している点は関心度の高さを示唆。追加情報による続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus: o que é e qual o risco do vírus ligado a mortes em cruzeiro - Revista Fórum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: what it is and the risk posed by the virus linked to deaths on a cruise - Revista Fórum
article.articleSummary: On a cruise from southern Argentina to Cape Verde, hantavirus—primarily rodent-borne—raised concern after three deaths during the voyage, with only one case officially confirmed by the WHO; public health risk is assessed as low as of May 5, 2026. Hantavirus is found worldwide, more common in Asia (China, Russia, South Korea), but cases persist annually in the Americas and parts of Europe. Transmission mainly occurs via inhalation of particles from rodent urine, feces, or saliva; human-to-human transmission is rare, except for the Andes virus in South America. Sequencing will determine whether the infections are linked to onboard transmission or represent imported (pre-embarkation) infections. There is no specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive and may require intensive care in severe cases. Health authorities are closely monitoring and assessing implications for potential imported/exported cases and origin tracing.”} }{

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：何か、そしてクルーズ船での死亡に関連するウイルスのリスク - Revista Fórum
triage.triage_reason: 南米アルゼンチンからカーボベルデへのクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス関連の死亡事例（3件、WHO公式確認は1件）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当。ただし記事は教育的性格が強く、現在の公衆衛生リスクは低く評価されており、対象国での発生ではないため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はクルーズ船上での死亡事例であり、地理的には南米とカーボベルデのルート。ハンタウイルスの地理的分布情報として中国（アジア）が言及されているが、実際の現在のイベント発生地は対象国外。記事は情報提供的性格が強く、現在の公衆衛生リスクは低いと明記されている。クルーズ船という特殊環境での限定的な事例であり、国内への拡大リスクは不明確。

article.articleHeadline: 7人发病，3人死亡，豪华游轮无法靠岸 汉坦病毒疫情爆发
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven people fell ill, three dead, luxury cruise ship unable to dock amid hantavirus outbreak
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed hantavirus cases and five suspected, including three fatalities, aboard the luxury cruise Hondius after departing Argentina on April 1; the ship is off Cape Verde in the South Atlantic, unable to dock, pending clearance from Cape Verde health authorities for passenger disembarkation and medical transfer. The cases include a Dutch passenger who developed fever, headache, and mild diarrhea on April 6 and died on board; his wife died en route to the Netherlands and was later confirmed infected. As of May 4, three suspected cases on board show high fever and gastrointestinal symptoms; several others develop pneumonia and severe illness. Hantavirus exposure is thought to be rodent-related. HPS is typical in the Americas and can be contagious in close contact, while Eurasian hantaviruses more often cause HFRS without person-to-person spread. The Shenzhen hospital head Lu Hongzhou notes the pattern aligns with HPS and rapid progression.

triage.headline_ja: 7人が発症、3人死亡、豪華クルーズ船が入港不可 ハンタウイルス疫情勃発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重症度と予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）、複数国での確認死亡者、対象国（China）での専門家言及、国際的な乗客輸送による拡大リスク存在
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいてShenzhenの病院幹部Lu Hongzhouが専門家意見として言及されているため、Chinaを対象国として計上。発生地域リストに多数国が含まれるが、実際の患者発生地はアルゼンチンおよび大西洋中の船舶であり、対象国リストに該当するのはChinaのみ（専門家言及）。クルーズ船がCape Verdeへの入港を試みており、国際的な医療対応と疾患制御の困難さが明確。HPS型ハンタウイルスは急速進行性で高い致命率を示唆している。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 一邮轮暴发疫情，已致3人死亡、多人感染，恐发生人际传播，中国大使馆发声
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak on a cruise ship has killed three people and infected many, with suspected person-to-person transmission; the Chinese embassy has issued a statement.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of hantavirus on the Dutch-owned expedition cruise Hondius, anchored off Praia, Cape Verde, has caused three deaths and infections among 149 people aboard (88 passengers, 61 crew) from 23 countries. The WHO notes hantavirus is usually environmental (rodent excreta) but human-to-human transmission can occur, and suspected transmission on Hondius is reported. Three infected passengers will be airlifted to the Netherlands; others remain in isolation, with a specialist physician assigned. Spain’s health ministry says the ship will dock in the Canary Islands for support, with the operator coordinating next steps. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde reports no Chinese citizens aboard. Separately, a UK national treated for hantavirus in South Africa after traveling on Hondius (Ascension Island, then Johannesburg) is in critical condition; SA finds no wider transmission. Hondius: built 2019, about 108 m, 80 cabins, up to 170 passengers.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船で疫病が大流行、3人死亡・多数感染、人間から人間への感染の懸念あり、中国大使館が声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ハンタウイルス感染症の集団発生で3人死亡、149人中多数が感染、人間から人間への感染が疑われ、国際的な広がりと隔離・移送により渡航に影響が生じている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの地域情報には対象外国（南アフリカ、カナリア諸島、オランダ、スペイン、英国、カーボベルデ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は、クルーズ船Hondiusにおけるハンタウイルス集団発生で、中国大使館が報告（中国国民が搭乗していないことを確認）している点から、対象国リストに該当するのはChina（1814991）のみ。ハンタウイルスの人間から人間への伝播が疑われることは特異的であり、また複数国籍の乗客・乗員が関与することから国際的リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma mais 391 casos de dengue no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms 391 more dengue fever cases in Paraná
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil, reports 391 new dengue cases, pushing the 2026 total to 3,232 with 2,674 locally acquired infections. The Paraná State Health Department (Sesa-PR) bulletin published May 5 notes the increase since the previous report. By comparison, the May 6, 2025 bulletin recorded 53,416 dengue cases in Paraná, with more than 43,000 locally acquired, underscoring a substantial year-over-year decline. Despite the sizable reduction in early 2026, authorities reiterate the ongoing transmission risk and urge continued preventive measures. The report highlights circulation of all four dengue virus serotypes—DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4—requiring vigilance to prevent further spread. Climate conditions that favor Aedes aegypti breeding are cited as a factor sustaining transmission, and the presence of multiple serotypes raises concerns for future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、パラナ州でデング熱新規391症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（対象国）でのデング熱流行の継続報道だが、前年同期比で症例数が大幅に減少しており、深刻度の急速な上昇は見られない。情報は十分だが、現段階では国際的拡大リスク等の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: デング熱はAedes aegypti蚊による媒介感染症で流行しやすい特性がある。複数の血清型（DENV-1～4）が循環しており長期的な曝露リスクが存在。ただし前年同期比で症例数は大幅減少（53,416→3,232）しており、深刻度の急速な上昇は見られない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため追跡対象。

article.articleHeadline: ハンタウイルスがクルーズ船内で感染、3人死亡　「日本に入ってくるリスクは低い」と専門家...中韓では同種ウイルス感染例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus infection aboard a cruise ship leaves three dead; experts say the risk of it entering Japan is low... There have been cases of the same virus in China and South Korea.
article.articleSummary: Six people aboard a cruise ship traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde are suspected to be infected with hantavirus, with three deaths reported. Kenji Kutsuna, professor at Osaka University Medical School, explains transmission occurs when rodent saliva, urine, or feces become aerosolized in dust and inhaled, leading to infection. Symptoms resemble influenza and typically emerge within weeks; severe cases can cause marked lung inflammation and respiratory distress. The case fatality rate is described as tens of percent, and human-to-human transmission is rare. The incident was discussed on News Zero, noting concurrent hantavirus activity in China and South Korea. Japanese experts say the risk of hantavirus entering Japan is low, but the event underscores the need for vigilance around international cruises and rodent-control measures to prevent imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスがクルーズ船内で感染、3人死亡　「日本に入ってくるリスクは低い」と専門家...中韓では同種ウイルス感染例
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの国際的な船舶感染事例であり、重症度（致死率数十%）と異常性は認められるが、記事では日本への侵入リスクが低いと専門家評価されており、確定診断と詳細な流行可能性について情報が不足している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域にはアルゼンチン、カーボベルデ、日本、韓国が含まれるが、記事サマリーはクルーズ船上（アルゼンチン→カーボベルデ航路）での感染事例を主題としており、対象国リストに該当するのはChinaのみ（中韓での同種ウイルス感染例の言及）。ただしCluster sizeが小さく（6名疑い、3名死亡）、船舶限定の事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀とされている。確定診断と流行可能性の詳細情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: 09:12:46更新｜中國駐佛得角使館：涉疫郵輪上無中國公民 請加強衛生防範
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 09:12:46 Update | Chinese Embassy in Cape Verde: There are no Chinese citizens on the cruise ship linked to the outbreak. Please strengthen hygiene precautions.
article.articleSummary: On May 4, 2026, the Hondius cruise ship, moored off Praia, Cape Verde, reported a hantavirus outbreak. WHO and Cape Verde’s health authorities documented seven cases on the vessel, including two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases; three deaths were recorded, with one patient in critical condition and others mild. The ship reportedly carried no Chinese citizens. Cape Verde’s health ministry is coordinating with WHO and affected countries to respond. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde advised Chinese nationals to monitor official updates, maintain hygiene, and avoid contact with rodents; emergency number 130 was provided. Oceanwide Expeditions later disclosed that among the three deaths, two Dutch nationals had disembarked, while one German death remained on board, with a body still onboard.

triage.headline_ja: 09:12:46更新｜中國駐佛得角使館：涉疫郵輪上無中國公民 請加強衛生防範
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当、国境を越えた集団感染で死亡例あり。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedotで識別されたドイツ・オランダは記事本文に含まれていない（Oceanwide Expeditionsの運営船舶の乗客国籍への言及のみ）。記事の主題はカーボベルデでの郵輪発生アウトブレイクおよび中国の対応であるため、verified_locationsはカーボベルデと中国のみとした。ハンタウイルスの国際国境を越えた集団感染、複数国籍乗客、死亡例3件、臨界症例あり。WHOが関与し複数国家が応答している。

article.articleHeadline: Giun ký sinh ở chuột tấn công não người phụ nữ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Parasitic Worm in Mice Attacks a Woman's Brain.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a 30-year-old woman, Hoa, developed eosinophilic meningitis due to Angiostrongylus cantonensis (rat lungworm). She presented with severe headache, tinnitus, photophobia, and later dizziness and imbalance. MRI 3 Tesla showed multifocal nodular lesions in cortex, subcortical areas, brainstem, and cerebellum. CSF had leukocytosis (973/µL) with eosinophilia, elevated protein, and low glucose. CSF PCR confirmed Angiostrongylus cantonensis infection. The parasite’s rat hosts release larvae that migrate to the CNS; snails are intermediate hosts. Transmission likely via contact with rats or consumption of undercooked snails or vegetables contaminated with snail material. Treatment included 7–10 days of anti-inflammatory therapy and 2–3 weeks of antiparasitic drugs, with liver function monitoring. After ~2 weeks, symptoms improved; discharge with outpatient follow-up. Mortality for eosinophilic meningitis is about 2–3%, but long-term neuro sequelae such as memory and balance impairment can occur. Prevention emphasizes cooking food, washing produce, and good pet hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミの寄生虫が女性の脳を攻撃する
triage.triage_reason: Angiostrongyliasis（広東住血線虫症）による散発的脳髄膜炎ケースの報告。個別症例であり、公衆衛生的影響や国際拡大のリスクは限定的だが、熱帯感染症の臨床的重要性と予防教育の観点から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本ケースはAngiostrongyliasis（広東住血線虫症）の散発的脳髄膜炎で、ベトナム・ホーチミン市での個別症例報告。Classical Swine Fever も疾患リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではAngiostrongyliasisのみが主題。重症度はあるものの、流行の兆候、国際的拡大リスク、または管理困難性の証拠がない。地域的な食品安全・衛生教育の文脈で報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D intensifica vacinação contra chikungunya em território indígena de Dourados (MS) - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day intensifies chikungunya vaccination in Dourados Indigenous Territory (MS) - Ponta Porã Reports - Ponta Porã News - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY.
article.articleSummary: May 5, 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil: The Ministry of Health led a Day D vaccination against chikungunya in the Dourados Indigenous Territory, focusing on Jaguapiru II and Bororó II amid rising cases, especially among Indigenous residents. The reserve hosts about 22,500 people, with roughly 10,000 in the 18–59 age group targeted for vaccination. A total of 46,500 doses were dispatched—43,500 to Dourados and 3,000 to Itaporã—based on epidemiological criteria and cold-chain capacity. The vaccination campaign began April 27 and uses microplanning and extramuros teams to expand access. This is part of a national arbovirus response to broaden vaccination, surveillance, and care quality. The Butantan Institute vaccine is the first globally approved to prevent chikungunya by Anvisa; contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, certain comorbidities, and allergy to components.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラドス先住民領土（MS）でのチクングニア予防接種キャンペーン強化 - ポンタポラン情報
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア症例増加に対応した予防接種キャンペーンの報道。症例増加という異常性は確認されるが、具体的な患者数、死亡、重症度に関する情報が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクの評価も不明。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: チクングニア症例の増加がブラジル国内で報告され、保健省主導による大規模な予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。先住民コミュニティでの症例増加が特に懸念されているが、具体的な患者数や死亡数は記事サマリーに記載されていない。情報の充実を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 男友婚前查出乙肝，女子父母担心传染让两人分手
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boyfriend diagnosed with hepatitis B before marriage; the woman's parents worry about transmission and cause them to break up.
article.articleSummary: In Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, a 26-year-old woman, Xiao Wu, discovers her boyfriend has chronic hepatitis B during a pre-marital check. He tests positive for hepatitis B surface antigen. Fearing transmission and facing family pressure, the couple nearly breaks up. A physician explains that routine daily contact (sharing meals, handshakes, hugs, or using the same toilet) does not spread HBV. Regarding sexual transmission, even with unprotected sex, about 5% of exposed adults progress to chronic infection, while 95% clear the virus with a healthy immune response, effectively a natural vaccination. Xiao Wu is found to have hepatitis B antibodies, indicating she already has immunity and is not at risk of infection. The boyfriend begins antiviral therapy, achieving an undetectable viral load within three months. After counseling, Xiao Wu’s parents accept the relationship; they are engaged and planning a wedding by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: 男友婚前查出乙肝，女子父母担心传染让两人分手（婚前検査で彼氏が肝炎B陽性判定、女性の両親が感染を懸念し破局させる）
triage.triage_reason: 個人的な健康問題と家族の懸念に関する社会記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクを示す医学的シグナルではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人的な婚前検査での肝炎B診断と、それに関わる家族間の懸念・破局・和解という人間ドラマを扱った社会記事である。個別症例の報告やアウトブレイク、感染症の流行兆候を示す公衆衛生上のシグナルではなく、医学的な情報提供（肝炎Bの感染経路、ワクチン接種、抗ウイルス療法の有効性）を含む教育的記事である。感染症危機管理の対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus: As WHO shares the symptoms of the infected patients, Delhi NCR doctor reveals how a mild fever can become a life-threatening lung emergency
article.articleSummary: Deaths aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship are linked to hantavirus, with the WHO sharing symptoms observed in the infected. In Delhi-NCR, Dr. Pradeep Bajad, Senior Consultant in Pulmonary Medicine and Sleep Medicine at Amrita Hospital, Faridabad, notes the pattern: a virus that can masquerade as a mild illness before rapidly becoming a life-threatening lung emergency. He stresses hantavirus is an old virus that remains widely misunderstood, contributing to delayed recognition and treatment. The report highlights how a seemingly mild fever can escalate into severe respiratory distress, underscoring the danger of rapid deterioration in hantavirus infections. Framed as a continuing outbreak concern associated with cruise-ship deaths, the piece emphasizes clinical vigilance and awareness. Published 2026-05-05.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：WHOが感染患者の症状を共有する中、デリーNCRの医師が軽い熱がいかに生命を脅かす肺の緊急事態になりうるかを明かす
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症は重症度が高く（肺感染による死亡例）、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当。ただしインドでの実際の発生状況、患者数、拡大リスク等の詳細が不明であるため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にデリーNCRの医学的解説であり、インド国内でのハンタウイルス発生の具体的な患者数、拡大速度、今後の流行予測等の詳細が不足している。MV Hondius船での死亡例への言及があるが、当該船の所在地・航路が不明。インドでの実際の発生規模と国際的拡大リスクの把握には追加情報が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 'This time we don't have strength to rebuild': Bird flu hits western India's biggest egg-supply hub, again
article.articleSummary: Navapur in Maharashtra's Nandurbar district, an egg hub feeding Mumbai, Surat, Jalgaon, endures a third Avian Influenza outbreak. The outbreak began April 12 with sudden poultry deaths; by April 26 samples from Diamond and Tasleem farms tested positive, and Navapur was declared infected on April 30 with a 1 km infected radius and 10 km surveillance radius; poultry movement was banned for 90 days. By May 5, over 2 lakh birds had been culled; about 8 lakh eggs destroyed and more than 210 tonnes of feed discarded. Affected farms include Diamond Poultry Farm, Tasleem Poultry Farm (Taslearia’s 62,300 birds culled; 6 lakh eggs destroyed; 72 tonnes feed wasted) and Wasim B Poultry Farm (30,000 birds and 60,000 eggs wiped out). Compensation remains low (Rs 140 per bird in 2024; costs up to Rs 500 per bird); farmers advocate vaccination against H5N1, which India does not permit for highly pathogenic strains.

triage.headline_ja: 「今回は再建する力がない」：鳥インフルエンザが西インドの最大卵供給拠点を再び直撃
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハーラシュトラ州ナワープルにおける3度目の高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)の発生。大規模な家禽の殺処分(200万羽以上)、卵供給への深刻な経済的影響、および継続的な感染リスクが認められ、IHR基準で2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にインドのマハーラシュトラ州ナワープルでの鳥インフルエンザH5N1の発生を主題としている。3度目の発生、大規模な経済的損失(卵供給への影響、200万羽以上の殺処分)、および補償の不十分さが報告されている。農民がH5N1ワクチン接種を要求しているが、インドは高病原性株への接種を許可していない。公衆衛生上の懸念(人への感染ポテンシャル)と経済的影響の両面で重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ketahui penularan utama virus hanta dari tikus ke manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out the main transmission of hantavirus from rats to humans
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) transmission is via inhalation of aerosolized dried rat urine, feces, or saliva from infected rats. Andes virus (ANDV) can, in limited cases, spread between humans in close contact. In Jakarta, Indonesia, expert Dicky Budiman notes the disease is zoonotic; initial symptoms include fever, body aches, and weakness, followed by vascular leakage that causes pulmonary edema and acute respiratory failure. Case fatality can reach about 40% due to hypoxemia; progression to severe lung involvement can occur within days, underscoring the need for early recognition and supportive care. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management relies on oxygen delivery, ventilatory support, and careful fluid management. Global pandemic potential is small because transmission is not primarily human-to-human. Prevention emphasizes hygiene and reducing exposure in high-risk settings such as ships or poorly ventilated enclosed spaces.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスのネズミから人への主な感染経路を知る
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス肺症候群の病態・管理に関する教育的な記事であり、インドネシア（ジャカルタ）での具体的な患者数、流行状況、公衆衛生上の緊急性は記事から明確でない。スクリーニング基準は一部該当するが、情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルス肺症候群（HPS）の一般的な感染メカニズム、病態、管理方法に関する教育的な情報提供である。ジャカルタの専門家（Dicky Budiman）の見解が含まれているが、インドネシアでの具体的な発症者数や流行規模は記載されていない。人-人感染の可能性は限定的であり、グローバルパンデミックリスクは低いとの記述がある。確認された患者数や流行状況についての情報がないため、信号としての重大性は低いが、動物由来感染症のリスク認識という点では注視を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 节俭吃出大病！长期食用冰箱存货，病菌可能“上脑”
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Frugal eating could lead to a serious illness! Prolonged consumption of fridge stock may cause bacteria to invade the brain.
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China: a 79-year-old man developed pyogenic meningitis caused by Listeria monocytogenes (Pasteur strain) after prolonged consumption of expired items stored in the refrigerator. He presented with sudden weakness, fever near 39°C, neck stiffness, and inability to speak, followed by confusion, diarrhea, and urinary incontinence. Admission labs showed elevated infection markers and MRI revealed bilateral frontal subdural effusions. He was diagnosed with acute bacterial meningitis and gradually recovered with treatment. Investigations point to ingestion of long-stored fridge stock as the infection source; Listeria can survive and multiply at 0–4°C and reach the brain via the bloodstream after gut infection. The report emphasizes that refrigeration is not sterilization and warns against consuming foods kept long-term (frozen meat, seafood, dairy), offering fridge-use tips to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 節約が大病の元に！冷蔵庫の古い食材の長期摂取で、菌が脳に侵入する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 個別の臨床症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常事態ではない。Listeriaは既知の食品由来感染症であり、予想外の疾病パターンではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国・深圳での単一症例（79歳男性のリステリア髄膜炎）の臨床報告であり、食品安全に関する一般的な啓発記事である。集団発生（outbreak）や異常な疾病パターン（unusual trend）の報告ではなく、シグナル価値がない。Listeriaの食品由来感染は既知のリスクであり、予想外性（unexpectedness）もない。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam permanece libre de infección humana por virus Hanta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam remains free of human hantavirus infection.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports no human hantavirus infections to date amid concerns about cases linked to an international cruise. The Ministry of Health’s Preventive Medicine Department, with WHO, is monitoring and guiding prevention efforts; the public is urged to adopt preventive measures and not panic. No Vietnam cases confirmed. Guidance emphasizes avoiding contact with rodents or droppings, ventilating and dampening areas before cleaning, wearing gloves and masks, washing hands after exposures, sealing rodent entries, proper food storage, and daily waste management. Symptomatic individuals with relevant exposure should seek care. By May 4, 2026, seven cruise-linked cases were identified: two confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected; three deaths, one critical, three mild. Hantavirus can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome; treatment is supportive. Transmission is rodent-borne; incubation typically 2–8 weeks; early symptoms include fever, chills, headache, muscle pains; progression to respiratory distress is possible.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムはハンタウイルスのヒト感染から自由なままである
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内では確認症例なく、国際クルーズ関連での外国人症例が主題。スクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」に該当するが、ベトナムの公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は現在なく、情報が限定的
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナムでのハンタウイルス人感染がないことを強調しており、国際クルーズ乗客による外国人症例（7例、死亡3例）が背景。ベトナム保健省とWHOが監視・予防指導を実施中。国内での直接的な患者発生なく、主にリスク啓発と予防措置の推奨が内容。情報不足が多いため「WATCH」と判定し、続報を注視する必要がある

article.articleHeadline: Dia D acelera vacinação contra chikungunya em reserva indígena de Dourados - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day Accelerates Vaccination Against Chikungunya in Dourados Indigenous Reserve.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 May 2026, Brazil's Ministry of Health led a Day D vaccination campaign against chikungunya in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, focusing on the Dourados Indigenous Reserve (Jaguapiru II and Bororó II). The campaign aims to curb transmission amid rising cases, particularly among residents of the 22,500-person reserve, about 10,000 aged 18–59—the vaccination priority group. A total of 46,500 doses were dispatched (43,500 to Dourados, 3,000 to Itaporã). The immunization, initiated 27 April, uses a vaccine developed by Instituto Butantan and approved by Anvisa, indicated for adults 18–59 with high exposure risk; distribution uses mobile units (vacimóvel) and microplanning; extramuros actions prioritized. The effort is part of Brazil's national arboviruses response, with similar campaigns in Sergipe, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo. The vaccine is based on an attenuated virus and is not given to pregnant, lactating, immunosuppressed individuals, or those with certain allergies or uncontrolled comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラドス先住民保護区でのチクングニヤワクチン接種キャンペーン加速
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニヤ流行に対する公式ワクチンキャンペーンで、複数州での展開が報告されており流行の広がりを示唆するが、重症度や死亡率などの詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: チクングニヤはWPRO地域外（南米）の疾患であるが、ブラジル国内で複数州（マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州、セルジペ州、ミナス・ジェライス州、サンパウロ州）での流行が確認され、政府主導のワクチンキャンペーンが実施されている。記事では感染例の数や重症度が具体的に記載されていないため、公衆衛生への影響の程度は不明。先住民保護区での優先接種は高リスク集団への対応を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande confirma 9º caso de raiva em morcego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande confirms 9th rabies case in a bat.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil confirms ninth bat rabies case in 2026. A bat was found collapsed in the Jardim Bela Vista neighborhood, collected by the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) and sent to the lab, where rabies virus was confirmed. The city has recorded nine positive cases this year from 546 bats recovered in urban areas; most analyzed bats tested negative, indicating virus circulation without a general population risk. Public health guidance stresses not touching bats under any circumstances; if an animal is behaving abnormally or is indoors, isolate the area and call for collection. Bats in natural habitat are not a danger; risk comes from direct contact with ill animals. Annual vaccination of dogs and cats remains the primary prevention to prevent domestic-dog-mediated transmission. CCZ continues rabies vaccination and collection services, with local contact numbers provided.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデ、コウモリの狂犬病9番目の症例を確認

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus no Brasil: país registrou 189 mortes nos últimos 10 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus in Brazil: the country recorded 189 deaths in the last 10 years.
article.articleSummary: Three hantavirus deaths were confirmed on a cruise ship traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde, with three more passengers under suspicion; the vessel remains isolated near its destination, which prohibits disembarkation. In Brazil, hantavirus cases and deaths have declined over 2016–2025. The Northeast region records the fewest cases and deaths but the highest fatality rate (3 cases, 2 deaths; 66.6% CFR). The South bears the largest burden with 238 cases and 77 deaths (CFR 32.3%). Hantavirus is transmitted via urine, feces, and excreta of wild rodents, primarily affecting rural workers. Infected individuals can develop hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, with fever, shortness of breath, and tachypnea; severe cases may progress to respiratory or cardiac failure. There is no specific antiviral treatment, contributing to the disease’s mortality.”}{

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman developed meningitis caused by a worm from mice, almost misdiagnosed as a stroke.
article.articleSummary: Angiostrongylus cantonensis–induced eosinophilic meningitis in a 30-year-old woman in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. She presented with two weeks of headache, tinnitus, photophobia, and imbalance; MRI showed widespread cortical and subcortical nodules with brainstem and cerebellar involvement, not typical for acute stroke. Lumbar puncture revealed marked eosinophilic meningitis (973 cells/µL) with elevated protein and low glucose; CSF PCR confirmed Angiostrongylus cantonensis. The rat lungworm infects humans via ingestion of undercooked snails/slugs or produce contaminated with snail larvae; the patient reported raw vegetables and keeping hamsters at home. Treatment included 7–10 days of anti-inflammatory therapy to reduce cerebral edema and about 2–3 weeks of antiparasitic medication, with periodic liver monitoring. After ~2 weeks, headaches and dizziness improved; outpatient follow-up to assess potential long-term neurologic sequelae such as memory impairment and balance disorders. Prevention stresses cooking foods thoroughly, washing greens, and avoiding uncooked snails or contaminated produce.

article.articleHeadline: 戴手套！"超72小时未治疗死亡率近100%"，又有人中招_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wear gloves! "Untreated for more than 72 hours, the mortality rate is nearly 100%," another person has fallen victim.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus wound infection case in Shanghai, China: a 70-something woman (alias Li A) sustained a left middle finger puncture while handling seafood on March 16; within 24 hours she developed swelling and fever, with white blood cell count 16.03×10^9/L. Diagnosed as traumatic Vibrio vulnificus infection; multidisciplinary team started cefoperazone-sulbactam plus levofloxacin. Because she had a prosthetic heart valve with pacemaker and was on anticoagulation, plus diabetes and diabetic ketoacidosis, the infection posed high risk of septic shock or heart failure. Left-hand debridement and drainage on March 19; due to extensive infection, a second debridement on March 26 with a negative-pressure wound therapy device. Tissue sent for metagenomic next-generation sequencing, confirming Vibrio vulnificus with high read counts. Antimicrobials adjusted accordingly; anticoagulation managed; insulin infusion for hyperglycemia and ketosis. After two weeks, fever resolved, swelling subsided, and she was discharged. Emphasizes rapid progression and >72 hours mortality near 100% without treatment.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven people reported ill, three have died! WHO: The outbreak-related cruise ship may have already shown human-to-human transmission; the first confirmed couple boarded in Argentina. China confirms: There are no Chinese citizens on board.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship Hondius off Praia, Cape Verde. Seven of nearly 150 passengers and crew have fallen ill, with three deaths; one patient is in intensive care in South Africa. The first confirmed cases were a couple who boarded the ship in Argentina. Three patients are to be evacuated by air ambulance to the Netherlands; one aircraft has already arrived in Cape Verde, with transfer to be completed when safe. China’s embassy in Cape Verde confirmed no Chinese citizens are on board and urged Chinese nationals to strengthen hygiene. Spain’s health ministry said the Canary Islands will receive the ship, as Cape Verde lacks capacity for this disposal; Oceanwide Expeditions is coordinating. WHO notes hantavirus is rodent-borne and typically transmitted via excreta, but intimate close-contact exposure (e.g., spouses, cabin-mates) may allow limited human-to-human transmission. The ship had stopped at several African-island locations with rodent populations, suggesting possible sources. The situation is being coordinated with affected authorities to move toward the Canary Islands.

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus outbreaks are rare, but they aren't going away and there's no cure
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreaks are rare; there is no vaccine or cure and funding is limited. Different rodent hosts drive Old World (Europe/Asia) versus New World (Americas) strains; Americas strains can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome with higher fatality. The Kore a 1951 outbreak near the Hantan River led to the virus’ name, with later tracing to eastern Siberia, Europe, and northeastern China. In the United States, Old World hantaviruses were found in urban rats at Baltimore, New York, and Philadelphia ports. The Four Corners 1993 outbreak of Sin Nombre virus—deer mice—killed at least 15. Yosemite 2012 saw 10 infections, 3 deaths, via dust from rodent excreta in tent cabins. Andes virus (Chile) emerged in 2002; capable of human-to-human spread and higher fatality. Epuyén, Argentina, 2018–2019: 29 cases, 11 deaths with sustained human transmission. Two confirmed and five suspected cases aboard the cruise ship M/V Hondius.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスのアウトブレイクは稀だが、消え去らず、治療法もない

triage.notes: 記事は複数国の歴史的および現在のハンタウイルス事例を取り上げているが、対象国リストに該当するのは中国（北東部を含む歴史的追跡）のみ。米国（Philadelphia, Baltimore, New York）、アルゼンチン（Epuyén）、チリ、スペイン領カナリア諸島、韓国が発生地域として記載されているが、対象国に含まれていない。記事は啓発・総説的な性質が強く、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイク情報は限定的。継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Pencegahan terbaik virus hanta dengan pengendalian tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Best Prevention of Hantavirus Through Rodent Control
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-06, in Jakarta, Indonesia, Griffith University epidemiologist Dicky Budiman says primary hantavirus prevention hinges on rodent control in residential environments, especially during the rainy season and floods. Core measures include sealing rodent access to homes and warehouses, storing food in closed containers, and cleaning damp surroundings. While rodent droppings pose hantavirus risk (which targets the lungs and can cause rapid death), urine can carry leptospirosis, which attacks the kidneys and liver. During floods, risk increases; use boots, avoid contact with dirty water, and protect wounds. Cleanup teams and warehouse workers should wear masks and wash hands regularly. When sweeping dusty areas, disinfect first and wear a mask to prevent inhalation of aerosols. Early detection remains crucial, with rodent control, environmental hygiene, and personal hygiene emphasized during the rainy season.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever not relieved by over-the-counter meds! Man diagnosed with meningitis hospitalized; experts warn that droplets and kissing may transmit.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed cases of meningococcal meningitis in Taiwan: a one-month-old infant and a man in his 30s in Taichung City. The adult, who traveled to Thailand and Malaysia from late February to early March, developed fever in late April. He self-medicated before hospital admission on May 1 and is now hospitalized. One close contact, a foreign national, has left Taiwan and is being monitored through May 9. Global meningococcal meningitis outbreaks persist in Africa's Sahel, as well as Vietnam, Japan, North America, Europe, and Oceania. Transmission occurs via throat and nasal secretions and droplets through close contact or prolonged proximity; risk higher for those with lower immunity. Common symptoms include fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, nausea, vomiting, and rash; severe cases may cause coma, delirium, pneumonia, sepsis, or meningitis. Public health measures: seek prompt care, report travel/contact history, practice hand hygiene, avoid crowded places, cough etiquette; masks as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱が市販薬で効かず！男性が脳膜炎と診断され入院　専門家：飛沫感染・キスで感染の可能性

article.articleHeadline: Pencegahan virus hanta dengan pengendalian tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus prevention through rodent control.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta-based epidemiologist Dicky Budiman says hantavirus prevention hinges on rodent control in homes and warehouses, especially during the rainy and flood seasons. Core measures include sealing rodent access, storing food in sealed containers, and keeping damp areas clean. During rain and floods, the risk from rodent droppings rises, with hantavirus transmission limited but possible; leptospirosis from rat urine on surfaces also poses a threat. Hantavirus attacks the lungs and can cause rapid death, while leptospirosis affects the kidneys and liver. Protective actions include wearing boots during floods, avoiding contact with dirty water, and ensuring cleaners in closed spaces wear masks and wash hands regularly. When sweeping dusty areas, use disinfectants first and wear a mask to prevent inhaling aerosols. Transmission during floods remains rare, but vigilance and early detection—via rodent control, environmental hygiene, and personal hygiene—are crucial in Indonesia's rainy seasons.

article.articleHeadline: Anambas MBG Food Poisoning: Lab Finds Borax, E. coli
article.articleSummary: Mass poisoning linked to Indonesia's Free Nutritious Food (MBG) program in the Anambas Islands Regency, Air Asuk area, with at least 155 people affected. An Extraordinary Event (KLB) was declared on April 15, 2026. Lab results from the Natuna District Health Office found borax in remaining MBG meals (contamination levels 100–5,000 mg), and BPOM confirmed the presence of Escherichia coli. The National Food and Nutrition Agency (BGN) will tighten oversight; the Integrated Health Post for Nutritious Food (SPPG) MBG kitchen must renew its Hygiene and Sanitation Suitability Certification (SLHS) and meet all standards before resuming operations. Investigations by the Department of Food Security, Agriculture, and Animal Health and the Provincial Health Office are ongoing, with sanitary rapid tests conducted and meal samples sent to Batam BPOM for confirmation. The exact source of contamination in water or food remains unidentified, with further investigation planned to prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: アナンバス栄養食計画の食中毒事件：ホウ酸と大腸菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: 155人以上の集団食中毒事件（KLB宣言済み）で重症度が中等度以上、異常事象であり、政府対応が開始されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当する。
triage.notes: インドネシアの政府栄養食計画（MBG）関連の集団食中毒事件。155人以上の患者が発生し、公式にKLB（異常事象）が宣言されている。ホウ酸（100～5,000mg）と大腸菌（E. coli）の混合汚染が確認され、汚染源は水か食品かまだ不明。複数の政府機関が対応中であり、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Fear mounts as Hantavirus spreads, cruise-ship infections, WHO warning about fatalities, how much of a concern is this for India?
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus concerns rise after suspected infections aboard a cruise ship off the Atlantic coast near Cape Verde, with three passengers dying. The World Health Organization warns that, though rare, human-to-human transmission is possible in some settings, but overall risk remains low and authorities say the situation is under control. Hantavirus can spread via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent droppings, urine, or remains, highlighting rodents as the transmission source. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pains and cramps, potentially progressing to more severe illness. The report notes suspected hantavirus infections on the vessel and ongoing monitoring, with no details on laboratory confirmation provided. The article raises questions about implications for India while stressing vigilance and prudent public health responses during this developing situation as of May 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：ハンタウイルスが恐怖を広げている、クルーズ船での感染、死亡についてのWHOの警告、インドにとってどの程度の懸念か？
triage.triage_reason: カーボベルデ沖のクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス感染疑い例と死亡が報告されており、異常で予想外の事象である。しかし、記事では人獣共通感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは全体的に低いと述べられており、また実際の感染確認が不足しているため、情報不足の段階での経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではクルーズ船がカーボベルデ沖大西洋で発生しているが、サマリーの主題はインドへの影響への懸念提示であり、実際の感染確認は『疑い例』のレベルに留まっている。WHOは全体的リスクは低いと評価しており、状況は管理下にあると当局は述べている。ただし、国際的な航海における感染防止と確認の重要性から、続報を注視する必要がある。カーボベルデは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 做这事记得戴手套！又有人中招了！情况严重可夺命！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Remember to wear gloves when doing this! Another person has fallen victim to it! The situation is serious and potentially life-threatening!
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus wound infection from seafood exposure caused two severe cases highlighted in Shanghai. A 70-year-old woman with heart valve replacement, pacemaker, chronic anticoagulation, and diabetes developed rapid left-hand swelling and severe pain after a puncture while handling seafood. She spiked to 39.7°C; leukocytosis and elevated inflammatory markers supported a diagnosis of traumatic Vibrio vulnificus infection at Shanghai Sixth People’s Hospital. She underwent urgent wound debridement and drainage with multidisciplinary care and broad-spectrum antibiotics; after two weeks, fever resolved, edema subsided, inflammatory and glucose markers stabilized, and she was discharged. In a separate case, an elderly man sustained a small puncture from a blue crab on the left hand, developed swelling with purulence and rising creatinine, progressed to necrotizing fasciitis and septic shock, required emergency amputation, ventilation, and dialysis, but died within 9 days. These cases underscore the high fatality risk of wound Vibrio vulnificus infections after seafood exposure.

triage.headline_ja: これをするときは手袋を忘れずに！また被害者が出た！状況は深刻で命に関わることもある！
triage.triage_reason: ビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染症による重症症例（敗血性ショック、壊死性筋膜炎、死亡例含む）が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常性」に該当。また、海産物を扱う住民への継続的な曝露リスクがあり、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさの複数基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は上海での海産物取扱中の外傷性ビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染症2例を報告。1例は回復したが、1例は敗血性ショック進行により9日以内に死亡。高齢者で基礎疾患（心臓弁膜置換、慢性抗凝固療法、糖尿病）を有する患者が易感染性を示唆。海産物扱い従事者への継続的な曝露リスクと死亡リスクの高さが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: งานวิจัยบ่งชี้สาเหตุ 'คนไม่รู้จักไข้ดิน' ทั้งที่เป็นโรคอันตราย | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research points to the cause of people's lack of awareness about melioidosis, even though it is a dangerous disease
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or 'soil fever,' is an endemic yet poorly known disease in Thailand for nearly seven decades. A 2024 ethnographic study at Thammasat University by a sociology/anthropology researcher examined why awareness remains limited. The research, the first Thai anthropology study on melioidosis, identifies two major obstacles: medical complexity and social/policy complexity. Clinically, the pathogen is an 'evasive' organism that mimics tuberculosis or pneumonia and can destroy lymphatic, blood, bone, brain, and spinal structures; diagnosis relies on culture and may take days, contributing to deaths. Despite a mortality rate around 40% even with hospital care, many patients die within 2-3 days of admission. Treatment spans two phases: an initial 10-14 day intensive IV antibiotic course, followed by 12-20 weeks (3-5 months) of oral therapy to clear infection. Public awareness is hampered by attitudes and government policies; cases from Vietnam War veterans illustrate long latency and diagnostic surprises. Published May 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 研究が指摘する「土の熱病」認識不足の原因 - 危険な疾病であるにもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: タイで風土病として定着しているメリオイドーシスについて、啓発不足の社会的背景を分析した研究報告。公衆衛生影響や国際拡大リスクは直接的ではないが、高い致死率と診断困難性の医学的重要性を認識する価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事は新規流行ではなく、タイで70年近く風土病として存在するメリオイドーシスの認識向上に関する社会学研究の発表。高い致死率（約40%）と診断困難性が臨床的課題として浮き彫りされている。フルRRAの必要性は低いが、公開研究として保健当局の啓発施策の参考になる可能性がある。
